상위 인용 로보틱스 논문 500개를 배경, 방법, 검증, 한계, 공개 자:
A self-contained HTML collection of 500 highly cited robotics papers,
with structured notes on their background, methods, validation, limitations, and public resources.
이 페이지의 논문 순위와 venue 범위는 RoboPaper Atlas의: The paper ranking and venue range on this page are based on RoboPaper Atlas' ICRA / IROS / RA-L / T-RO / RSS / IJRR / Sci-Rob / SoRo / T-Mech / T-FR / RA-P / T-ASE / RAM / CoRL / iSpaRo Paper Explorer.
RoboPaper Atlas는 DBLP, Crossref, OpenAle: RoboPaper Atlas is a robotics paper navigation page that uses DBLP, Crossref, OpenAlex-based DOI-deduped paper index and Semantic Scholar citation count.
논문별 13개 고정 질문과 단일 컬럼 summary row 구성은 <a: For the 13 fixed questions and single column summary row configuration for each paper, refer to 13 Questions for Deep Paper Reading.
원본 Atlas 사이트는 <a class=\"source-chip\" h: The original Atlas site is https://gisbi-kim.github.io/robopaper-atlas/index.html.
각 chunk는 50개 논문과 650개 summary row를 포함합니다: Each chunk contains 50 papers and 650 summary rows.
The notes distinguish verified information from unverified resource links.
통합본은 500개 카드와 6,500개 summary row를 포함하고,: The integrated version includes 500 cards and 6,500 summary rows, and each chunk file can independently open 50 papers.
확인하지 못한 코드, 데이터셋, 프로젝트 링크는 각 카드에서 확인되지 않: Code, dataset, and project links that could not be verified are marked as “Not verified” or “Public link not verified” on each card.
RoboPaper Atlas의 상위 인용 로보틱스 논문 500개를 13개: This is a self-contained HTML that organizes the 500 most cited robotics papers from the RoboPaper Atlas into 13 fixed items. The 13 summary rows use an understated rainbow accent ranging from red to rose, and are displayed only in a one-column vertical layout.
KITTI는 실제 도심 주행에서 동기화된 카메라, LiDAR, GPS/I: KITTI is a dataset paper that creates a common reference point for autonomous driving perception and SLAM evaluation by providing synchronized camera, LiDAR, and GPS/IMU data from actual urban driving.
자율주행과 모바일 로보틱스가 실험실 장면을 넘어 실제 도로 환경의 인식,: This is a benchmark study that appeared at a time when autonomous driving and mobile robotics were going beyond laboratory scenes and required recognition, estimation, and tracking performance of real road environments.
논문은 스테레오, optical flow, visual odometry,: The paper addresses the challenge of making intertwined driving recognition problems such as stereo, optical flow, visual odometry, and 3D object detection comparable on the same platform.
기존 데이터셋은 실내, 정적 장면, 단일 센서, 작은 규모에 머무르는 경: Existing datasets often remain indoors, static scenes, single sensors, and small-scale, so they do not sufficiently reflect the dynamic objects and sensor synchronization problems of actual urban driving.
목표는 실제 차량 기반 멀티센서 기록과 표준 평가 서버를 제공해 컴퓨터비: The goal is to provide real vehicle-based multi-sensor recordings and a standard evaluation server so that the computer vision and robotics communities can compare the same problems with the same numbers.
저자들은 VW station wagon에 스테레오 카메라, Velodyn: The authors equipped a VW station wagon with a stereo camera, Velodyne laser scanner, and GPS/IMU and composed raw/synced data, annotations, and benchmark protocols.
핵심 아이디어는 알고리즘 자체보다 실제 주행 센서 스택과 공개 리더보드를: The core idea is to realign the research flow around the dataset by combining a real driving sensor stack and an open leaderboard rather than the algorithm itself.
검증은 Karlsruhe 도심 주행 장면에서 수집한 여러 task spl: Verification was done with several task splits and baseline results collected from Karlsruhe urban driving scenes, and corresponds to the evaluation of a dataset based on an actual robot driving platform.
결과적으로 KITTI는 stereo, flow, odometry, det: As a result, KITTI became a representative benchmark in the fields of stereo, flow, odometry, and detection, and was later repeatedly used as reference data in autonomous driving perception papers.
비교 관점에서 KITTI는 Middlebury류 정적 비전 데이터보다 센: From a comparative perspective, KITTI has stronger sensor diversity and outdoor dynamic scenes than the Middlebury-like static vision data, but has biases tied to specific cities and vehicle platforms.
의의는 SLAM, 3D detection, tracking, drivin: The significance is that it significantly increases the speed of algorithm development and reproducibility by combining SLAM, 3D detection, tracking, and driving perception into one data ecosystem.
한계는 독일 도심, 특정 센서 높이와 차량 궤적, 제한된 날씨와 도로 문: The limitation is that it does not guarantee generalization and long-tail safety as it is based on German city centers, specific sensor heights and vehicle trajectories, and limited weather and road culture.
향후 과제는 더 다양한 지역, 악천후, 장기 반복 주행, semantic: Future tasks are to expand the distribution of actual driving conditions by expanding to more diverse regions, bad weather, long-term repetitive driving, and semantic/interactive tasks.
자원 공개는 KITTI dataset page와 논문 PDF가 확인되며,: The KITTI dataset page and paper PDF were confirmed to be resource disclosures, and no separate official GitHub code was confirmed as a core resource of the paper.
ORB-SLAM은 ORB feature를 tracking, mapping: ORB-SLAM is a paper that elevates monocular SLAM to the level of a real-time system by using ORB features uniformly throughout the entire process of tracking, mapping, relocalization, and loop closing.
단안 카메라 SLAM은 저가 센서만으로 위치추정과 지도를 동시에 수행할: The monocular camera SLAM was an important foundational technology for mobile robots, AR, and drones as it could simultaneously perform location estimation and guidance with only a low-cost sensor.
논문은 작은 실내부터 큰 실외까지 scale ambiguity와 trac: The paper solves the problem of performing robust real-time SLAM on monocular video with scale ambiguity and tracking loss from small indoors to large outdoors.
기존 PTAM 계열은 좁은 환경과 수동 초기화에 강하게 의존했고, loo: The existing PTAM series relied heavily on narrow environments and manual initialization, and was weak in integrated loop closing, relocalization, and long-term map management.
목표는 자동 초기화, tracking, local mapping, loo: The goal is to create a general-purpose feature-based monocular SLAM system with automatic initialization, tracking, local mapping, loop closing, and relocalization.
방법은 ORB feature, covisibility graph, ess: The method combines ORB features, covisibility graph, essential graph optimization, keyframe/point culling, and place recognition in parallel threads.
핵심 아이디어는 모든 SLAM 하위 작업에서 같은 ORB represen: The core idea is to use the same ORB representation in all SLAM subtasks and maintain only compact and trackable maps in a survival-of-the-fittest manner.
검증은 여러 공개 데이터셋의 총 <strong>27개</strong> s: Verification focuses on offline dataset evaluation by comparing trajectory accuracy and robustness in a total of 27 sequences from several public datasets.
결과는 당시 monocular SLAM baseline들보다 넓은 장면에: The results showed low drift and strong relocalization in a wider scene than the monocular SLAM baselines at the time, and the paper improved reproducibility with open code.
비교 대상은 PTAM, LSD-SLAM 등 당시 주요 monocular: The targets of comparison are the major monocular SLAMs at the time, such as PTAM and LSD-SLAM, and focus on sparse feature-based accuracy and stability rather than dense reconstruction.
의의는 이후 ORB-SLAM2/<strong>3</strong>, vis: The significance is that it is a usable monocular SLAM architecture that later became a direct reference point for ORB-SLAM2/3, visual-inertial SLAM, and open-source SLAM benchmarks.
한계는 단안 scale, dynamic object, textureles: Limitations include being vulnerable to monocular scale, dynamic objects, textureless scenes, rolling shutter, and illumination changes, and does not provide dense semantic maps.
향후 과제는 stereo/RGB-D/IMU 통합, multi-map li: Future tasks naturally led to stereo/RGB-D/IMU integration, multi-map lifelong operation, dynamic scene handling, and semantic robustness.
자원 공개는 arXiv, 프로젝트 페이지, raulmur/ORB_SLAM: Resource disclosure is confirmed on arXiv, project page, and raulmur/ORB_SLAM GitHub, and code disclosure is specified as part of the paper contribution.
MuJoCo는 접촉이 많은 로봇 제어 최적화를 위해 빠르고 안정적인 ar: MuJoCo is a physics engine thesis that provides fast and stable articulated dynamics and a contact solver for optimizing high-contact robot control.
모델 기반 제어와 강화학습은 많은 후보 제어기를 빠르게 평가할 수 있는: Model-based control and reinforcement learning rely heavily on accurate physics simulators that can quickly evaluate many candidate controllers.
논문은 다관절 시스템과 접촉을 포함한 로봇 동역학을 빠르게 계산하면서도: The paper addresses the problem of calculating robot dynamics, including multi-joint systems and contacts, quickly while providing them smoothly enough to be used for control optimization.
기존 범용 게임/로봇 엔진은 spring-damper 접촉, joint: Existing general-purpose game/robot engines often did not fit well with control optimization needs in spring-damper contact, joint constraint processing, and derivative approach.
목표는 model-based control에 특화된 physics eng: The goal is to create a physics engine specialized for model-based control and provide XML model specification and efficient contact dynamics.
방법은 generalized coordinate articulated d: The method combines generalized coordinate articulated dynamics, recursive computation, convex contact model, velocity-stepping solver, and MJCF/XML modeling.
핵심 아이디어는 접촉을 penalty spring이 아니라 최적화된 co: The key idea is to secure stability and speed even in stiff contact by releasing the contact with an optimized constraint response rather than a penalty spring.
검증은 다양한 articulated model과 contact-rich: Validation is a software/simulation evaluation that demonstrates simulation performance under various articulated model and contact-rich control scenarios.
결과는 control optimization에 필요한 빠른 rollout: The results showed the possibility of fast rollout and stable contact processing required for control optimization, and later became one of the de facto standard engines for robot learning benchmarks.
비교 관점에서 MuJoCo는 ODE/Bullet류 범용 엔진보다 제어 최: From a comparative perspective, MuJoCo emphasized a design closer to control optimization and differentiable-friendly modeling than ODE/Bullet general-purpose engines.
의의는 sim-to-real, reinforcement learning,: The significance is that sim-to-real, reinforcement learning, and trajectory optimization research provide a common basis for repeatedly experimenting with complex robot models.
한계는 모든 접촉 물리가 실제와 일치하지 않고, friction/cont: The limitation is that not all contact physics match reality, and friction/contact parameter tuning and simulator-reality gap still remain bottlenecks in policy transfer.
향후 과제는 더 정확한 contact calibration, differ: Future tasks lead to more accurate contact calibration, differentiable simulation, real-world identification, and integration of learning pipeline.
자원 공개는 MuJoCo 공식 사이트와 google-deepmind/mu: Resource disclosure is currently confirmed on the MuJoCo official site and google-deepmind/mujoco GitHub, and the license status at the time of the original paper and the current license status must be interpreted separately.
ORB-SLAM2는 ORB-SLAM의 강한 sparse feature p: ORB-SLAM2 expands ORB-SLAM's strong sparse feature pipeline to stereo and RGB-D and generalizes it to a metric-scale real-time SLAM system.
로봇과 AR 시스템은 단안뿐 아니라 stereo, RGB-D 센서를 상황: Robots and AR systems use not only monocular, but also stereo and RGB-D sensors depending on the situation, so SLAM that processes multiple inputs in the same architecture was needed.
논문은 monocular, stereo, RGB-D camera inpu: The paper addresses an open-source SLAM problem that receives monocular, stereo, and RGB-D camera inputs and performs tracking, mapping, and loop closing.
기존 ORB-SLAM은 단안 기반이라 metric scale을 직접 얻지: Existing ORB-SLAM was monocular-based, so it could not directly obtain metric scale, and RGB-D/stereo SLAM systems had inconsistent loop closing and map management quality.
목표는 ORB-SLAM의 robustness를 유지하면서 depth가 있: The goal is to provide scale-aware localization and mapping from sensors with depth while maintaining the robustness of ORB-SLAM.
방법은 ORB feature matching, local bundle a: The method maintains ORB feature matching, local bundle adjustment, keyframe graph, and loop closing, and utilizes stereo/RGB-D depth for map point initialization.
핵심 아이디어는 센서별 front-end 차이를 최소화하고 동일한 spa: The core idea is to minimize front-end differences for each sensor and integrate multi-camera modality with the same sparse map optimization backend.
검증은 KITTI, TUM RGB-D, EuRoC 등 공개 dataset: Verification is an offline benchmark evaluation that compares trajectory accuracy in public datasets such as KITTI, TUM RGB-D, and EuRoC.
결과는 stereo/RGB-D 설정에서 당시 대표 open-source: The results showed competitive accuracy and speed compared to the representative open-source SLAM at the time in stereo/RGB-D settings and provided widely reusable code.
비교 대상은 RGB-D SLAM, LSD-SLAM, S-PTAM 등이며,: The comparison targets are RGB-D SLAM, LSD-SLAM, and S-PTAM, and have strengths in localization accuracy and real-time sparse mapping over dense reconstruction.
의의는 연구자가 센서 선택을 바꿔도 같은 SLAM backbone을 재사: The significance is that it significantly increases the reproducibility and baseline of visual SLAM experiments by allowing researchers to reuse the same SLAM backbone even if they change sensor selection.
한계는 여전히 dynamic object, low texture, sev: Limitations include that it is still vulnerable to dynamic objects, low texture, and severe illumination changes, and it does not directly address dense semantic reconstruction or active relocalization.
향후 과제는 visual-inertial tight coupling, m: Future tasks include visual-inertial tight coupling, multi-session map reuse, long-term map maintenance, and semantic/dynamic robustness.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 raulmur/ORB_SLAM2 GitHub가: For resource disclosure, arXiv and raulmur/ORB_SLAM2 GitHub are confirmed, and the project and code are important public resources for the paper.
이 논문은 RRT*와 PRM*를 통해 sampling-based moti: This paper extends sampling-based motion planning from simple feasibility search to optimal planning with asymptotic optimality through RRT* and PRM*.
고차원 로봇 motion planning은 exact planning이: In high-dimensional robot motion planning, exact planning was difficult, so sampling-based planners were widely used, but ensuring optimality remained a key task.
논문은 collision-free path를 찾는 데서 더 나아가 pat: The paper goes beyond finding a collision-free path and solves the problem of designing a sampling-based planning algorithm whose path cost converges to the optimal solution.
기존 PRM과 RRT는 probabilistic completeness는: Existing PRM and RRT provided probabilistic completeness, but the guarantee that solution quality would converge to the optimal value was weak even as the number of samples increased.
목표는 sampling-based planning에 asymptotic: The goal is to grant asymptotic optimality to sampling-based planning while maintaining the scalability and implementability of existing planners.
방법은 PRM*와 RRT*를 제안하고, neighbor radius와 r: The method proposes PRM* and RRT*, and gradually improves the path cost by theoretically setting the neighbor radius and rewiring conditions.
핵심 아이디어는 tree/roadmap을 단순 확장하지 않고 새 samp: The core idea is to make the graph recover the optimal path structure by reexamining the connections around new samples rather than simply expanding the tree/roadmap.
검증은 이론 증명과 수치 simulation으로 이루어졌으며, 실제 로봇: Verification was done through theoretical proof and numerical simulation, and was more of an algorithmic benchmark than an actual robot hardware experiment.
결과는 RRT*와 PRM*가 확률적 완전성과 점근적 최적성을 동시에 갖는: The results show that RRT* and PRM* have both stochastic completeness and asymptotic optimality, and suggest cost improvement as the sample increases.
비교 대상은 RRT와 PRM이며, 새 알고리즘은 초기 속도에서 불리할 수: The comparison targets are RRT and PRM, and although the new algorithm may be disadvantageous in initial speed, it has a structural advantage in long-term solution quality.
의의는 이후 BIT*, FMT*, informed sampling, ki: The significance is that it provided a theoretical starting point for the series of optimal sampling planners such as BIT*, FMT*, informed sampling, and kinodynamic optimal planning.
한계는 high-dimensional narrow passage와 kin: Limitations include that convergence can be slow in high-dimensional narrow passage and kinodynamic constraints, and finite-time performance greatly depends on the problem structure.
향후 과제는 admissible heuristic, batch sampl: Future tasks include combining admissible heuristic, batch sampling, informed set restriction, dynamic constraints, and real-time replanning.
자원 공개는 arXiv/DOI가 확인되며, 논문 자체의 공식 코드 공개는: Resource disclosure is confirmed through arXiv/DOI, and official code disclosure of the paper itself is not confirmed, but RRT* series implementation is confirmed through OMPL, etc.
PCL 논문은 point cloud 처리 알고리즘을 공통 C++ 라이브러: The PCL paper bundled point cloud processing algorithms into a common C++ library, greatly expanding the base for experimentation and reuse in 3D perception research.
RGB-D 센서와 LiDAR가 빠르게 확산되면서 로봇은 2D image를: As RGB-D sensors and LiDAR rapidly spread, robots had to go beyond 2D images and process 3D point clouds in real time.
논문은 filtering, feature, registration, se: The paper addresses the problem of providing 3D perception building blocks such as filtering, feature, registration, segmentation, and surface reconstruction in a reusable form.
기존 연구 코드는 논문별로 흩어져 있고 API와 데이터 구조가 달라 비교: Existing research codes were scattered across papers and had different APIs and data structures, making comparison, combination, and reproduction difficult.
목표는 open-source modular library를 통해 3D p: The goal is to standardize the 3D perception algorithm through an open-source modular library and allow researchers and developers to quickly configure the system.
방법은 point type, kd-tree, sample consensu: The method organizes point type, kd-tree, sample consensus, descriptor, registration, and visualization modules into a C++-based API.
핵심 아이디어는 단일 알고리즘 제안이 아니라 3D pipeline 전체를: The core idea is not to propose a single algorithm, but to provide the entire 3D pipeline as an assembleable software ecosystem.
검증은 여러 3D processing 예제와 응용 demonstratio: Verification is centered on several 3D processing examples and application demonstrations, and is not in the nature of asserting SOTA on a single specific benchmark.
결과는 PCL이 로봇 perception과 3D vision의 대표 op: As a result, PCL established itself as a representative open-source toolkit for robot perception and 3D vision, becoming the baseline and implementation basis for numerous subsequent papers.
비교 관점에서 PCL은 MATLAB script나 개별 연구 코드보다 p: From a comparative perspective, PCL has a stronger production-friendly API and ROS interoperability than MATLAB script or individual research code, but library quality varies by module.
의의는 FPFH, ICP, RANSAC, segmentation 같은 알: The significance is that it speeds up 3D robotics research by preventing researchers from having to implement new algorithms such as FPFH, ICP, RANSAC, and segmentation each time.
한계는 library paper 특성상 알고리즘별 이론적 novelty가: The limitation is that due to the nature of the library paper, the theoretical novelty of each algorithm is not uniform, and a separate ecosystem is needed from the latest 3D perception based on GPU/learning.
향후 과제는 large-scale point cloud, learned: Future tasks include continuous integration with large-scale point cloud, learned descriptors, GPU acceleration, and modern robotics middleware.
자원 공개는 pointclouds.org와 PointCloudLibrar: Pointclouds.org and PointCloudLibrary/pcl GitHub are confirmed to be open resources, and open code is the core resource of the paper.
Chen and Medioni의 registration 논문은 여러 ra: Chen and Medioni's registration paper provided the core foundation for the early ICP series, which creates a 3D object model by repeatedly registering multiple range images.
3D range sensing이 확산되기 전부터 로봇 vision은 여러: Even before the spread of 3D range sensing, the issue of creating a complete object model by combining range images from multiple viewpoints was important in robot vision.
논문은 서로 다른 시점에서 얻은 range image들을 하나의 일관된: The paper addresses the problem of combining range images obtained from different viewpoints into a single consistent 3D object representation.
기존 방법은 수동 대응점, 제한된 시점 관계, 노이즈에 취약한 정합에 의: Existing methods relied on manual correspondence points, limited viewpoint relationships, and registration vulnerable to noise, making it difficult to automatically integrate complex object surfaces.
목표는 overlapping range view 사이의 상대 pose를: The goal is to accumulate multiple scans into a single surface model by repeatedly estimating the relative pose between overlapping range views.
방법은 표면 점과 tangent plane 사이의 거리를 최소화하는 반복: The method updates the rigid transformation using an iterative matching procedure that minimizes the distance between surface points and the tangent plane.
핵심 아이디어는 point-to-plane 형태의 local surfac: The core idea is to use a point-to-plane local surface error to construct an objective function that fits the surface alignment more directly than a simple point-to-point.
검증은 여러 range image를 가진 물체 scan을 대상으로 한 오: Verification is an offline 3D reconstruction experiment targeting object scans with multiple range images, and is not centered on actual robot manipulation experiments.
결과는 다중 range view가 점진적으로 일관된 object mode: The results show that multiple range views can be progressively integrated into a coherent object model, creating an important comparative axis for subsequent ICP studies.
비교 관점에서 이 방법은 Besl-McKay ICP와 함께 고전 regi: From a comparative perspective, this method is cited as the two main bases of classical registration along with Besl-McKay ICP, but it is sensitive to initial values and local minima.
의의는 3D registration을 object modeling의 핵심: The significance is that it established 3D registration as a core procedure in object modeling and subsequently influenced SLAM, scanning, medical imaging, and point cloud registration.
한계는 rigid static object와 충분한 overlap을 가정: The limitation is that it assumes sufficient overlap with rigid static objects, and modern robust handling of outliers, symmetry, and large initial misalignment is limited.
향후 과제는 robust correspondence, global reg: Future tasks lead to the combination of robust correspondence, global registration, probabilistic uncertainty, and learned descriptor.
자원 공개는 DOI는 확인되지만 공식 project page나 GitHu: For resource disclosure, the DOI was confirmed, but the official project page, GitHub, and dataset page were not confirmed.
VINS-Mono는 monocular camera와 IMU를 tightl: VINS-Mono presented a real-time VIO system including initialization, loop closure, and relocalization by combining a monocular camera and IMU with tightly-coupled sliding-window optimization.
드론과 모바일 로봇은 GPS가 약한 환경에서 카메라와 IMU만으로 sca: Drones and mobile robots must reliably estimate scale-aware pose using only cameras and IMUs in environments where GPS is weak.
논문은 monocular image와 IMU measurement를 입력: The paper solves the problem of real-time estimation of metric trajectory, velocity, IMU bias, and sparse map by receiving monocular image and IMU measurement as input.
기존 VIO는 초기화, bias 추정, loop closure, relo: Existing VIOs were often difficult to integrate into actual systems because initialization, bias estimation, loop closure, relocalization, and sensor failure handling were separate.
목표는 robust initialization부터 nonlinear op: The goal is to provide a highly complete monocular VIO pipeline including robust initialization, nonlinear optimization, loop closure, and pose graph reuse.
방법은 IMU preintegration, feature tracking: The method combines IMU preintegration, feature tracking, tightly-coupled sliding-window bundle adjustment, marginalization, relocalization, and pose graph optimization.
핵심 아이디어는 scale과 gravity를 포함한 visual-iner: The core idea is to stabilize visual-inertial initialization, including scale and gravity, and to operate the local window and global loop graph together.
검증은 EuRoC MAV와 real-world handheld/aeria: Validation includes EuRoC MAV and real-world handheld/aerial experiments, along with offline dataset evaluation and actual sensor demonstration.
결과는 OKVIS, MSCKF, ROVIO 등과 비교해 competiti: The results showed competitive trajectory accuracy and high robustness compared to OKVIS, MSCKF, ROVIO, etc. and quickly spread as open-source.
비교 대상은 filter-based VIO와 optimization-ba: The objects of comparison are filter-based VIO and optimization-based VIO, and VINS-Mono chooses the accuracy and reproducibility of full nonlinear optimization at the expense of computational volume.
의의는 연구와 실제 응용 모두에서 바로 쓸 수 있는 VIO baselin: The significance is that it provides a VIO baseline that can be used immediately in both research and practical applications, making it a standard starting point for SLAM, AR, and UAV navigation.
한계는 빠른 회전, motion blur, texture 부족, IMU-: Limitations may include performance degradation in fast rotation, motion blur, lack of texture, IMU-camera calibration error, and dynamic scenes.
향후 과제는 stereo/multi-camera, event camera: Future tasks include combining stereo/multi-camera, event camera, semantic robustness, online calibration, and dynamic object rejection.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 HKUST-Aerial-Robotics/VINS: For resource disclosure, arXiv and HKUST-Aerial-Robotics/VINS-Mono GitHub are confirmed, and public code and demo are key resources.
이 튜토리얼은 SLAM의 확률적 문제정의, EKF 기반 해법, 데이터 연: This tutorial is an article that sets the standard for introductory and standard terminology by organizing SLAM's probabilistic problem definition, EKF-based solution, data correlation, and consistency issues.
모바일 로봇이 미지 환경에서 위치와 지도를 동시에 추정해야 한다는 SLA: The SLAM problem, in which mobile robots must simultaneously estimate location and map in an unknown environment, has become a key challenge in autonomous movement.
논문은 SLAM의 기본 확률 모델, 상태 표현, 관측 모델, data a: The paper undertakes the task of organizing SLAM's basic probability model, state expression, observation model, data association, and uncertainty propagation in an understandable manner.
기존 설명은 논문마다 notation과 가정이 달라 입문자가 EKF-SL: The existing explanation had different notations and assumptions for each paper, making it difficult for beginners to understand the essence and failure factors of EKF-SLAM at a glance.
목표는 SLAM problem의 수학적 구조와 대표 EKF solutio: The goal is to explain the mathematical structure of the SLAM problem and the representative EKF solution in a tutorial format so that researchers and practitioners can use the same language.
방법은 landmark map과 robot pose를 joint stat: The method is explained from the perspective of Bayesian filtering, which sets the landmark map and robot pose as the joint state and updates the posterior through motion/observation update.
핵심 아이디어는 위치 불확실성과 landmark 불확실성이 correla: The core idea is to clearly show that location uncertainty and landmark uncertainty are intertwined through correlation, revealing that SLAM is different from simple localization.
검증은 새로운 실험 benchmark가 아니라 기존 SLAM 예제와 개념: Verification is not a new experimental benchmark, but is a tutorial/survey conducted through existing SLAM examples and conceptual analysis.
결과는 특정 알고리즘 성능 수치보다 SLAM community의 표준 문: The results left a stronger impact as a standard problem definition and educational material for the SLAM community than as specific algorithm performance figures.
비교 관점에서 이 글은 FastSLAM이나 graph SLAM보다 EKF: From a comparative perspective, this article does not cover the entirety of modern backend optimization, as the explanation is stronger on EKF-SLAM than on FastSLAM or graph SLAM.
의의는 SLAM을 확률 추정 문제로 정식화하는 공통 기반을 제공해 이후: The significance is that it provides a common basis for formulating SLAM as a probability estimation problem, making subsequent discussions on graph-based, particle-based, and visual SLAM easier.
한계는 <strong>2006년</strong> 관점의 tutorial이: The limitation is that it is a 2006 perspective, so robust perception, large-scale loop closure, semantic/dynamic SLAM, and learned front-end are rarely covered.
향후 과제는 Part II와 후속 survey들이 다룬 data asso: Future tasks will expand to data association, consistency, scalability, graph optimization, and robust perception, which were covered in Part II and subsequent surveys.
자원 공개는 DOI와 공개 PDF가 확인되지만 별도 공식 코드나 data: DOI and open PDF are confirmed for resource disclosure, but it is not a separate official code or dataset open paper.
TUM RGB-D benchmark 논문은 RGB-D SLAM을 came: The TUM RGB-D benchmark paper is a dataset/evaluation protocol paper that allows RGB-D SLAM to be evaluated using camera trajectory ground truth and standard metrics.
Kinect류 RGB-D camera가 보급되면서 실내 dense/vis: As Kinect-type RGB-D cameras became popular, indoor dense/visual SLAM research rapidly increased, but fair trajectory evaluation data was lacking.
논문은 RGB-D SLAM 시스템을 같은 RGB-D sequence와 g: The paper addresses the benchmark problem of quantitatively comparing RGB-D SLAM systems on the same RGB-D sequence and ground-truth trajectory.
기존 RGB-D SLAM 논문들은 각자 다른 장면과 metric을 써서: Existing RGB-D SLAM papers used different scenes and metrics, making it difficult to compare absolute trajectory error, relative pose error, and robustness.
목표는 다양한 motion, texture, structure를 포함한: The goal is to create a reproducible benchmark by providing RGB-D sequences and evaluation tools, including various motions, textures, and structures.
방법은 RGB image, depth image, camera calib: The method synchronizes RGB image, depth image, camera calibration, and motion capture ground truth and provides an ATE/RPE-based evaluation script.
핵심 아이디어는 SLAM 결과의 map 품질보다 trajectory er: The core idea is to standardize the trajectory error rather than the map quality of the SLAM results to numerically compare RGB-D odometry and loop closure performance.
검증은 handheld RGB-D camera로 수집한 실내 sequen: Verification is an offline dataset evaluation based on indoor sequences and motion-capture ground truth collected with a handheld RGB-D camera.
결과는 benchmark 자체와 baseline evaluation을 제: The results presented the benchmark itself and baseline evaluation, which later became one of the most common evaluation datasets for RGB-D SLAM papers.
비교 관점에서 TUM RGB-D는 실제 실내 움직임과 GT가 강하지만 장: From a comparative perspective, TUM RGB-D has strong real-world indoor motion and GT, but is limited in scene scale, sensor generation, and outdoor/general robot dynamics.
의의는 RGB-D SLAM의 재현성 문제를 크게 줄이고 ORB-SLAM2: The significance is to greatly reduce the reproducibility problem of RGB-D SLAM and provide a common language for comparing ORB-SLAM2, ElasticFusion, and KinectFusion series.
한계는 Kinect 계열 depth noise와 실내 짧은 traject: Limitations include Kinect-based depth noise and short indoor trajectories, which do not sufficiently represent long-term, outdoor, dynamic human-rich SLAM.
향후 과제는 더 큰 공간, 다양한 sensor, semantic/dyna: Future tasks include expanding the benchmark to include larger spaces, various sensors, semantic/dynamic annotation, and online failure metrics.
자원 공개는 TUM RGB-D dataset page와 평가 도구가 확인: The TUM RGB-D dataset page and evaluation tool were confirmed for resource disclosure, but the separate GitHub code of the paper itself was not confirmed.
ICRA 버전의 Randomized Kinodynamic Planning: ICRA's version of Randomized Kinodynamic Planning is an early key paper that applies RRT to dynamically constrained state-space trajectory planning.
고전 path planning은 configuration space의 기: Classical path planning mainly dealt with geometric collisions in configuration space, but real robots had to simultaneously satisfy the dynamics constraints of speed, acceleration, and control input.
논문은 장애물이 있는 환경에서 nonlinear dynamics를 따르는: The paper addresses the problem of finding a control trajectory that takes a system following nonlinear dynamics from an initial state to a goal state in an environment with obstacles.
기존 randomized roadmap은 holonomic path pl: The existing randomized roadmap was strong in holonomic path planning, but it was difficult to apply directly to kinodynamic planning including state and velocity.
목표는 high-dimensional state space에서 빠르게 탐: The goal is to find a feasible kinodynamic trajectory by constructing a randomized tree that can be quickly explored in high-dimensional state space.
방법은 random state sampling, nearest neigh: The method creates an RRT-type trajectory tree using random state sampling, nearest neighbor selection, forward dynamic simulation, and incremental tree expansion.
핵심 아이디어는 configuration space 대신 state sp: The key idea is to explore state space instead of configuration space and generate edges with dynamic rollout rather than simple straight lines.
검증은 hovercraft와 satellite 같은 동역학 예제의 sim: Verification was done through simulation of dynamic examples such as hovercraft and satellite, and actual robot hardware experiments are not the focus of the paper.
결과는 최대 <strong>12차원</strong> 상태공간에서 rand: The results showed that a randomized tree can find a kinodynamic feasible trajectory in a state space of up to 12 dimensions.
비교 관점에서 이 접근은 grid search나 deterministic: From a comparative perspective, this approach is more practical at higher dimensions than search grid or deterministic control search, but its optimality and finite-time completeness are limited.
의의는 RRT 계열을 단순 path planning에서 control-c: The significance is that it expanded the RRT series from simple path planning to control-constrained planning, creating a starting point for sampling-based kinodynamic planning.
한계는 동역학 rollout의 품질, distance metric, ra: The limitations are that performance is sensitive to the quality of dynamic rollout, distance metric, and random control sampling, and cost optimality is not the goal.
향후 과제는 optimal kinodynamic RRT, steering: Future tasks lead to the combination of optimal kinodynamic RRT, steering function, informed sampling, and model predictive planning.
자원 공개는 DOI/논문 기록은 확인되지만 공식 project page,: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/paper records, but the official project page, GitHub, and dataset were not confirmed.
FPFH는 point cloud local geometry descrip: FPFH simplifies the calculation of point cloud local geometry descriptor, providing practical speed and expressiveness in 3D registration and object recognition.
3D point cloud registration은 대응점 추정이 핵심이: The key to 3D point cloud registration is estimation of corresponding points, and for this, a local descriptor that reliably summarizes the surrounding surface geometry was needed.
논문은 Point Feature Histogram의 표현력을 유지하면서: The paper solves the problem of creating a descriptor that can be used in large point clouds by reducing computational costs while maintaining the expressiveness of the Point Feature Histogram.
기존 PFH는 모든 이웃 쌍 관계를 계산해 descriptor 품질은 좋: The existing PFH calculates all neighbor pair relationships and has good descriptor quality, but its complexity is high, putting a heavy burden on the real-time registration pipeline.
목표는 더 빠른 local feature histogram을 제안해 3D: The goal is to streamline correspondence search in 3D registration by proposing a faster local feature histogram.
방법은 query point와 이웃 간 Simplified PFH를 계산: The method calculates the Simplified PFH between the query point and its neighbors and then creates an FPFH descriptor by weighted aggregation of the SPFHs of the surrounding neighbors.
핵심 아이디어는 이웃 간 모든 pairwise 관계를 직접 계산하지 않고: The core idea is to preserve local geometry statistics through a 2-stage approximation without directly computing all pairwise relationships between neighbors.
검증은 range scan과 point cloud registration: Verification is performed with offline experiments comparing descriptor matching and alignment performance in range scan and point cloud registration tasks.
결과는 PFH 대비 계산량을 크게 줄이면서 registration에 필요: The results showed that the amount of calculation was greatly reduced compared to PFH, while maintaining much of the discriminative power required for registration.
비교 대상은 PFH와 기존 local feature이며, FPFH는 de: The objects of comparison are PFH and existing local features, and FPFH's strength is the practical trade-off between descriptor richness and runtime.
의의는 PCL에 포함되어 ICP 초기정렬, object recogniti: The significance is that it is included in PCL and is widely used as a basic feature for ICP initial alignment, object recognition, and 3D registration.
한계는 normal estimation 품질, point density,: Its limitations are that it is sensitive to normal estimation quality, point density, occlusion, and repetitive geometry, and has limited expressiveness compared to learned 3D descriptors.
향후 과제는 robust normal estimation, global: Future tasks include integration with robust normal estimation, global registration, learned descriptor, and outlier rejection.
자원 공개는 DOI와 PCL 구현이 확인되며, 별도 논문 전용 GitHu: For resource disclosure, DOI and PCL implementation were confirmed, and GitHub dedicated to separate papers was not confirmed.
ORB-SLAM3는 visual, visual-inertial, mult: ORB-SLAM3 integrates visual, visual-inertial, and multi-map SLAM into one open-source library, extending the ORB-SLAM series to include long-term operation and reinitialization.
SLAM 시스템은 센서 조합, tracking failure, map r: As sensor combinations, tracking failures, and map reuse situations become more diverse, the SLAM system becomes insufficient with a single map and single camera modality.
논문은 monocular, stereo, RGB-D, monocular-: The paper addresses the problem of performing accurate SLAM and map reuse on monocular, stereo, RGB-D, monocular-inertial, and stereo-inertial inputs.
기존 ORB-SLAM2는 inertial tight coupling과 r: The existing ORB-SLAM2 had limited inertial tight coupling and robust multi-map management, making it difficult to recover from tracking loss during long-term operation.
목표는 visual-inertial initialization, tigh: The goal is to provide an integrated SLAM library with visual-inertial initialization, tightly-coupled BA, place recognition, and atlas-based multi-map.
방법은 ORB feature front-end, IMU preintegr: The method combines ORB feature front-end, IMU preintegration, MAP estimation, local/inertial BA, loop closing, and Atlas multi-map representation.
핵심 아이디어는 tracking이 끊겨도 새 map을 만들고 later: The core idea is a combination of the Atlas structure and inertial optimization, which creates a new map even if tracking is interrupted and merges the maps with later place recognition.
검증은 EuRoC, TUM-VI, KITTI 등 여러 dataset에서: Verification is centered on an offline benchmark that compares visual and visual-inertial settings on several datasets such as EuRoC, TUM-VI, and KITTI.
결과는 다양한 sensor setup에서 높은 trajectory acc: The results showed high trajectory accuracy in various sensor setups, and were especially influential with the open-source baseline of visual-inertial monocular SLAM.
비교 대상은 VINS-Mono, OKVIS, ORB-SLAM2 등이며,: The targets of comparison are VINS-Mono, OKVIS, and ORB-SLAM2, and ORB-SLAM3's strengths are feature-based accuracy and multi-map recovery.
의의는 연구자가 하나의 library로 여러 SLAM modality를: The significance is that it is an integrated baseline that allows researchers to compare multiple SLAM modalities with one library and insert them into an actual system.
한계는 ORB feature 의존성 때문에 low texture, blu: Limitations include low texture, blur, dynamic object, and adverse lighting due to ORB feature dependency, and dense/semantic maps are not directly provided.
향후 과제는 dynamic SLAM, semantic associatio: Future tasks will expand to dynamic SLAM, semantic association, neural features, online calibration, and lifelong map maintenance.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 UZ-SLAMLab/ORB_SLAM3 GitHu: Resource disclosure is confirmed through arXiv and UZ-SLAMLab/ORB_SLAM3 GitHub, and public code is the core of the paper's resources.
RRT-Connect는 시작과 목표에서 두 RRT를 동시에 키우고 gre: RRT-Connect is a method of speeding up single-query high-dimensional path planning by simultaneously growing two RRTs at the start and goal and meeting them through greedy connect.
로봇 팔과 복잡한 기구의 motion planning은 고차원 confi: Motion planning of robotic arms and complex mechanisms often requires quickly solving a single start-goal query in a high-dimensional configuration space.
논문은 collision-free path를 single query로 빠: The paper addresses the problem of quickly finding a collision-free path with a single query, and especially focuses on increasing search efficiency in high-dimensional planning.
기존 RRT는 빠르게 공간을 탐색하지만 한쪽 tree만 확장하면 목표까지: The existing RRT quickly searches space, but if only one tree is expanded, there may be a lot of unnecessary search to reach the goal.
목표는 probabilistic planning의 단순성과 확장성을 유지: The goal is to propose a bidirectional planner that significantly reduces practical query time while maintaining the simplicity and scalability of probabilistic planning.
방법은 start와 goal에서 각각 RRT를 확장하고, 새 node가: The method extends the RRT at the start and goal, respectively, and uses a strategy of connecting the opposite tree as greedily as possible when a new node is created.
핵심 아이디어는 exploration과 exploitation을 두 tr: The core idea is to strongly induce progress in the goal direction by combining exploration and exploitation with an attempt to connect the two trees.
검증은 고차원 planning benchmark와 manipulation: Verification is performed through simulation of high-dimensional planning benchmarks and manipulation-like scenarios, and focuses on algorithmic evaluation rather than actual robot experiments.
결과는 기본 RRT보다 빠른 solution discovery를 보였고: The results showed a faster discovery solution than the basic RRT, and later became the basic baseline for sampling-based planners.
비교 대상은 single-tree RRT와 기존 randomized pl: The comparison targets are single-tree RRT and existing randomized planner. RRT-Connect is strong in fast feasible path, but path quality optimization requires separate post-processing.
의의는 MoveIt, OMPL 등 실제 motion planning st: The significance is that it provides a simple and powerful structure that can be used as a basic planner in actual motion planning stacks such as MoveIt and OMPL.
한계는 narrow passage, differential constra: The limitation is that direct guarantees are weak for narrow passage, differential constraints, optimality, and dynamic obstacles.
향후 과제는 shortcut smoothing, constraint-aw: Future tasks include combining shortcut smoothing, constraint-aware planning, optimal RRT*, kinodynamic steering, and informed sampling.
자원 공개는 DOI와 구현체가 OMPL 등에 확인되지만, 원 논문 전용: Resource disclosure is confirmed through DOI and implementation in OMPL, etc., but official GitHub or dataset dedicated to the original paper has not been confirmed.
Dynamic Window Approach는 로봇의 속도 공간에서 동역학: The Dynamic Window Approach is a classic method that performs real-time local collision avoidance by evaluating only dynamically reachable commands in the robot's speed space.
모바일 로봇 navigation은 global path가 있어도 센서 기: Mobile robot navigation must simultaneously satisfy sensor-based local obstacle avoidance and dynamics constraints even if there is a global path.
논문은 로봇이 현재 속도에서 짧은 시간 안에 실제로 도달 가능한 tran: The paper solves the problem of the robot selecting a translational/rotational velocity that can actually be reached within a short period of time from the current speed and moving forward without collision.
기존 local planner는 기하학적 회피나 potential fie: Existing local planners often focused on geometric avoidance or potential fields and did not explicitly address robot acceleration limit and stopping distance.
목표는 velocity command space에서 안전성, goal p: The goal is to present a real-time obstacle avoidance algorithm that evaluates safety, goal progress, and speed together in the velocity command space.
방법은 dynamic window 안의 admissible velocit: The method samples the admissible velocity within the dynamic window and selects the optimal command by combining heading, clearance, and velocity objectives.
핵심 아이디어는 경로 공간이 아니라 즉시 실행 가능한 속도 공간을 탐색해: The core idea is to place dynamic constraints at the center of local planning by exploring the immediately actionable velocity space rather than the path space.
검증은 mobile robot navigation experiment와: Verification is performed through mobile robot navigation experiments and simulations, and includes evaluation of local navigation based on actual robots.
결과는 동적 제약을 고려하면서도 실시간으로 장애물을 회피하고 목표 방향으: The results showed that it was possible to avoid obstacles and move toward the goal in real time while considering dynamic constraints.
비교 관점에서 DWA는 potential field보다 안정적이고 pra: From a comparative perspective, DWA is more stable and practical than potential fields, but it does not directly address global optimality or complex social navigation.
의의는 ROS navigation stack 등에서 오랫동안 local: The significance is that it is a practical collision avoidance framework that has been used as the basic concept of local planner for a long time in ROS navigation stack, etc.
한계는 local minima, 좁은 통로, dynamic pedestr: Limitations may include vulnerability to local minima, narrow passageways, dynamic pedestrian interaction, non-circular robot footprint, and perception uncertainty.
향후 과제는 trajectory rollout, model predict: Future tasks include combining trajectory rollout, model predictive control, social cost, uncertainty-aware planning, and learned local policy.
자원 공개는 DOI가 확인되지만 논문 전용 공식 코드나 dataset p: Although the DOI was confirmed for resource disclosure, the official code or dataset page dedicated to the paper was not confirmed.
Gazebo 논문은 물리, 센서, 다중 로봇, middleware 연동을: The Gazebo paper presents an open-source simulator with physics, sensors, multiple robots, and middleware integration to lower the repetition cost of robot system experiments.
로봇 알고리즘은 실제 하드웨어 실험이 비싸고 위험하기 때문에 반복 가능한: For robot algorithms, a repeatable simulation environment is essential because actual hardware experiments are expensive and risky.
논문은 다중 로봇, 센서 모델, 물리 엔진, control interfa: The paper addresses the problem of designing and using an open-source simulator with multiple robots, sensor models, physics engine, and control interface.
기존 simulator는 특정 로봇이나 2D 환경에 묶이거나 physic: Existing simulators were often tied to specific robots or 2D environments or lacked physics realism and software integration.
목표는 realistic 3D multi-robot simulation을: The goal is to provide realistic 3D multi-robot simulation and create a reusable robotics simulator that is linked to the Player/Stage ecosystem.
방법은 3D graphics, rigid-body physics, sen: The method integrates 3D graphics, rigid-body physics, sensor simulation, plugin-like model structure, and robot control interface.
핵심 아이디어는 로봇 소프트웨어가 실제 robot과 simulator를: The core idea is to reduce the conversion costs of development and testing by allowing the robot software to handle the actual robot and simulator with a similar interface.
검증은 여러 robot/sensor simulation example과: Verification is centered on explaining several robot/sensor simulation examples and use paradigms, and is more in the nature of a system demonstration rather than a single numerical benchmark.
결과는 Gazebo가 ROS 시대의 대표 simulator로 발전했고,: As a result, Gazebo developed into a representative simulator in the ROS era and became a pre-deployment testbed for numerous robotics algorithms.
비교 관점에서 Gazebo는 물리와 센서 simulation을 통합한 o: From a comparative perspective, Gazebo has the advantage of being an open-source that integrates physics and sensor simulation, but its high-fidelity contact and photorealism are different from professional simulators.
의의는 로봇 연구에서 simulation-first development: The significance is that it greatly increases the accessibility of simulation-first development, multi-robot experiment, and reproducible demo in robot research.
한계는 simulation-reality gap, sensor noise: The limitation is that simulation-reality gap, sensor noise modeling, contact fidelity, and large scene performance cannot replace actual hardware verification.
향후 과제는 ROS <strong>2</strong>, Ignition/: Future tasks include integration with ROS2, Ignition/Gazebo Sim, differentiable/photorealistic simulation, and dataset generation.
자원 공개는 Gazebo 공식 사이트와 공개 source ecosyste: Resource disclosure is confirmed through the Gazebo official site and open source ecosystem, and the thesis resource is the simulator itself.
McGeer의 Passive Dynamic Walking은 제어와 액추에: McGeer's Passive Dynamic Walking changed the perspective of biped locomotion by showing that stable walking is possible using only mechanical structure and gravity without control or actuation.
이족보행 로봇 연구는 오랫동안 강한 actuation과 자세 제어에 의존: Biped robot research has long relied on strong actuation and posture control, but it has been difficult to explain the energy efficiency of human walking.
논문은 경사면에서 중력과 다리의 자연 동역학만으로 보행 gait가 생성될: The paper addresses the problem of exploring whether walking gait can be created on a slope using only gravity and the natural dynamics of the legs.
기존 보행 제어는 모든 관절 궤적을 적극적으로 강제하는 접근이 많아 me: Existing gait control has many approaches that actively force all joint trajectories, failing to fully utilize the natural stability created by mechanical dynamics.
목표는 단순한 legged mechanism이 passive dynami: The goal is to demonstrate through models and experiments that a simple legged mechanism can exhibit stable walking through passive dynamics alone.
방법은 compass-gait 계열의 underactuated mecha: The method analyzes an underactuated mechanical model of the compass-gait series and observes the motion of an actual passive walker prototype.
핵심 아이디어는 보행을 토크로 만든 trajectory tracking: The key idea is to view walking as a limit cycle phenomenon created by morphology and gravity, rather than a trajectory tracking problem created by torque.
검증은 물리 prototype과 동역학 분석을 통해 이루어졌고, powe: Verification was conducted through physical prototypes and dynamics analysis, and was not an evaluation of a powered robot controller or large-scale benchmark.
결과는 경사면에서 자연스럽고 에너지 효율적인 gait가 나타남을 보여 이: The results showed that a natural and energy-efficient gait appeared on inclined surfaces, which later became the basis for the design of dynamic walking and legged robotics.
비교 관점에서 passive walker는 active biped보다 단: From a comparative perspective, passive walkers are simpler and more efficient than active bipeds, but their ability to respond to flat terrain, speed changes, and disturbances is limited.
의의는 robot locomotion에서 compliance, morph: The significance is that it strongly highlights the design philosophy of utilizing compliance, morphology, and natural dynamics in robot locomotion.

의의는 2D LiDAR SLAM의 실용적 baseline을 제공해 ROS: The significance is that it provides a practical baseline for 2D LiDAR SLAM, which has been used for a long time in ROS navigation and mobile robot education/research.

자원 공개는 DOI와 OpenSLAM GMapping page가 확인되며: Resource disclosure is confirmed through DOI and OpenSLAM GMapping page, and public implementation is widely used.
g2o는 SLAM과 bundle adjustment를 일반 graph o: g2o expressed SLAM and bundle adjustment as general graph optimization problems and provided a C++ framework that could solve them efficiently.
SLAM, pose graph optimization, bundle ad: SLAM, pose graph optimization, and bundle adjustment all share the sparse nonlinear least-squares problem expressed by variable nodes and constraint edges.
논문은 문제별 solver를 따로 만드는 대신 다양한 graph-base: The paper addresses the task of enabling various graph-based estimation problems to be solved in the same framework instead of creating separate solvers for each problem.
기존 구현은 특정 SLAM formulation이나 sensor에 묶여: Existing implementations were tied to specific SLAM formulations or sensors, making reuse, comparison, and expansion difficult, and sparse structure utilization was inconsistent.
목표는 arbitrary graph structure와 parameter: The goal is to provide a general graph optimization framework that supports arbitrary graph structures and parameter blocks.
방법은 vertex/edge abstraction, analytic/nu: The method combines vertex/edge abstraction, analytic/numeric Jacobian, Gauss-Newton and Levenberg-Marquardt, and sparse linear solver interface.
핵심 아이디어는 SLAM backend를 problem-independe: The core idea is to abstract the SLAM backend into a problem-independent hypergraph optimizer to flexibly optimize constraints created by the front-end.
검증은 pose graph SLAM, landmark SLAM, bund: Verification is performed with a software benchmark that compares runtime and accuracy in pose graph SLAM, landmark SLAM, and bundle adjustment examples.
결과는 여러 graph optimization 문제에서 효율적인 성능을: The results showed efficient performance in several graph optimization problems and were adopted as the backend of numerous SLAM systems such as ORB-SLAM.
비교 대상은 SBA, HOG-Man 등 당시 optimizer이며, g2: The targets of comparison are optimizers at the time such as SBA and HOG-Man, and g2o is particularly strong in versatility and extensibility.
의의는 SLAM 연구자가 backend solver를 직접 새로 만들 필: The significance is that it reduces the need for SLAM researchers to create a new backend solver and provides a common basis for graph SLAM experiments.
한계는 nonconvex problem의 local minima, rob: The limitation is that the local minima, robust kernel selection, front-end outlier, and scale problems of nonconvex problems cannot be solved with the optimizer framework alone.
향후 과제는 incremental optimization, distrib: Future tasks include combination of incremental optimization, distributed/parallel solving, differentiable optimization, and learned front-end.
자원 공개는 RainerKuemmerle/g2o GitHub와 논문 PD: Resource disclosure is confirmed through RainerKuemmerle/g2o GitHub and paper PDF, and public code is the core resource.
Kajita et al.은 ZMP preview control로 huma: Kajita et al. presented a representative formula for generating a stable bipedal walking pattern by generating a humanoid center-of-mass trajectory with ZMP preview control.
휴머노이드 로봇은 넘어지지 않으면서 원하는 발자국을 따라 걷기 위해 동역: Humanoid robots must create a dynamically stable walking pattern to walk along the desired footprint without falling.
논문은 예정된 ZMP trajectory를 만족하도록 center-of-: The paper addresses the problem of biped walking pattern generation, which generates center-of-mass motion to satisfy a predetermined ZMP trajectory.
기존 보행 생성은 heuristic tuning이나 단기 안정 조건에 의: Existing gait generation relies on heuristic tuning or short-term stability conditions, making it difficult to handle both smooth preview and trajectory optimality.
목표는 linear inverted pendulum model을 이용해: The goal is to design a preview controller that considers the future ZMP reference using a linear inverted pendulum model.
방법은 CoM dynamics를 선형 시스템으로 모델링하고 optimal: The method models CoM dynamics as a linear system and calculates a CoM trajectory that reduces ZMP error with optimal preview control.
핵심 아이디어는 현재 순간 안정성만 보지 않고 미래 ZMP referen: The core idea is to make the gait smoother by planning the CoM by looking ahead at the future ZMP reference rather than just looking at the present moment stability.
검증은 humanoid walking simulation과 HRP 계열: The verification is presented in the context of humanoid walking simulation and HRP series robot experiments and is linked to real bipedal walking control.
결과는 안정적인 forward walking pattern을 생성할 수: The results showed that a stable forward walking pattern could be generated, and it later became the standard method for humanoid gait generation.
비교 관점에서 preview control은 단순 inverted pen: From a comparative perspective, preview control is more practical than a simple inverted pendulum, but full-body dynamics and contact transition require separate control.
의의는 ASIMO/HRP 이후 세대의 ZMP 기반 humanoid wal: The significance is that it is a classic pattern generation method that widely influenced the ZMP-based humanoid walking controller of the generation following ASIMO/HRP.
한계는 ZMP 안정성에 초점을 둬 uneven terrain, push: Limitations focus on ZMP stability, so there are limitations on uneven terrain, push recovery, highly dynamic locomotion, and whole-body contact rich motion.
향후 과제는 MPC, capture point, whole-body co: Future tasks include combining MPC, capture point, whole-body control, terrain adaptation, and learning-based locomotion.
자원 공개는 DOI가 확인되지만 공식 코드나 dataset page는 확: For resource disclosure, the DOI is confirmed, but the official code or dataset page is not confirmed.
Mellinger and Kumar는 differential flatne: Mellinger and Kumar combined differential flatness and minimum-snap polynomial to make a quadrotor fly smoothly and aggressively along waypoints.
쿼드로터는 빠른 기동과 제한된 actuator margin 때문에 부드럽: Due to the fast maneuverability and limited actuator margin of quadrotors, smooth and dynamically feasible trajectory generation is important.
논문은 waypoint와 corridor constraints를 만족하면: The paper addresses the problem of generating and controlling a smooth trajectory that is easy for a quadrotor to follow while satisfying waypoint and corridor constraints.
기존 waypoint interpolation은 velocity, acc: The existing waypoint interpolation sometimes did not sufficiently reflect the continuity of velocity, acceleration, jerk, snap, and actuator feasibility.
목표는 quadrotor differential flatness를 활용해: The goal is to create a polynomial trajectory with a minimum snap objective using quadrotor differential flatness and follow it with a nonlinear controller.
방법은 flat output인 position/yaw의 piecewise: The method is to obtain the piecewise polynomial coefficients of position/yaw, which are flat outputs, through optimization, and calculate and control the thrust and attitude commands.
핵심 아이디어는 trajectory smoothness의 고차 미분인 s: The core idea is that quadrotor motor effort and tracking difficulty can be reduced by minimizing snap, which is a high-order derivative of trajectory smoothness.
검증은 실제 quadrotor flight experiment와 aggr: Verification is carried out through actual quadrotor flight experiments and aggressive maneuver demonstrations and has a strong hardware experiment nature.
결과는 빠른 waypoint flight와 precise trajecto: The results showed fast waypoint flight and precise trajectory tracking, which later became the standard baseline for aerial robotics planning/control.
비교 관점에서 이 방법은 heuristic waypoint trackin: From a comparative perspective, this method is smoother and more feasible than heuristic waypoint tracking, but does not directly address obstacle-rich replanning and perception uncertainty.
의의는 quadrotor trajectory planning을 optim: The significance is that it organized quadrotor trajectory planning into an optimization-friendly polynomial problem and opened the minimum-snap planner series.
한계는 모델 파라미터, wind/disturbance, actuator: Limitations include robustness to model parameters, wind/disturbance, actuator saturation, and dynamic obstacles that depend on separate controllers and replanning.
향후 과제는 safe corridor planning, online re: Future tasks include safe corridor planning, online replanning, MPC, multi-agent collision avoidance, and perception-aware trajectory generation.
자원 공개는 DOI가 확인되지만 논문 전용 공식 GitHub는 확인되지: The DOI is confirmed for resource disclosure, but the official GitHub dedicated to the paper is not confirmed.
이 글은 Mori의 Uncanny Valley 개념을 영어권 roboti: This article widely conveyed Mori's Uncanny Valley concept to the English-speaking robotics community and provided a socio-psychological reference point for humanoid robot design and HRI evaluation.
사회적 로봇과 휴머노이드가 인간과 비슷해질수록 사용자의 정서 반응과 수용: As social robots and humanoids become more similar to humans, users' emotional responses and acceptance become key elements in their design.
논문은 인간 유사성이 높아질 때 affinity가 단조 증가하지 않고 특: The paper raises the issue that when human similarity increases, affinity does not increase monotonically but may drop sharply in a certain range.
기존 로봇 디자인 논의는 더 인간과 비슷할수록 더 좋다는 암묵적 가정을: Existing robot design discussions have often made the implicit assumption that the more human-like the better.
목표는 Mori의 원 개념을 전달하고 humanoid, prostheti: The goal is to convey Mori's original concepts and illustrate the perceptual risks that must be considered in humanoid, prosthetics, and social robot design.
방법은 실험 알고리즘이 아니라 conceptual curve와 예시를 통: The method presents the relationship between human likeness, motion, and familiarity through conceptual curves and examples, rather than an experimental algorithm.
핵심 아이디어는 거의 인간 같지만 미묘하게 어긋난 외형이나 움직임이 강한: The core idea is that although they are almost human, their appearance or movements that are subtly out of sync can cause strong discomfort and rejection.
검증은 원 글의 conceptual essay 성격이 강해 현대적 의미의: As the verification is strongly in the nature of a conceptual essay, it does not include controlled user studies or quantitative benchmarks in the modern sense.
결과는 정량 성능이 아니라 HRI와 로봇 디자인 담론에서 uncanny: The result is not quantitative performance, but rather the influence of spreading the concept of uncanny valley in HRI and robot design discourse.
비교 관점에서 이 글은 empirical HRI 논문보다 증거 수준은 낮: From a comparative perspective, this article has a lower level of evidence than the empirical HRI paper, but it provided the hypothesis for numerous subsequent user studies.
의의는 로봇의 기능 성능뿐 아니라 perception, affect, a: The significance is that not only the functional performance of the robot but also perception, affect, and aesthetics influence acceptance, making it a research agenda.
한계는 문화권, 개인차, task context, motion quali: The limitation is that it does not quantitatively separate variations according to culture, individual differences, task context, and motion quality.
향후 과제는 controlled experiment, cross-cult: Future tasks include controlled experiments, cross-cultural studies, motion realism, and design guidelines for each robot role.
자원 공개는 DOI와 번역/해설 글이 확인되지만 코드, dataset,: Resource disclosure confirms DOI and translation/explanation, but is not related to code, dataset, or project page.
PoseCNN은 RGB 이미지에서 object segmentation,: PoseCNN is a representative deep learning method that estimates the 6D object pose of a cluttered scene by combining object segmentation, center voting, and rotation regression in RGB images.
로봇 조작은 cluttered scene에서 특정 object의 6D p: Robot manipulation requires knowledge of the 6D pose of a specific object in a cluttered scene to perform grasping, placement, and manipulation planning.
논문은 RGB 또는 RGB-D 장면에서 known object insta: The paper addresses the 6D pose estimation problem of estimating the 3D translation and rotation of a known object instance in an RGB or RGB-D scene.
기존 feature matching이나 template 기반 방법은 te: Existing feature matching or template-based methods are weak in textureless objects, occlusion, and clutter, and end-to-end learning-based pose estimation is not yet mature.
목표는 CNN을 이용해 semantic label, object cent: The goal is to create a pipeline that can estimate semantic label, object center, and quaternion rotation using CNN and refine it with ICP.
방법은 fully convolutional network가 pixel-w: The method is a fully convolutional network predicts pixel-wise label and center direction, obtains the center through Hough voting, and then regresses the rotation.
핵심 아이디어는 translation을 direct regression: The core idea is to obtain translation robustly through pixel voting instead of direct regression, and learn rotation by considering the symmetry of each object.
검증은 YCB-Video dataset과 real cluttered sc: Verification is evaluated using ADD/ADD-S metrics on the YCB-Video dataset and real cluttered scenes, and offline dataset and real scene evaluation are combined.
결과는 당시 6D pose baseline보다 강한 성능을 보였고, YC: The results showed stronger performance than the 6D pose baseline at the time, and the YCB-Video dataset became a key benchmark for subsequent pose estimation studies.
비교 대상은 LINEMOD류 method와 learning-based p: The comparison targets are LINEMOD-type methods and learning-based pose estimators, and PoseCNN's strength is its combination of RGB-based coarse pose and depth ICP refinement.
의의는 robot manipulation용 6D pose estimati: The significance is that dataset, metric, and deep architecture are provided together in 6D pose estimation for robot manipulation.
한계는 known object assumption, CAD model 의: Limitations include known object assumptions, CAD model dependency, severe occlusion, transparent/reflective objects, and unseen category generalization.
향후 과제는 category-level pose, foundation v: Future tasks include combining category-level pose, foundation visual features, uncertainty, tracking, differentiable rendering, and active perception.
자원 공개는 project page와 yuxng/PoseCNN GitHu: Resource disclosure is confirmed on the project page and yuxng/PoseCNN GitHub, and YCB-Video related resources are also disclosed.
이 논문은 최대 14대 로봇으로 800,000회 이상 grasp atte: This paper collected more than 800,000 grasp attempts with up to 14 robots and learned monocular image-based grasp servoing through self-supervised learning.
로봇 grasping은 perception과 control이 밀접하게 결: Robot grasping is a problem in which perception and control are closely combined, so it is difficult to grasp various objects with only human-designed features and calibration.
논문은 monocular camera image와 후보 gripper m: The paper solves the problem of predicting the grasp success probability by receiving a monocular camera image and a candidate gripper motion command as input and using them for real-time servicing.
기존 grasp learning은 데이터 규모가 작거나 synthetic: Existing grasp learning had small data scale or relied on synthetic models, making it weak against changes in actual novel objects and camera-robot geometry.
목표는 대규모 실제 로봇 self-supervision으로 hand-ey: The goal is to create a grasp controller that is less dependent on calibration by learning hand-eye coordination with large-scale real-world robot self-supervision.
방법은 여러 로봇이 수집한 grasp trial의 success/fail: The method uses success/failure of grasp trials collected by several robots as a learning signal, and CNN predicts success probability from image and motion commands.
핵심 아이디어는 정책을 직접 imitation하지 않고 grasp out: The core idea is to move the gripper in a closed-loop using the outcome predictor as a learned servo objective without imitating the policy directly.
검증은 실제 robot fleet에서 수집한 데이터와 novel obje: Verification is conducted through data collected from an actual robot fleet and novel object grasping experiments, and focuses on evaluating actual hardware.
결과는 약 <strong>800,000회</strong> 이상 grasp: The results showed strong real-time control in novel object grasping through more than 800,000 grasp attempts and parallel collection of 6-14 robots.
비교 대상은 prior self-supervised grasping과 s: The comparison targets are prior self-supervised grasping and synthetic grasp dataset-based methods, and their strengths are data size and closed-loop correction compared to the baseline.
의의는 대규모 robot data collection이 visuomoto: The significance is that it shows that large-scale robot data collection enables visuomotor skill learning, becoming a precursor to RT-X type large-scale robot data flow.
한계는 bin-picking setup과 gripper/task 형태에: Limitations are tied to the bin-picking setup and gripper/task format, the data collection cost is very high, and it does not address long-horizon manipulation or semantic instruction.
향후 과제는 multi-task dataset, language-cond: Future tasks include multi-task dataset, language-conditioned grasping, data-efficient learning, offline RL, and cross-embodiment transfer.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 IJRR page, brainrobotdata: Resource disclosures include arXiv, IJRR page, and brainrobotdata dataset page, but it has not been clearly confirmed whether the code is public.
Honda humanoid robot 논문은 P2 계열의 기계 구조, 안: The Honda humanoid robot paper revealed the P2 series mechanical structure, stable gait control, stair walking, and remote control functions, becoming a symbolic milestone in humanoid development.
1990년대 휴머노이드 연구는 인간 생활환경에서 움직일 수 있는 전신 로: In the 1990s, humanoid research needed to integrate kinematics, gait, and balance control of full-body robots capable of moving in human living environments.
논문은 Honda humanoid robot의 mechanism, sys: The paper addresses system development issues that explain the mechanism, system configuration, walking control, and integrated function of the Honda humanoid robot.
기존 이족보행 로봇은 제한된 평지 보행이나 실험실 데모에 머무르는 경우가: Existing bipedal robots often limited to walking on level ground or in laboratory demonstrations and lacked integrated functions including stairs and direction changes.
목표는 인간형 로봇이 전후좌우, 대각선 이동, 방향 전환, 계단 보행,: The goal is to show that a humanoid robot can move back and forth, diagonally, change direction, walk up stairs, and perform simple tasks.
방법은 humanoid hardware platform, posture: The method integrates humanoid hardware platform, posture stability control, biped walking algorithm, path following, and wireless teleoperation functions.
핵심 아이디어는 개별 보행 알고리즘보다 전신 기구와 안정 제어를 결합해: The core idea is to demonstrate real humanoid locomotion functions at the system level by combining full-body mechanisms and stability control rather than individual gait algorithms.
검증은 Honda humanoid robot의 실제 동작 시연과 기능 설: The verification is in the nature of a hardware system thesis consisting of actual operation demonstration and functional explanation of the Honda humanoid robot.
결과는 uneven ground와 stair walking까지 포함한 안: The results reported stable movement, including uneven ground and stair walking, and the possibility of simple autonomous/teleoperated operation.
비교 관점에서 수치 benchmark보다 engineering miles: From a comparison perspective, it is more of an engineering milestone than a numerical benchmark, so it is difficult to directly compare metrics with modern learning-based locomotion.
의의는 ASIMO로 이어지는 humanoid robotics의 대중적·기: The significance is that it created a popular and technical reference point for humanoid robotics leading to ASIMO and demonstrated the possibility of developing full-body mobile robots.
한계는 폐쇄형 상용/연구 시스템이라 상세 제어 구현과 재현 가능한 cod: Limitations are that it is a closed commercial/research system, so detailed control implementation and reproducible code/data are not disclosed, and task autonomy is limited.
향후 과제는 더 동적인 보행, push recovery, manipula: Future challenges lead to more dynamic walking, push recovery, manipulation integration, perception-driven autonomy, and human interaction.
자원 공개는 DOI와 Honda R&amp;D research insig: Resource disclosure is confirmed through DOI and Honda R&D research insight page, but no official code or dataset has been released.
OpenAI의 dexterous manipulation 논문은 domai: OpenAI's dexterous manipulation paper transferred the RL policy and vision pose estimator learned from domain-randomized simulation to the actual Shadow Dexterous Hand.
인간 손처럼 복잡한 다지 로봇 손을 제어하는 것은 high-dimensi: Controlling a robot hand as complex as a human hand is a long-standing challenge due to high-dimensional contact dynamics and perception uncertainty.
논문은 Shadow Dexterous Hand가 object를 손 안에서: The paper addresses the problem of Shadow Dexterous Hand learning a vision-based closed-loop policy to reorient objects to the desired orientation in the hand.
기존 조작 제어는 단순 gripper나 강한 모델 가정에 의존했고, 실제: Existing manipulative controls relied on simple grippers or strong model assumptions, and it was difficult to generalize contact-rich manipulation of real multi-hands to hand-designed controllers.
목표는 human demonstration 없이 simulation RL: The goal is to learn the policy using only simulation RL without human demonstration and transfer it to the actual robot through domain randomization.
방법은 randomized physics/appearance simula: The method learns the recurrent policy in randomized physics/appearance simulation using RL, and a separate CNN pose estimator estimates the object pose from the camera image.
핵심 아이디어는 massive randomized simulation과: The core idea is a sim-to-real strategy that makes the policy withstand real system errors through massive randomized simulation and distributed RL.
검증은 실제 Shadow Dexterous Hand와 cube reori: Verification is performed on the actual Shadow Dexterous Hand and cube reorientation tasks, and the key is real robot deployment after simulation training.
결과는 physical hand에서 finger gaiting, mult: The results reported that complex behaviors such as finger gaiting, multi-finger coordination, and gravity use emerged emergently in the physical hand.
비교 관점에서 baseline은 전통 제어보다 learning-based: From a comparative perspective, the baseline is closer to learning-based sim-to-real feasibility proof than traditional control, and the scale of computing and system engineering is very large.
의의는 deep RL이 실제 dexterous manipulation에: The significance is that it strongly demonstrates that deep RL can achieve actual dexterous manipulation, making it a symbolic milestone for robot learning.
한계는 단일 object/task 중심, motion-capture나 p: Limitations remain as single object/task focus, dependence on motion-capture or pose estimator, enormous simulation computation, and limited generalization.
향후 과제는 다양한 물체, tactile sensing, real-wor: Future tasks include various objects, tactile sensing, real-world fine-tuning, data-efficient RL, and foundation manipulation policy.
자원 공개는 IJRR/OpenAI article과 video가 확인되지만: IJRR/OpenAI articles and videos have been confirmed to be resource disclosures, but official disclosure of the entire training code and dataset has not been confirmed.
SVO는 sparse feature와 direct image alignm: SVO combines sparse features and direct image alignment to enable fast monocular visual odometry even with MAV-class computational resources.
소형 드론과 모바일 로봇은 가벼운 camera로 빠르게 self-moti: Small drones and mobile robots need to quickly estimate self-motion using lightweight cameras, but onboard computing is limited.
논문은 monocular image stream에서 camera moti: The paper addresses the visual odometry problem of quickly estimating camera motion in a monocular image stream.
기존 feature-based VO는 feature extraction/: Existing feature-based VO has high feature extraction/matching costs, and direct methods may have difficulty managing tracking stability and mapping structure.
목표는 feature-based와 direct method의 장점을 결합: The goal is to create an accurate and very fast semi-direct VO by combining the advantages of feature-based and direct methods.
방법은 sparse map point를 유지하고, image alignm: The method maintains sparse map points, estimates pose using image alignment, and then updates the map using feature alignment and depth filter.
핵심 아이디어는 descriptor matching을 줄이고 photom: The core idea is to balance speed and accuracy by reducing descriptor matching and applying photometric alignment to sparse feature positions.
검증은 MAV와 camera dataset에서 trajectory est: Verification evaluates trajectory estimation on MAV and camera datasets and includes experiments with actual flight applications in mind.
결과는 높은 frame rate에서 competitive한 accurac: The results showed competitive accuracy at high frame rates and were widely used as an onboard visual odometry baseline.
비교 대상은 PTAM류 feature-based SLAM과 direct: The objects of comparison are PTAM-type feature-based SLAM and direct VO, and since SVO is odometry without loop closure, long-term drift must be processed separately.
의의는 low-latency visual odometry가 필요한 aer: The significance is that it spreads the semi-direct paradigm in aerial robotics, which requires low-latency visual odometry.
한계는 photometric consistency, exposure ch: Limitations may include vulnerability to photometric consistency, exposure change, blur, lack of texture, and lack of loop closure.
향후 과제는 IMU fusion, relocalization, loop: Future tasks include IMU fusion, relocalization, loop closure, rolling shutter handling, and combination with event cameras.
자원 공개는 DOI와 uzh-rpg/rpg_svo GitHub가 확인되며: For resource disclosure, DOI and uzh-rpg/rpg_svo GitHub are confirmed, and there is public code.
Moravec and Elfes의 sonar mapping 논문은 wid: Moravec and Elfes' sonar mapping paper presented the core concept of early grid mapping by stochastically accumulating wide-angle sonar cones into an occupancy grid.
초기 모바일 로봇은 저가 sonar 센서로 주변 구조를 추정해야 했고,: Early mobile robots needed to estimate surrounding structures using low-cost sonar sensors and needed a way to incorporate uncertain range readings into maps.
