Driving in the Matrix는 가상 세계에서 자동 생성한 주석: Driving in the Matrix is a synthetic-to-real paper that tested whether annotation data automatically generated in the virtual world can reduce the annotation burden of actual driving recognition learning.
딥러닝 기반 자율주행 perception은 대규모 human annota: Deep learning-based autonomous driving perception relies on large-scale human annotations, but the cost of densely labeling road scenes limits the speed of research.
논문은 virtual world에서 생성한 이미지와 pixel-level: The paper asks whether images and pixel-level annotations generated in the virtual world can replace or supplement learning for real-world tasks such as real-world object classification and detection.
기존 실제 데이터셋은 정확하지만 비싸고, 순수 synthetic data: Existing real-world datasets are accurate but expensive, and pure synthetic data has uncertain generalization to real-world scenes due to appearance gap and simulator bias.
목표는 synthetic driving data를 대량 생성하고 real: The goal is to generate large quantities of synthetic driving data and quantitatively evaluate the practical value of virtual labels compared to learning from real data.
방법은 game/simulation world에서 PASCAL VOC 형: The method automatically collects images, annotations, and segmentations in PASCAL VOC format from the game/simulation world and inputs them into real-world classifier learning.
핵심 아이디어는 인간이 그린 label을 simulator의 perfec: The core idea is to replace human-drawn labels with the simulator's perfect annotation to increase data size and label diversity, and then measure the actual cost of the domain gap.
검증은 synthetic set 크기별 학습, real data와 syn: Verification was performed with an offline vision benchmark, including learning by synthetic set size, combination of real data and synthetic data, and evaluation of real road object recognition.
결과는 synthetic data만으로도 실제 객체를 어느 정도 학습할: The results showed that real objects can be learned to some extent with synthetic data alone, and that annotation efficiency can be improved when combined with real data.
비교는 human-annotated real dataset 학습과 syn: The comparison compares human-annotated real dataset training with synthetic-only or mixed training, but does not include the latest domain randomization or foundation model baseline.
의의는 자율주행 시뮬레이터 데이터가 단순 시각화가 아니라 실제 perce: The significance is that it shows that autonomous driving simulator data can function as an actual perception training resource rather than a simple visualization, stimulating subsequent sim-to-real research.
한계는 virtual world의 asset, 조명, 카메라 모델, tr: The limitation is that the virtual world's assets, lighting, camera models, and traffic distribution do not fully represent the real long-tail driving scene.
향후 과제는 photorealistic simulation, domain: Future tasks include photorealistic simulation, domain adaptation, sensor-level simulation, safety-critical rare scenario coverage, and real-to-sim validation.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 FCAV project/dataset 안내를 확: We confirmed the arXiv and FCAV project/dataset instructions for resource disclosure, but the direct download status of the dataset/code could not be confirmed due to project page access restrictions in automatic requests.
ElasticFusion은 RGB-D frame을 surfel map과: ElasticFusion is a paper that performs dense real-time SLAM without a pose graph by integrating the RGB-D frame with a surfel map and a non-rigid deformation graph.
RGB-D 카메라가 보급되면서 실내 로봇과 AR은 sparse featu: As RGB-D cameras become widespread, indoor robots and AR require dense SLAM that even restores the surface in real time rather than sparse feature maps.
논문은 RGB-D stream에서 camera pose, dense su: The paper addresses the problem of simultaneously processing camera pose, dense surfel map, loop closure correction, and light source estimation in an RGB-D stream.
기존 dense SLAM은 pose graph나 keyframe stru: Existing dense SLAM relies on pose graph or keyframe structure or does not handle dense map deformation sufficiently naturally after loop closure.
목표는 global pose graph 없이도 실시간으로 일관된 dens: The goal is to maintain a consistent dense map in real time without a global pose graph and elastically correct accumulated drift when revisiting.
방법은 photometric-geometric dense tracking: The method combines photometric-geometric dense tracking, active/inactive surfel map, deformation graph, fern-based place recognition, and lighting estimation.
핵심 아이디어는 map 자체를 elastic surfel structur: The core idea is to view the map itself as an elastic surfel structure, and when loop closure comes in, it non-rigidly deforms and matches the dense surface rather than the trajectory.
검증은 TUM RGB-D benchmark와 실시간 indoor RGB-: For verification, trajectory error and map quality were evaluated in the TUM RGB-D benchmark and real-time indoor RGB-D reconstruction scenario.
결과는 GPU 기반으로 실시간 dense SLAM을 달성하고 당시 RGB: The results achieved real-time dense SLAM based on GPU and showed strong performance in drift correction and map consistency compared to the RGB-D SLAM baseline at the time.
비교는 KinectFusion, Kintinuous, DVO-SLAM 등: The comparison focuses on dense RGB-D series such as KinectFusion, Kintinuous, and DVO-SLAM, and comparison with semantic or dynamic scene SLAM is outside the scope of the paper.
의의는 dense surfel mapping, loop closure d: The significance is that it has created a reference point for real-time RGB-D scene reconstruction research through dense surfel mapping, loop closure deformation, and open-source implementation.
한계는 RGB-D range, static scene 가정, GPU 의존: Limitations remain in the RGB-D range, static scene assumption, GPU dependency, and vulnerability to large lighting changes and dynamic objects.
향후 과제는 semantic mapping, dynamic object: Future tasks include connection with semantic mapping, dynamic object handling, long-term map maintenance, and neural implicit reconstruction.

Shimoga의 survey는 force closure, form clo: Shimoga's survey systematically organized classical robot synthesis algorithms focusing on force closure, form closure, dexterity, and grasp uncertainty.
로봇 조작에서 grasp는 물체를 안정적으로 잡고 힘을 전달하는 가장 기: In robot manipulation, grasp is the most basic physical contact problem of stably holding an object and transmitting force.
논문은 주어진 물체 형상과 접촉 모델에서 어떤 손가락 배치와 접촉력을 선: The paper organizes algorithms on which finger placement and contact force should be selected for a stable grasp given the object shape and contact model.
기존 연구는 force closure, form closure, fric: Existing research treated criteria such as force closure, form closure, friction cone, and dexterity with different mathematics, making it difficult to understand the entire topography.
목표는 grasp synthesis 연구를 문제 설정, contact m: The goal is to create a reference literature for subsequent research by classifying grasp synthesis research by problem setting, contact model, quality metric, and algorithmic approach.
방법은 analytic grasp planning, optimizatio: The method surveys literature related to analytic grasp planning, optimization, geometric reasoning, contact force feasibility, compliance, and uncertainty.
핵심 아이디어는 grasp 품질을 단일 직관이 아니라 closure, s: The core idea is to view grasp quality not as a single intuition, but as a multi-objective design problem where closure, stability, manipulability, and robustness conflict.
검증은 새로운 실험이 아니라 당시 grasp synthesis liter: Verification is not conducted through new experiments, but through comparison of theories, examples, and algorithm characteristics in the grasp synthesis literature at the time.
결과는 고전 grasp planning의 핵심 가정과 한계를 한 구조 안: The results tie the core assumptions and limitations of classical grasp planning into one structure and show what later data-driven grasping inherited and discarded.
비교는 논문 간 수치 benchmark가 아니라 접촉 모델과 optima: Because the comparison is not a numerical benchmark between papers but a conceptual comparison of the contact model and optimality criterion, the evaluation of experimental reproducibility is limited.
의의는 현대 deep grasping 논문에서도 여전히 쓰는 closur: The significance is that it clarifies the genealogy of the concepts of closure and grasp quality, which are still used in modern deep grasping papers.
한계는 실제 센서 노이즈, deformable objects, learn: The limitation is that it does little to handle real sensor noise, deformable objects, learning-based perception, and large-scale clutter grasping.
향후 과제는 analytic stability와 data-driven p: Future tasks are directed toward connecting analytic stability, data-driven perception, tactile feedback, and uncertainty-aware manipulation.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 survey 논문 특성상: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but code or dataset disclosure was not confirmed due to the nature of the survey paper.
이 논문은 DAVIS event camera의 events, frames: This paper is a dataset paper that created an event-based VO/SLAM benchmark by combining events, frames, IMU, and motion-capture ground truth of the DAVIS event camera.
Event camera는 높은 시간 해상도와 HDR 특성으로 빠른 로봇: Event cameras are advantageous for fast robot movements due to their high temporal resolution and HDR characteristics, but they lack standard datasets and ground truth.
논문은 pose estimation, visual odometry, SL: The paper addresses the problem of providing synchronized benchmark data and a simulator that can evaluate pose estimation, visual odometry, and SLAM algorithms on an event stream.
기존 event-based vision 연구는 작은 장면이나 장비별 데이: Existing event-based vision research relied on small scenes or equipment-specific data, making comparison and reproduction between algorithms difficult.
목표는 event, grayscale frame, IMU, calibra: The goal is to create a common evaluation basis for event-based robotics research by providing event, grayscale frame, IMU, calibration, and trajectory ground truth together.
방법은 DAVIS sensor로 다양한 실내외 및 고속 motion se: The method records various indoor and outdoor and high-speed motion sequences with a DAVIS sensor and provides motion capture, precise trajectory reference and simulator.
핵심 아이디어는 asynchronous event stream만 따로 두: The core idea is to expose the frame and IMU together rather than leaving only the asynchronous event stream, allowing frame-based, event-based, and visual-inertial methods to be compared under the same conditions.
검증은 dataset 자체의 sensor synchronization,: Verification is presented in terms of sensor synchronization, calibration, and ground-truth trajectory quality of the dataset itself and representative VO/SLAM usage scenarios.
결과는 event-based pose estimation과 SLAM 연구: The results create a standard benchmark repeatedly used in event-based pose estimation and SLAM research, enabling the evaluation of fast motion and HDR scenes.
비교는 기존 frame-camera dataset과 달리 event st: The comparison has a big difference in that it includes an event stream, unlike the existing frame-camera dataset, but since it is a dataset paper, it is not focused on a single algorithm SOTA competition.
의의는 이후 event camera SLAM, optical flow,: The significance is that it provides a common experimental language for future event camera SLAM, optical flow, feature tracking, and VIO research.
한계는 특정 DAVIS 해상도와 장면 구성에 묶이고, 아주 다양한 wea: The limitation is that it is tied to a specific DAVIS resolution and scene composition, and cannot cover a wide variety of weather, deformation, and large-scale driving conditions.
향후 과제는 고해상도 event sensor, multi-camera/e: Future tasks include expansion of high-resolution event sensor, multi-camera/event-inertial dataset, long-term outdoor sequence, and task-level robot benchmark.

FAB-MAP 2.0은 visual appearance만으로 대규모 lo: FAB-MAP 2.0 is a probabilistic SLAM paper expanded to perform large-scale loop closure and place recognition based only on visual appearance.
장기 주행 로봇은 geometry만으로 누적 오차를 해결하기 어렵기 때문: Because it is difficult to solve accumulated errors in long-term driving robots with geometry alone, it is important to be able to recognize places that have already been seen based on their appearance.
논문은 대규모 환경에서 현재 관측 이미지가 이전 장소인지 새 장소인지 a: The paper addresses the problem of probabilistically determining whether the current observation image is an old location or a new location based on appearance alone in a large-scale environment.
기존 bag-of-words place recognition은 perce: Existing bag-of-words place recognition underestimates perceptual aliasing and word correlation, which can lead to increased false loop closure in large-scale environments.
목표는 FAB-MAP의 probabilistic appearance mo: The goal is to extend FAB-MAP's probabilistic appearance model to larger datasets and real-time operation, enabling robust loop closure.
방법은 visual vocabulary, Chow-Liu tree 기반: The method uses visual vocabulary, Chow-Liu tree-based feature dependency model, likelihood calculation, and online place recognition structure.
핵심 아이디어는 단어 존재 여부를 독립으로 보지 않고 appearance: The core idea is to calculate the posterior of confusing places more conservatively by modeling the correlation between appearance words rather than considering the presence or absence of words as independent.
검증은 대규모 주행 image sequence에서 loop closure: Verification is performed with offline SLAM/place recognition experiments that evaluate loop closure precision-recall and scalability on large-scale driving image sequences.
결과는 appearance-only 방식으로도 큰 환경에서 낮은 fals: The results showed that even the appearance-only method can find loop closure candidates while maintaining low false positives in a large environment.
비교는 naive bag-of-words와 초기 FAB-MAP 계열이 중: The comparison focuses on naive bag-of-words and the early FAB-MAP series, and does not include deep visual descriptors or learned global retrieval baselines over time.
의의는 visual place recognition을 SLAM backe: The significance is that visual place recognition was established as a probabilistic loop closure sensor connected to the SLAM backend.
한계는 geometry verification 없이는 viewpoint·: The limitation is that without geometry verification, ambiguity still remains in viewpoint·season·illumination changes and repetitive structures.
향후 과제는 metric verification, sequence-bas: Future tasks include combining metric verification, sequence-based matching, learned descriptor, and lifelong map management.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex와 open-access record는: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex and open-access record, but the official code repository dedicated to the paper was not confirmed.
SLAMMOT은 정적 지도 작성과 움직이는 객체 추적을 함께 풀어 동적: SLAMMOT is a paper that extends mobile robot perception in a dynamic environment by solving static mapping and moving object tracking together.
실제 도로와 실내 환경에는 사람과 차량처럼 움직이는 객체가 많아 정적 세: In real roads and indoor environments, there are many moving objects such as people and vehicles, so SLAM alone, which assumes a static world, cannot sufficiently explain the robot's surroundings.
논문은 로봇 위치와 정적 map을 추정하면서 동시에 moving obje: The paper addresses the SLAMMOT problem, which tracks the state of a moving object while estimating the robot position and static map.
기존 SLAM은 움직이는 물체를 outlier로 버리기 쉽고, 기존 tr: Existing SLAM easily discards moving objects as outliers, and existing tracking often assumes ego-motion and map uncertainty as separate inputs.
목표는 mapping과 moving object tracking이 서로의: The goal is to create an integrated probabilistic framework in which mapping and moving object tracking share each other's uncertainties.
방법은 sensor measurements를 static landmark: The method divides sensor measurements into static landmarks and moving objects and updates the robot, map, and moving target states together through Bayesian filtering series estimation.
핵심 아이디어는 동적 객체를 SLAM의 방해물이 아니라 추정해야 할 별도: The key idea is to model static structures and dynamic actors simultaneously by raising dynamic objects as separate states that need to be estimated rather than as an obstacle to SLAM.
검증은 laser 기반 mobile robot dataset과 동적 환경: Verification was performed by evaluating localization, mapping, and object tracking performance in a laser-based mobile robot dataset and dynamic environment scenarios.
결과는 moving object를 명시적으로 추적하면 정적 map 품질과: The results showed that explicitly tracking moving objects can improve both static map quality and dynamic object state estimation.
비교는 moving object를 무시하거나 제거하는 SLAM 관점과 독: The comparison is based on a SLAM perspective that ignores or removes moving objects and an independent tracking method, but is not a large-scale comparison at the level of modern multi-object tracking benchmarks.
의의는 dynamic SLAM, DATMO, autonomous driv: The significance is that it clearly presents the initial problem definition of dynamic SLAM, DATMO, and autonomous driving perception.
한계는 객체 검출과 data association이 어려운 clutter: Its limitations are that it is weak in cluttered scenes where object detection and data association are difficult, and semantic classes and long-term interaction modeling are limited.
향후 과제는 learning-based detection, semanti: Future tasks include integration with learning-based detection, semantic dynamic mapping, multi-sensor tracking, and prediction-aware planning.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex와 open-access copy는 확: For resource disclosure, DOI/OpenAlex and open-access copy were confirmed, but official code/dataset links were not confirmed.
V-LOAM은 camera 기반 motion estimate와 LiDAR: V-LOAM is a visual-lidar SLAM paper that achieves low drift and fast outdoor odometry by combining camera-based motion estimate and LiDAR mapping.
자율주행과 야외 로봇은 빠른 ego-motion과 정확한 3D map을: Autonomous driving and outdoor robots require both fast ego-motion and accurate 3D maps, but cameras and LiDAR each have different strengths and weaknesses.
논문은 visual odometry의 빠른 frame-rate 추정과 L: The paper addresses the problem of performing robust low-drift odometry and mapping by combining fast frame-rate estimation of visual odometry and LiDAR scan-to-map registration.
기존 VO는 scale drift와 texture 변화에 약하고 LiDA: Existing VO is weak against scale drift and texture changes, and LiDAR-only odometry can have rough motion estimates due to scan rate and lack of structure.
목표는 vision과 LiDAR를 느슨하게 결합해 실시간으로 동작하면서도: The goal is to loosely combine vision and LiDAR to create a system that operates in real time while reducing outdoor trajectory drift.
방법은 camera feature tracking으로 high-frequ: The method estimates high-frequency motion through camera feature tracking and performs low-frequency pose correction and map refinement through LiDAR edge/planar feature mapping.
핵심 아이디어는 vision을 빠른 odometry front-end로,: The core idea is to divide vision into a fast odometry front-end and LiDAR into a metric-scale drift correction and geometry map backend.
검증은 KITTI odometry와 outdoor vehicle data: Verification was performed with offline/field-style experiments evaluating trajectory error and mapping quality on KITTI odometry and outdoor vehicle datasets.
결과는 vision-only와 LiDAR-only 계열보다 낮은 drif: The results show lower drift and better real-time performance than the vision-only and LiDAR-only series, which became an important standard for subsequent LOAM series fusion research.
비교는 VO, LOAM류 LiDAR odometry, KITTI benc: The comparison focuses on VO, LOAM type LiDAR odometry, and KITTI benchmark methods, but the end-to-end learned fusion baseline is not included in time.
의의는 visual-lidar odometry가 자율주행 SLAM의 실용: The significance is that it strongly demonstrates that visual-lidar odometry can be a practical fusion architecture for autonomous driving SLAM.
한계는 camera-LiDAR calibration, feature-po: Limitations remain as long-term global consistency issues due to camera-LiDAR calibration, feature-poor scenes, dynamic objects, and lack of loop closure.
향후 과제는 tightly-coupled optimization, IMU: Future tasks include tightly-coupled optimization, IMU/GNSS fusion, loop closure, semantic/dynamic filtering, and open reproducible implementation.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인했으나 저자 공식 GitHub나: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but the author's official GitHub or dataset page was not confirmed.
이 논문은 unknown terrain에서 새 장애물 정보가 들어올 때: This paper is a study on incremental replanning, which quickly updates the route without resolving the entire route when new obstacle information comes in on unknown terrain.
야외 모바일 로봇은 지도를 완전히 모른 채 이동하며 새로 관측한 장애물과: Outdoor mobile robots move without complete map knowledge and must immediately reflect newly observed obstacles and cost changes in their plans.
논문은 unknown terrain navigation에서 센서가 갱신한: The paper addresses the problem of quickly re-planning the route to the goal using the cost map updated by the sensor in unknown terrain navigation.
기존 A*식 전역 재계획은 환경 정보가 조금 바뀔 때마다 많은 노드를 다: The existing A* type global replanning was inefficient for real-time driving because it recalculated many nodes every time the environmental information slightly changed.
목표는 이전 search 결과를 재사용해 map update 후에도 op: The goal is to provide a replanning algorithm that quickly updates the optimal or near-optimal path even after map update by reusing previous search results.
방법은 incremental heuristic search 계열의 그래프: The method efficiently processes only changed areas through incremental heuristic search series graph updating and priority queue-based cost propagation.
핵심 아이디어는 새 장애물 발견을 전체 문제 재시작으로 보지 않고 기존: The key idea is to locally repair the inconsistency of the existing shortest-path tree without viewing the discovery of a new obstacle as restarting the entire problem.
검증은 unknown grid/terrain navigation 시뮬레이: Verification was performed by comparing replanning time and path quality in an unknown grid/terrain navigation simulation and a robot driving situation.
결과는 반복적 전역 계획보다 훨씬 빠르게 경로를 갱신하면서 장애물 발견: The result was that the path was updated much faster than iterative global planning, enabling continuous navigation even after obstacle discovery.
비교는 A* 및 이전 dynamic replanning 알고리즘과의 효율: The comparison is centered on efficiency with A* and previous dynamic replanning algorithms, and there is no comparison with perception error or modern sampling planners.
의의는 D* 계열 재계획을 실제 terrain navigation에 실용: The significance is in solidifying the standard technique of field robot path planning by pragmatically connecting D* series replanning to actual terrain navigation.
한계는 grid/cost representation과 local trav: Limitations depend on grid/cost representation and local traversability estimates, and have limited coverage of dynamic obstacles, kinodynamic constraints, and continuous terrain geometry.
향후 과제는 3D terrain, robot dynamics, uncer: Future tasks include combining 3D terrain, robot dynamics, uncertainty-aware cost learning, and multi-robot replanning.

휴머노이드 로봇은 인간이 설계한 계단, 문, 공구, 작업 공간을 그대로: Humanoid robots were required to have human-like movement and manipulation abilities in order to use stairs, doors, tools, and work spaces designed by humans.

논문은 알려진 또는 추출된 landmarks를 이용해 robot posi: The paper addresses the problem of calculating robot position and orientation using known or extracted landmarks.
기존 odometry-only navigation은 주행 거리가 늘수록: Existing odometry-only navigation accumulates errors as the driving distance increases, and landmark-based methods have to systematically handle correspondence and geometric ambiguity.
목표는 landmark geometry를 이용해 mobile robot: The goal is to present an algorithm and conditions that stably perform mobile robot localization using landmark geometry.
방법은 관측 landmark의 위치 관계와 로봇 pose constrai: The method calculates possible poses using the positional relationship of observation landmarks and robot pose constraints and uses geometric reasoning to reduce ambiguity.
핵심 아이디어는 환경 landmark를 absolute reference: The key idea is to convert local sensor measurements into global pose constraints by using environmental landmarks as absolute references.
검증은 landmark configuration과 mobile robot: Verification was performed using experiments or examples that analyzed pose estimation accuracy in landmark configuration and mobile robot localization scenarios.
결과는 landmark-based localization이 odometr: The results showed that landmark-based localization can reduce odometry drift and stably recover the robot pose.
비교는 odometry-only와 단순 landmark matching: The comparison is centered on odometry-only and simple landmark matching approaches, and particle filters and graph localization baselines belong to future research.
의의는 landmark localization의 geometric fou: The significance is that it provided an geometric foundation for landmark localization and became an axis for later Monte Carlo localization and SLAM research.

향후 과제는 probabilistic data association, m: Future tasks include probabilistic data association, multi-sensor landmark extraction, map learning, and robust global localization.

Kilobot은 수백 대 이상 swarm experiment를 가능하게: Kilobot is a platform paper that proposes a low-cost small robot with a component cost of about $14 and a group control infrastructure to enable swarm experiments with hundreds or more units.
Swarm robotics는 많은 로봇의 집단 행동을 실험해야 하지만 개: Swarm robotics requires testing the collective behavior of many robots, but the cost of individual robots and the costs of charging, programming, and operating them have prevented scale-up.
논문은 큰 수의 로봇을 실제로 운용할 수 있는 low-cost scala: The paper addresses the problem of designing a low-cost scalable robot platform that can actually operate a large number of robots.
기존 swarm robot platform은 기능은 많지만 비싸거나, 저: The existing swarm robot platform has many functions, but is expensive or, at a low price, communication, programming, and power management are not convenient enough for large-scale experiments.
목표는 집단 행동 연구에 필요한 locomotion, local comm: The goal is to provide locomotion, local communication, sensing, and batch programming required for group behavior research at very low cost.
방법은 vibration-based locomotion, infrared: The method combines vibration-based locomotion, infrared communication/sensing, overhead programming/control support, and simple hardware architecture.
핵심 아이디어는 개별 로봇 성능을 최소화하더라도 집단 실험에 꼭 필요한: The core idea is to significantly increase the robot count by preserving functions essential for group experiments even if individual robot performance is minimized.
검증은 Kilobot hardware prototype과 다수 로봇 집단: Verification evaluated scalability and operability through the Kilobot hardware prototype and multiple robot group behavior demonstrations.

비교는 기존 small robot platform과 비용·scalabil: The comparison compares cost, scalability, and function trade-offs with existing small robot platforms, and prioritizes group operability over high performance and individual movement accuracy.
의의는 Kilobot이 swarm robotics의 표준 실험 platf: The significance is that Kilobot has become one of the standard experimental platforms for swarm robotics, lowering the entry barrier for collective behavior research.
한계는 이동 정확도, sensing richness, payload, c: Limitations include limited movement accuracy, sensing richness, payload, and computation power, making it unsuitable for complex manipulation or outdoor tasks.
향후 과제는 richer sensing, reliable localiza: Future tasks include richer sensing, reliable localization, automatic charging, heterogeneous swarm, and simulator-to-real collective control.

로봇 팔 성능은 단순히 특정 pose에서 움직일 수 있는지뿐 아니라 주어: The performance of a robot arm depends not only on whether it can move in a specific pose, but also on how well it can accelerate in which direction with a given torque.
논문은 manipulator dynamics를 고려해 end-effect: The paper addresses the problem of quantifying end-effector acceleration capability considering manipulator dynamics.
기존 kinematic manipulability는 Jacobian 기반: Existing kinematic manipulability only looked at Jacobian-based speed capability and did not reflect inertia, torque limit, and configuration-dependent dynamics.
목표는 로봇 자세별 동적 성능을 비교할 수 있는 dynamic manip: The goal is to present a dynamic manipulability measure and ellipsoid expression that can compare dynamic performance for each robot posture.
방법은 manipulator equation, mass matrix, t: The method derives a possible end-effector acceleration set using the manipulator equation, mass matrix, and torque constraint.
핵심 아이디어는 kinematic Jacobian의 속도 ellipsoi: The core idea is to extend the kinematic Jacobian's velocity ellipsoid to a dynamics-aware acceleration ellipsoid and use it as a control and design indicator.
검증은 대표 robot manipulator configuration에서: Verification was performed by calculating the dynamic manipulability ellipsoid in a representative robot manipulator configuration and analyzing performance changes by posture.
결과는 같은 kinematic reach 안에서도 inertia와 tor: The results showed that even within the same kinematic reach, the favorable acceleration direction varied greatly due to inertia and torque limit.
비교는 kinematic manipulability와의 개념적 대비가 중: The comparison is centered on a conceptual contrast with kinematic manipulability, and has a stronger index proposal nature than a task-level benchmark.
의의는 robot design, redundancy resolution,: The significance is that it is a key indicator that allows dynamic performance criteria to be considered in robot design, redundancy resolution, and motion planning.

향후 과제는 operational-space control, dynami: Future tasks include combining operational-space control, dynamic task allocation, contact-rich manipulation, and data-driven actuator modeling.

이 논문은 실제 로봇에 deep RL을 적용하며 얻은 sample eff: This paper is a robot learning survey/tutorial that summarizes practical lessons in sample efficiency, safety, sim-to-real, and reward design obtained by applying deep RL to real robots.
Deep RL은 로봇 제어와 조작에 큰 가능성을 보였지만 실제 로봇에서는: Deep RL has shown great potential in robot control and manipulation, but data cost, safety, reset, and hardware wear are critical limitations in real robots.
논문은 실제 로봇에서 deep reinforcement learning을: The paper addresses what design choices and pitfalls must be considered to successfully train deep reinforcement learning on real robots.
기존 RL 성공 사례는 simulation이나 게임에 집중되어 robot: Existing RL success cases were focused on simulation or games, making it easy to underestimate the problems of robot embodiment, sparse reward, exploration risk, and distribution shift.
목표는 저자들이 실제 로봇학습 연구에서 얻은 실용적 lesson을 정리해: The goal is to reduce trial and error in new robot RL research by summarizing the practical lessons the authors learned from actual robot learning research.
방법은 off-policy learning, replay, simulat: The method explains off-policy learning, replay, simulation pretraining, domain randomization, reward engineering, reset automation, and safety practice through case studies.
핵심 아이디어는 robot deep RL의 병목이 알고리즘 수식만이 아니: The core idea is that the bottleneck of robot deep RL is not just the algorithm formula, but the entire data pipeline, task setup, evaluation protocol, and engineering loop.
검증은 새로운 단일 benchmark보다 여러 manipulation과: Verification is a tutorial/survey method that synthesizes multiple manipulation and locomotion research experiences, open literature, and experimental cases rather than a new single benchmark.
결과는 실제 robot RL에서 sample efficiency와 rob: The results summarize that to obtain sample efficiency and robustness in actual robot RL, simulation, demonstrations, carefully shaped tasks, and scalable infrastructure must be used together.
비교는 다양한 RL family의 장단점 비교가 중심이며, 특정 알고리즘: The comparison focuses on comparing the pros and cons of various RL families, and is not aimed at competing for SOTA scores of specific algorithms.
의의는 robot learning 커뮤니티에 재현 가능한 실험 설계와 실: Its significance is that it provides the robot learning community with practical guidance on reproducible experimental design and failure modes.
한계는 빠르게 변하는 foundation model, offline RL: Limitations include the rapidly changing foundation model, offline RL, diffusion policy, and VLA research, which has expanded significantly since the paper, so some contents require updating.
향후 과제는 safe/offline RL, scalable real ro: Future tasks include safe/offline RL, scalable real robot data, foundation policy pretraining, evaluation standardization, and uncertainty-aware deployment.
자원 공개는 DOI와 arXiv는 확인되지만 논문 자체의 통합 code/: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI and arXiv, but the integrated code/dataset of the paper itself was not confirmed.
이 논문은 symbolic task planning과 continuous: This paper is a representative paper of TAMP, which hierarchically combines symbolic task planning and continuous motion planning to allow the robot to plan only what is currently needed.
로봇 manipulation은 high-level task sequenc: Robot manipulation must simultaneously consider high-level task sequence and low-level collision-free motion, so pure symbolic planning or motion planning is not enough.
논문은 현재 상태에서 필요한 task refinement와 motion: The paper addresses the task and motion planning problem that hierarchically connects the task refinement and motion feasibility required in the current state.
기존 task planner는 geometric feasibility를: It is easy for existing task planners to ignore geometric feasibility, and it is difficult for motion planners to understand long-term symbolic goals and object interaction structures.
목표는 계층적 계획 구조를 사용해 로봇이 먼 미래를 완전히 열거하지 않고: The goal is to use a hierarchical planning structure to allow the robot to start with decisions needed in the present and refine them into an executable plan, rather than completely enumerating the distant future.
방법은 abstract operator, geometric precond: The method combines abstract operators, geometric preconditions, motion planner calls, and hierarchical refinement to generate symbolic-geometric plans.
핵심 아이디어는 모든 세부 경로를 처음부터 고정하지 않고 plan ske: The key idea is to quickly remove infeasible branches while gradually refining the plan skeleton without fixing all the detailed paths from the beginning.
검증은 robot manipulation domain에서 pick-pla: Verification was performed through planning examples and computation behavior of pick-place and rearrangement tasks in the robot manipulation domain.
결과는 hierarchical task-motion integration: The results showed that hierarchical task-motion integration can find a feasible robot plan more practically than naive combined search.
비교는 독립 task planning 또는 flat geometric s: The comparison is centered on structural comparison with independent task planning or flat geometric search, and there is no large-scale comparison with the modern TAMP benchmark suite.
의의는 TAMP를 로봇 조작의 핵심 연구 분야로 굳히고 PR2 시대의 s: The significance is that it solidified TAMP as a core research field in robot manipulation and had a great influence on the symbolic-geometric planning trend of the PR2 era.
한계는 domain model 작성, geometric predicate: Limitations include limited domain model creation, geometric predicate engineering, uncertainty and perception failure handling, and learning integration.
향후 과제는 learned affordance, probabilistic: Future tasks include learned affordance, probabilistic belief planning, online replanning, language-conditioned TAMP, and benchmark standardization.
이 논문은 PUMA 560 robot arm의 명시적 동역학 모델과 관성: This paper provides a standard benchmark plant for control research by summarizing the explicit dynamics model and inertial parameters of the PUMA 560 robot arm.
1980년대 로봇 제어 연구는 실제 산업용 manipulator의 동역학: Robot control research in the 1980s required sharing the dynamics model of an actual industrial manipulator to compare computed torque control and identification.
논문은 PUMA 560 arm의 explicit dynamic equat: The paper deals with the problem of deriving and providing explicit dynamic equations and inertial parameters for the PUMA 560 arm.
기존 연구는 robot-specific parameter가 불명확하거나: Existing studies had unclear robot-specific parameters or used different models, making it difficult to compare and reproduce controller performance.
목표는 널리 쓰이는 PUMA 560에 대해 관절 질량·관성·중력·Cori: The goal is to present an explicit model including joint mass, inertia, gravity, and Coriolis terms for the widely used PUMA 560.
방법은 rigid-body dynamics, link parameter: The method constructs a manipulator equation through rigid-body dynamics, link parameter measurement/identification, and symbolic equation derivation.
핵심 아이디어는 실제 robot arm을 추상 6-DOF 예제가 아니라: The key idea is to make a real robot arm a reproducible dynamic benchmark with numerical parameters rather than an abstract 6-DOF example.
검증은 모델 구조와 parameter consistency, contro: Verification consists of presenting model structure, parameter consistency, and dynamic equations at a level applicable to controller research.
결과는 PUMA 560이 이후 수많은 robot control 논문에서: The results provided a foundation for PUMA 560 to be used as a common simulation target in numerous robot control papers in the future.
비교는 다른 robot model과의 성능 경쟁이 아니라 모델 명시성과: The key to comparison is not a performance competition with other robot models, but providing model clarity and reproducibility.
의의는 computed torque, adaptive control, r: Its significance is in establishing standard examples for research on computed torque, adaptive control, robust control, and trajectory planning.
한계는 rigid-body nominal model이라 friction,: The limitation is that it is a rigid-body nominal model, so it does not fully account for friction, backlash, actuator dynamics, and payload variation.
향후 과제는 friction/actuator identification,: Future tasks include friction/actuator identification, payload adaptation, data-driven residual modeling, and hardware validation benchmark expansion.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 원 parameter t: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but no separate code or dataset other than the original parameter table was confirmed.
이 논문은 inchworm locomotion을 모사한 self-defo: This paper is a study on a small mobile robot that designed a self-deformable capsule-like robot that simulates inchworm locomotion and verified it through modeling and experiments.
좁은 관로나 제한된 공간을 이동하는 로봇은 바퀴나 다리보다 몸체 변형을: For robots that move through narrow pipes or limited spaces, a crawling mechanism using body deformation may be more advantageous than wheels or legs.
논문은 inchworm처럼 몸을 늘이고 수축하며 전진하는 capsule-: The paper deals with the design, modeling, and controllability of a capsule-like robot that extends, contracts, and moves forward like an inchworm.
기존 capsule 또는 crawling robot은 구조가 복잡하거나: Existing capsules or crawling robots have complex structures or are tied to specific terrain, and lack locomotion efficiency and mechanical modeling verification.
목표는 self-deformable body mechanism을 설계하고: The goal is to design a self-deformable body mechanism and verify the locomotion principle through a motion model and prototype experiment.
방법은 capsule-like body, deformable/actuat: The method combines a capsule-like body, deformable/actuated mechanism, inchworm gait sequence, kinematic/dynamic model, and experimental validation.
핵심 아이디어는 다리나 바퀴 없이 몸체 shape change와 접촉 마: The core idea is to create forward movement using body shape change and asymmetry of contact friction without legs or wheels.
검증은 제작한 prototype의 locomotion 실험, 모델 예측과: Verification was conducted through locomotion experiments of the produced prototype, comparison of model predictions with actual moving distance and speed, and analysis of gait parameter changes.
결과는 제안 mechanism이 inchworm-inspired self: The results showed that the proposed mechanism can produce real forward movement through inchworm-inspired self-deformation.

의의는 pipe inspection, biomedical capsule,: The significance is that it provides a simple self-deforming locomotion design example applicable to pipe inspection, biomedical capsule, and confined-space robots.
한계는 특정 표면 마찰과 직선 이동 조건에 민감하고 sensing, st: Limitations are sensitive to specific surface friction and linear motion conditions, and sensing, steering, and long-term power autonomy have not been fully verified.
향후 과제는 steering mechanism, terrain adapt: Future tasks include steering mechanism, terrain adaptation, onboard sensing, miniaturization, and closed-loop control.

로봇이 clutter 속 novel object를 잡으려면 object: For a robot to grasp a novel object in a clutter, it must find an actually feasible pose in the 3D grasp point cloud without an object model.

검증은 point cloud dataset 평가와 실제 robot gra: Verification was performed on novel objects and cluttered scenes in a point cloud dataset evaluation and an actual robot grasping experiment.

향후 과제는 multi-finger grasp, active view s: Future tasks include combining multi-finger grasp, active view selection, tactile refinement, dense clutter rearrangement, and foundation grasp prior.

이 논문은 3D LiDAR point cloud를 FCN이 처리할 수 있: This paper is an early deep LiDAR detection study that performed vehicle detection by converting the 3D LiDAR point cloud into a representation that FCN can process.
자율주행 perception에서 차량 검출은 camera보다 조명에 강한: In autonomous driving perception, vehicle detection can obtain distance and size more directly by using 3D LiDAR geometry, which is more resistant to lighting than a camera.
논문은 raw 3D LiDAR point cloud에서 vehicle o: The paper addresses the problem of detecting vehicle objects in a raw 3D LiDAR point cloud using a deep fully convolutional network.
기존 LiDAR detection은 hand-crafted cluster: Existing LiDAR detection relies on hand-crafted clustering and feature engineering and is weak against complex sparsity and occlusion changes at different distances.
목표는 LiDAR data를 CNN-friendly representat: The goal is to create a close to end-to-end vehicle detection pipeline by converting LiDAR data into CNN-friendly representation.
방법은 point cloud를 bird's-eye-view 또는 rang: The method encodes the point cloud into a bird's-eye-view or range-style grid feature, and FCN densely predicts objectness and bounding information.
핵심 아이디어는 3D point set을 직접 다루기보다 공간 구조를 보: The core idea is to take advantage of the powerful convolutional architecture at the time by projecting it into a 2D tensor that preserves the spatial structure rather than directly handling the 3D point set.
검증은 KITTI vehicle detection benchmark류 o: Verification was conducted as an offline experiment evaluating detection accuracy on the KITTI vehicle detection benchmark outdoor driving dataset.

비교는 전통적 LiDAR feature pipeline과 초기 deep: The comparison focuses on the traditional LiDAR feature pipeline and the initial deep model, and does not include subsequent strong baselines such as PointPillars, SECOND, and transformer detectors.
의의는 modern 3D object detection이 point cl: The significance is that modern 3D object detection is an early example of the flow of learning point clouds with BEV/range representation.
한계는 vehicle class 중심이며 multi-class detec: Limitations are centered around vehicle class, and multi-class detection, small object, temporal fusion, and sensor calibration uncertainty are limitedly addressed.
향후 과제는 voxel/point hybrid networks, mult: Future tasks include voxel/point hybrid networks, multi-sensor fusion, temporal tracking, and uncertainty-aware detection.
자원 공개는 RSS DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 공식 code나: Resource disclosure was confirmed through RSS DOI/OpenAlex, but the official code or dataset page was not confirmed.
이 tutorial은 VO/VIO trajectory 평가에서 align: This tutorial organized basic metrics such as alignment, ATE, RPE, scale, and timestamp processing in VO/VIO trajectory evaluation and provided a toolbox.
Visual odometry와 visual-inertial odometr: Visual odometry and visual-inertial odometry studies may yield different conclusions depending on alignment and metric selection even if the same trajectory is evaluated.
논문은 VO/VIO 알고리즘의 estimated trajectory를 g: The paper addresses the problem of systematically explaining how to quantitatively compare the estimated trajectory of the VO/VIO algorithm with the ground truth.
기존 논문들은 ATE, RPE, scale alignment, coord: Existing papers used ATE, RPE, scale alignment, and coordinate convention separately, making numerical comparison and reproduction confusing.
목표는 trajectory evaluation의 수학적 정의와 실무 절차: The goal is to organize the mathematical definition and practical procedures of trajectory evaluation in a tutorial format and provide a reproducible toolbox.
방법은 trajectory association, SE(3)/Sim(3): The method explains trajectory association, SE(3)/Sim(3) alignment, absolute trajectory error, relative pose error, and segment-wise evaluation step by step.
핵심 아이디어는 evaluation metric을 알고리즘 성능의 일부처: The core idea is that the evaluation metric should be treated as part of the algorithm's performance, specifying what alignment and error definitions were used.
검증은 예제 trajectory와 VO/VIO evaluation sce: The verification is a tutorial-style experiment that shows the impact of metric calculation methods on result interpretation in example trajectories and VO/VIO evaluation scenarios.
결과는 연구자가 흔히 혼동하는 metric 선택을 정리하고 rpg_tra: The results organized the metric selection that researchers often confuse and enabled repeatable analysis with the rpg_trajectory_evaluation toolbox.
비교는 특정 odometry 알고리즘 간 SOTA 경쟁이 아니라 eval: The comparison is not about SOTA competition between specific odometry algorithms, but rather about explaining the differences between evaluation protocols.
의의는 많은 VO/VIO 논문이 평가 도구와 metric 정의를 더 명확: The significance is that many VO/VIO papers contribute to practical standardization by using evaluation tools and metric definitions more clearly.
한계는 metric tutorial이므로 perception failur: The limitation is that since it is a metric tutorial, it does not directly evaluate the cause of perception failure or task-level navigation success.
향후 과제는 uncertainty-aware trajectory eval: Future tasks include combining uncertainty-aware trajectory evaluation, online metrics, multi-session map consistency, and task success metrics.
자원 공개는 uzh-rpg/rpg_trajectory_evaluation: Resource disclosure confirmed uzh-rpg/rpg_trajectory_evaluation GitHub and DOI/OpenAlex.

여러 로봇이 unknown environment를 탐사할 때 같은 곳을: When multiple robots explore an unknown environment, coordination is important to quickly cover a large area without visiting the same place repeatedly.
논문은 multi-robot exploration task를 각 로봇이: The paper addresses the problem of controlling a multi-robot exploration task using a market economy in which each robot calculates costs and expected profits and bids.
기존 중앙집중 계획은 통신과 계산 부담이 크고 단순 분산 heuristi: Existing centralized planning had a large communication and computation burden, and simple distributed heuristics were difficult to reduce redundancy and inefficiency between robots.
목표는 탐사 목표 할당을 경제적 bidding과 utility 계산으로: The goal is to create distributed and efficient multi-robot coordination by converting exploration target allocation into economic bidding and utility calculations.
방법은 frontier 또는 exploration target의 expe: The method calculates the expected information gain and travel cost of the frontier or exploration target and determines robot-task assignment through an auction/market mechanism.
핵심 아이디어는 각 로봇의 지역 비용 정보를 가격과 bid로 표현해 복잡: The core idea is to express each robot's local cost information in terms of price and bid, turning complex team planning into a relatively simple task allocation problem.
검증은 multi-robot exploration simulation과: Verification was performed by comparing map coverage, travel distance, and exploration time in multi-robot exploration simulation and actual robot scenario.
결과는 market-based coordination이 로봇 간 중복을: The results showed that market-based coordination can reduce overlap between robots and increase exploration efficiency.
비교는 centralized planner와 heuristic assig: The comparison focuses on centralized planner and heuristic assignment, and has a different scope from modern information-theoretic multi-agent planning or learned coordination.
의의는 robotics에서 market-based task allocat: The significance is that it shows that market-based task allocation in robotics is an effective pattern not only for exploration but also for multi-robot coordination in general.
한계는 utility design과 communication assump: Limitations are sensitive to utility design and communication assumptions, and dynamic obstacles, severe localization uncertainty, and adversarial failures are addressed to a limited extent.
향후 과제는 robust communication, uncertainty: Future tasks include combining robust communication, uncertainty-aware bidding, heterogeneous robot teams, semantic exploration, and decentralized learning.

Geiger 등의 single-shot calibration 논문은 카메: The single-shot calibration paper by Geiger et al. is a sensor calibration study that attempted to automate the extrinsic calibration of cameras and range sensors by observing a single scene.
자율주행과 로봇 perception은 camera와 LiDAR/range: Autonomous driving and robot perception require accurate knowledge of the extrinsic calibration of the two sensor coordinate systems in order to use cameras and LiDAR/range sensors together.
논문은 camera image와 range measurement를 한 번: The paper addresses the problem of automatically matching camera images and range measurements with a single calibration scene observation.
기존 multi-sensor calibration은 여러 장면, 수동 c: Existing multi-sensor calibration requires multiple scenes, manual correspondence, and complex target placement, resulting in repeated work and large human errors.
목표는 single shot만으로도 camera와 range sensor: The goal is to quickly and automatically automate the calibration process by estimating the relative pose between the camera and range sensor with a single shot.
방법은 calibration target의 image feature와 r: The method extracts the image feature of the calibration target and the range sensor geometry together and calculates the extrinsic parameters by optimizing the geometric constraints.
핵심 아이디어는 두 센서가 동시에 보는 간단한 구조 장면에서 2D ima: The key idea is to make full use of the common geometry of the 2D image cue and 3D range cue in a simple structural scene viewed by both sensors simultaneously.
검증은 camera-range sensor setup에서 calibrat: Verification was performed through experiments evaluating calibration accuracy, repeatability, and downstream projection alignment in a camera-range sensor setup.
결과는 많은 수동 측정 없이도 실용적인 extrinsic calibrat: The results showed that practical extrinsic calibration can be obtained without many manual measurements.
비교는 기존 multi-shot 또는 manual calibration: The comparison focuses on existing multi-shot or manual calibration procedures and does not include comparison with modern targetless online calibration.
의의는 KITTI류 multi-sensor robotics dataset: The significance is that it shows the importance of calibration automation in KITTI-type multi-sensor robotics datasets and autonomous driving systems.
한계는 calibration target visibility와 senso: Limitations depend on calibration target visibility and sensor overlap and do not directly address calibration drift or targetless field calibration during long-term operation.
향후 과제는 online self-calibration, targetle: Future tasks include online self-calibration, targetless calibration, thermal/mechanical drift modeling, and uncertainty propagation.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 공식 code나 cali: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but the official code or calibration dataset was not confirmed.
이 논문은 gaze, gesture, body cue 같은 nonverb: This paper is an HRI study that tested whether nonverbal communication such as gaze, gesture, and body cue increase the efficiency and robustness of human-robot teamwork.
인간 팀워크는 말뿐 아니라 시선, 자세, gesture 같은 비언어 신호: Human teamwork relies heavily on not only words but also non-verbal signals such as gaze, posture, and gestures, so robots also need to deal with these.
논문은 human-robot team task에서 robot의 nonve: The paper addresses how a robot's nonverbal communication cue affects work efficiency and error recovery in a human-robot team task.
기존 HRI 시스템은 verbal command나 explicit int: Existing HRI systems are focused on verbal commands or explicit interfaces and do not fully utilize natural joint attention and turn-taking signals.
목표는 nonverbal cue가 실제 협업 성능을 높이는지 정량적으로: The goal is to quantitatively measure whether nonverbal cues actually improve collaboration performance and present HRI design principles.
방법은 robot behavior에 nonverbal signaling: The method adds nonverbal signaling conditions to robot behavior and measures task time, robustness, and interaction quality in a human participant teamwork experiment.
핵심 아이디어는 로봇 의도와 attention state를 몸짓으로 미리: The core idea is that by revealing robot intentions and attention state in advance through gestures, humans can predict and cooperate faster.
검증은 사람 참가자가 포함된 controlled HRI experimen: Verification is performed through a controlled HRI experiment involving human participants, and efficiency and failure recovery for each cue condition are compared.
결과는 적절한 nonverbal communication이 human-r: The results showed that appropriate nonverbal communication can improve the efficiency and robustness of human-robot teamwork.
비교는 cue가 있는 조건과 없는 조건이 중심이며, 최신 social n: The comparison focuses on conditions with and without cues, and the times are different from the latest social navigation or LLM-based interaction baselines.
의의는 HRI에서 communication을 명시 명령 전달이 아니라 e: The significance is that HRI expands communication into a design issue of embodied social signals rather than conveying explicit commands.
한계는 실험 task와 participant 규모가 제한적이고 문화·개인: Limitations include the limited size of experimental tasks and participants, and the lack of sufficient coverage of cultural and individual differences, long-term learning effects, and complex multi-human settings.
향후 과제는 multimodal intent signaling, adap: Future tasks include multimodal intent signaling, adaptive personalization, human gaze modeling, and field HRI evaluation.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 participant d: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but disclosure of participant data or robot behavior code was not confirmed.
Pisa/IIT SoftHand 논문은 하나의 주요 synergy와 un: The Pisa/IIT SoftHand paper presents an anthropomorphic robot hand that stably grasps a variety of objects with one key synergy and underactuated soft mechanics.
로봇 손은 많은 자유도와 복잡한 제어가 필요하지만 실제 물체 graspi: Robotic hands require many degrees of freedom and complex control, but in grasping real objects, small synergy and passive compliance play a big role like human hands.
논문은 Pisa/IIT SoftHand를 통해 adaptive syner: The paper addresses the issue of implementing adaptive synergy principles in machine design and control through Pisa/IIT SoftHand.
기존 dexterous hand는 고자유도와 정밀 제어를 요구해 비싸고: Existing dexterous hands require a high degree of freedom and precise control, making them expensive and complicated, and simple grippers have difficulty adapting to contact with various objects.
목표는 anthropomorphic shape, underactuatio: The goal is to create a hand that can perform a robust grasp with a single actuation synergy by combining anthropomorphic shape, underactuation, and soft joint compliance.
방법은 human hand postural synergy 분석, tend: The method combines human hand postural synergy analysis, tendon-driven underactuated mechanism, compliant joints, and adaptive grasp experiments.
핵심 아이디어는 손가락별 정확한 위치 제어보다 soft mechanics: The core idea is to transfer control complexity to mechanical intelligence by allowing soft mechanics to transform to suit the shape of the object rather than controlling the precise position of each finger.
검증은 다양한 물체 grasping, hand posture adapta: Verification was performed with hardware experiments including various object grasping, hand posture adaptation, and force/contact behavior analysis.
결과는 Pisa/IIT SoftHand가 단순 actuation으로도 여: The results showed that Pisa/IIT SoftHand can stably grasp objects of various sizes and shapes with simple actuation.
비교는 복잡한 dexterous hand와 단순 gripper 사이의 설: The comparison shows the design trade-off between a complex dexterous hand and a simple gripper, and comparison with a learning-based grasp policy is outside the scope of the paper.
의의는 soft robotics와 hand synergy 이론을 실제 a: The significance is that it greatly influenced subsequent adaptive grasping research by combining soft robotics and hand synergy theory into an actual anthropomorphic hand platform.
한계는 제한된 독립 손가락 제어와 dexterous in-hand man: Limitations remain limited independent finger control, dexterous in-hand manipulation capabilities, and lack of sensing integration.
향후 과제는 tactile sensing, multi-synergy ac: Future tasks include combining tactile sensing, multi-synergy actuation, dexterous manipulation, low-cost fabrication, and learned control.
자원 공개는 DOI, PDF, CentroEPiaggio/pisa-iit: Resource disclosure confirmed DOI, PDF, CentroEPiaggio/pisa-iit-soft-hand GitHub.
VPG는 pushing과 grasping을 별도 heuristic이 아니: VPG is a clutter manipulation paper that treats pushing and grasping not as separate heuristics but as complementary actions learned by self-supervised deep RL.
Cluttered bin manipulation에서는 바로 잡기 어려운: In cluttered bin manipulation, prehensile/non-prehensile action synergy is important, pushing out and re-grasping an object that is difficult to grasp.
논문은 RGB-D heightmap에서 push와 grasp action: The paper addresses the problem of organizing clutter and increasing grasp success by learning the pixel-wise values of push and grasp actions in the RGB-D heightmap.
기존 grasp-only policy는 심한 occlusion과 끼임에: The existing grasp-only policy was vulnerable to severe occlusion and jamming, and connecting pushing and grasping with a hand-coded sequence had low adaptability to each situation.
목표는 별도 human label 없이 robot trial에서 얻은 s: The goal is to learn the complementary policy of pushing and grasping using success signals obtained from robot trials without separate human labels.
방법은 fully convolutional Q-network, pixel: The method uses fully convolutional Q-network, pixel-wise action parameterization, self-supervised reward from success, simulation and real robot training.
핵심 아이디어는 push가 즉시 보상을 얻지 않아도 나중의 grasp 성: The core idea is that a push is learned as a useful preparatory action through value propagation by increasing later grasp success even if it does not immediately obtain a reward.
검증은 simulation과 UR5-style real robot clu: Verification evaluated grasp success, action efficiency, and generalization in simulation and UR5-style real robot clutter manipulation.
결과는 pushing을 함께 학습한 policy가 grasp-only b: The results showed that the policy learned along with pushing had a higher grasp success rate and efficiency in cluttered scenes than the grasp-only baseline.
비교는 grasp-only, heuristic pushing, super: The comparison focuses on grasp-only, heuristic pushing, and supervised affordance baselines, and does not include modern diffusion policy or large VLA baselines.
의의는 self-supervised robot interaction da: The significance is that it is a representative paper that shows that synergy between manipulation primitives can be learned using self-supervised robot interaction data.
한계는 bin-top heightmap과 discrete action s: Limitations are tied to bin-top heightmap and discrete action space, and problems with deformable/transparent objects, long-horizon task planning, and sample efficiency remain.
향후 과제는 richer action primitives, tactile: Future tasks include combining richer action primitives, tactile feedback, language-conditioned goals, offline pretraining, and foundation manipulation policy.
자원 공개는 arXiv, vpg.cs.princeton.edu proje: For resource disclosure, check arXiv, vpg.cs.princeton.edu project page, andyzeng/visual-pushing-grasping GitHub.
이 논문은 biped robot의 foot tipping과 postura: This paper proposed the concept of Foot-Rotation Indicator point, which is distinct from ZMP, to explain foot tipping and postural stability of a biped robot.
Biped robot은 발 접촉이 제한된 상태에서 넘어지지 않고 움직여야: Since a biped robot must move without falling over with limited foot contact, a stability standard is needed to determine when the support foot is rotating or tipping.
논문은 보행 중 postural stability를 분석하고 foot r: The paper addresses the problem of defining a Foot-Rotation Indicator point that analyzes postural stability and predicts foot rotation during walking.
기존 ZMP 기반 안정성 해석은 지면 접촉이 유지되는 범위 안에서는 유용: Existing ZMP-based stability analysis is useful within the range where ground contact is maintained, but is insufficient to directly express foot rotation onset.
목표는 biped foot의 회전 경향과 안정 한계를 더 명확히 설명하는: The goal is to present a FRI point concept that more clearly describes the rotational tendencies and stability limits of the biped foot.
방법은 rigid-body dynamics와 foot-ground con: The method analyzes rigid-body dynamics and foot-ground contact moments to derive the relationship between ZMP and FRI and stability conditions.
핵심 아이디어는 발이 회전하지 않는다는 가정 안의 ZMP보다, 실제 fo: The core idea is that rather than ZMP assuming that the foot does not rotate, we need an indicator that tracks the moment balance that causes actual foot rotation.
검증은 biped robot model과 보행/posture 예제를 통해: Verification was performed by analyzing how FRI points represent tipping conditions through a biped robot model and gait/posture examples.
결과는 FRI point가 support polygon 밖으로 이동하는: The results showed that situations where the FRI point moves outside the support polygon are useful in analyzing foot rotation and postural instability.
비교는 ZMP 기준과의 이론적 비교가 중심이며, 현대 humanoid w: The comparison is centered on theoretical comparison with the ZMP standard, and there is no comparison with modern humanoid whole-body MPC or hardware benchmarks.
의의는 biped locomotion stability 분석에서 ZMP의: The significance is that it has influenced humanoid balance control research by providing a concept that complements the limitations of ZMP in biped locomotion stability analysis.
한계는 idealized contact와 rigid-body assump: Limitations depend on idealized contact and rigid-body assumptions, and compliance, uneven terrain, and multi-contact whole-body behavior are addressed to a limited extent.
향후 과제는 compliant foot modeling, whole-bo: Future tasks include compliant foot modeling, whole-body control, push recovery, uneven terrain walking, and real-time stability margin estimation.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 code나 dataset: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but code or dataset disclosure was not confirmed.
Gaussian sampler는 obstacle boundary 주변을: Gaussian sampler is a classic paper that improves the performance of PRM's narrow passage search with a simple sampling rule that better captures the area around the obstacle boundary.
배경은 sampling-based motion planning이 고차원: The background was a time when sampling-based motion planning emerged as a practical solution in high-dimensional configuration space, but performance was determined by where the samples were distributed.
문제는 PRM이 free space 전체를 무작위로 덮을 때 실제 경로를: The problem is that when PRM randomly covers the entire free space, it does not sufficiently sample obstacle boundaries and narrow passages that determine the actual path.
기존 한계는 uniform sampling이 넓은 자유공간에 표본을 낭비: The existing limitation was that uniform sampling wastes samples in a wide free space and misses narrow connections, increasing the probability of roadmap connection failure.
목표는 기존 PRM 구조를 크게 바꾸지 않고 더 좋은 free-space: The goal is to present a simple sampling strategy that provides better free-space coverage and connectivity without significantly changing the existing PRM structure.
방법은 한 점과 그 주변 Gaussian perturbation 점을 뽑: The method picks a point and its surrounding Gaussian perturbation points and adopts the free point as a roadmap sample when one side is collision and the other side is free.
핵심 아이디어는 obstacle boundary 근방에서 free/occ: The core idea is to automatically oversample narrow passage entrances and the vicinity of surfaces by taking advantage of the fact that free/occupied pairs frequently occur near obstacle boundaries.
검증은 geometric path-planning benchmark에서: Verification corresponds to offline simulation evaluation compared to uniform sampling type PRM on a geometric path-planning benchmark.
결과는 Gaussian sampling이 어려운 passage가 있는 장: The result is that Gaussian sampling increases the possibility of connection with fewer samples in scenes with difficult passages and improves the practical success rate of PRM.
비교는 uniform strategy보다 boundary-sensitiv: Comparison has the advantage of being boundary-sensitive over the uniform strategy, but all samples may be concentrated near the boundary, so a balance with wide free-space coverage is necessary.
의의는 이후 obstacle-based PRM과 bridge-test류: The significance is that it provided an initial basis for why later obstacle-based PRM and bridge-test samplers should be aimed at narrow passages.
한계는 dynamics, uncertainty, real robot ex: The limitation is that it does not address dynamics, uncertainty, and real robot execution and is tied to the planning-level assumption that the collision checker and environmental model are accurate.
향후 과제는 adaptive mixture sampling, learni: Future tasks are to more actively reflect the problem structure, such as adaptive mixture sampling, learning-based sampler, and kinodynamic planning.
자원 공개는 DOI와 공개 PDF가 확인되지만 논문 전용 code나 da: DOI and open PDF were confirmed for resource disclosure, but paper-specific code or dataset page was not confirmed.
이 논문은 동물 동작 reference를 강화학습 목표로 써서 simul: This paper uses animal motion references as reinforcement learning goals to create an agile locomotion policy in simulation and shows an imitation pipeline that quickly adapts it to an actual robot.
배경은 legged robot이 동물처럼 다양한 보행과 agile man: The background is that for a legged robot to have various gaits and agile maneuvers like an animal, the development cost and skill-specific expertise are too large with only a hand-designed controller.
문제는 real-world animal motion을 입력으로 받아 로봇: The problem is to receive real-world animal motion as input, automatically synthesize a locomotion policy that fits the robot shape and physical constraints, and transfer it to actual hardware.
기존 한계는 reward shaping이 기술별로 수작업이고 simula: The existing limitation is that reward shaping is manually performed for each technology, and if the simulation policy is directly transferred to a real robot, performance deteriorates due to model mismatch.
목표는 reference motion data, reinforcement: The goal is to learn multiple agile skills in one procedure by combining reference motion data, reinforcement learning, and sample-efficient domain adaptation.
방법은 동물 motion clip을 imitation objective로: The method uses an animal motion clip as an imitation objective, learns the policy in simulation, and then adapts the dynamics parameters and policy with limited actual roll-out.
핵심 아이디어는 hand-crafted gait reward를 줄이는 대: The core idea is that instead of reducing the hand-crafted gait reward, the reference trajectory becomes the learning signal and the sim-to-real gap is corrected during the adaptation step.
검증은 simulation skill 학습과 실제 legged robot: Verification is an evaluation using simulation skill learning and actual legged robot deployment, and demonstrates animal-simulated walking, turning, and running movements.
결과는 단일 learning pipeline이 여러 동물 기반 locom: The results showed that a single learning pipeline can synthesize multiple animal-based locomotion skills and reproduce agile behavior in real robots.
비교는 manually designed controller보다 skill: Comparison reduces skill authoring costs over manually designed controllers, but is still sensitive to reference motion quality and morphology mismatch.
의의는 DeepMimic류 motion imitation을 실제 legg: The significance is that it strengthens the embodied skill transfer flow before VLA by connecting DeepMimic-type motion imitation to actual legged robot control.
한계는 주로 사전에 준비된 reference motion과 제한된 rob: Limitations mainly rely on pre-prepared reference motion and limited robot morphology, and rough terrain, contact-rich failure recovery, and safety guarantee are limited.
향후 과제는 더 다양한 동물 motion, online adaptatio: Future tasks include expanding to field locomotion by combining more diverse animal motion, online adaptation, terrain perception, and safety-constrained RL.
자원 공개는 arXiv PDF와 project page가 확인되지만 논문: Although arXiv PDF and project pages have been confirmed to be open resources, the public status of study code dedicated to the paper has not been confirmed.
MRTA taxonomy 논문은 multi-robot task alloc: The MRTA taxonomy paper organizes the multi-robot task allocation problem into robot, task, assignment, time, and dependency axes to create an algorithm comparison language.
배경은 multi-robot systems가 surveillance, e: The background is a trend in which multi-robot systems have expanded into applications that require simultaneous distribution of multiple robots and tasks, such as surveillance, exploration, and logistics.
문제는 서로 다른 MRTA 연구가 문제 구조와 가정을 제각각 부르면서 알: The problem is to sort out the situation where different MRTA studies call out different problem structures and assumptions, making it difficult to compare algorithms and judge problem difficulty.
기존 한계는 초기 taxonomy가 static, single-task,: The existing limitation is that the initial taxonomy was centered on static, single-task, and independent assignment, so it did not sufficiently cover problems with temporal, coalition, schedule, and dependency.
목표는 MRTA 문제를 더 세밀하게 분류하고 각 분류가 필요한 algor: The goal is to classify MRTA problems in more detail and explain what each classification means for the algorithmic machinery and complexity required.
방법은 기존 MRTA 문헌을 검토해 robot capability, ta: The method reviews existing MRTA literature and expands the classification system along axes such as robot capability, task requirement, assignment cardinality, temporal constraint, and inter-task dependency.
핵심 아이디어는 알고리즘 이름보다 문제 instance의 구조를 먼저 명: The core idea is that the structure of the problem instance must be specified before the algorithm name in order to fairly compare different auction, optimization, and scheduling methods.
검증은 새 실험이 아니라 문헌 survey와 taxonomy consis: Verification is not a new experiment, but is closer to a literature survey and taxonomy consistency evaluation, and maps various MRTA cases to a classification framework.
결과는 단순한 ST-SR-IA류 분류를 넘어 복합 task, multi-: The results go beyond simple ST-SR-IA classification and provide a more comprehensive MRTA vocabulary that includes complex tasks, multi-robot coalitions, and temporal planning.
비교는 기존 Gerkey-Mataric taxonomy보다 넓고 설명력이: The comparison is broader and has greater explanatory power than the existing Gerkey-Mataric taxonomy, but it does not directly provide an empirical benchmark or standardized dataset.
의의는 multi-agent robotics에서 task allocati: The significance is that it provides a reference frame that reveals commonalities and differences between papers when designing task allocation problems in multi-agent robotics.
한계는 taxonomy paper이므로 algorithm performa: The limit is taxonomy paper, so there are no algorithm performance figures or real robot validation, and when a new application appears, the classification axis must be expanded again.
향후 과제는 human-robot teaming, uncertainty-: Future tasks include linking human-robot teaming, uncertainty-aware allocation, online replanning, and learned preferences together as taxonomy and benchmarks.
자원 공개는 DOI와 publisher page가 확인되며 code, d: For resource disclosure, DOI and publisher page are confirmed, but code, dataset, and project page are not confirmed due to the nature of the paper.
DIGIT은 손가락 끝에 붙일 수 있는 저가 compact vision-: DIGIT is a paper that designed a low-cost compact vision-based tactile sensor that can be attached to the tip of a finger and demonstrated the practicality of the tactile sensor through in-hand manipulation experiments.
배경은 general-purpose in-hand manipulation: The background is that general-purpose in-hand manipulation remains a key challenge in robotics because it does not allow detailed sensing of contact force and contact location.
문제는 multi-fingered hand에 실제로 장착 가능한 크기와: The problem is to create a sensor that reliably obtains high-resolution tactile images at a size and price that can actually be mounted on a multi-fingered hand.
기존 한계는 GelSight류 vision tactile sensor가: The existing limitation was that the GelSight type vision tactile sensor was large or had low manufacturing repeatability, making it difficult to attach multiple sensors to a dexterous hand.
목표는 compact, low-cost, high-resolution,: The goal is to provide a tactile sensor DIGIT that satisfies compact, low-cost, high-resolution, and repeatable manufacturing as an open design.
방법은 elastomer gel, internal illumination: The method miniaturizes elastomer gel, internal illumination, camera module, and 3D-printed/mechanical housing and learns a marble manipulation controller in a multi-finger hand.
핵심 아이디어는 카메라가 변형된 gel 표면을 관측하게 하되 finger: The core idea is to have a camera observe the deformed gel surface, but to downgrade the lab prototype to a deployable sensor by prioritizing finger-tip form factor and manufacturability.
검증은 DIGIT 센서를 장착한 robotic hand의 in-hand: Verification is performed through in-hand glass marble manipulation by a robotic hand equipped with a DIGIT sensor and deep model-based control experiments.
결과는 소형 촉각 센서가 접촉 정보를 제공해 marble manipula: The results suggest a tactile platform where a small tactile sensor provides contact information, enables marble manipulation, and is reproducible through open design files.
비교는 기존 vision-based tactile sensor보다 작고: The comparison shows that while it is smaller and cheaper than the existing vision-based tactile sensor, actual use management issues such as calibration, gel wear, and lighting consistency remain.

배경은 robot map이 geometry와 appearance만 담아서: The background is that robot maps that only contain geometry and appearance are insufficient for high-level task planning and human interaction, and object/category semantics are needed.
