목표는 passive dynamic walking의 가능성을 knee-j: The goal is to expand the possibilities of passive dynamic walking to more humanoid models, including knee-joints.
방법은 무릎이 있는 passive walker의 동역학 모델과 물리적 실: The method analyzes the phenomenon of walking on slopes through a dynamic model of a passive walker with knees and a physical experimental device.
핵심 아이디어는 안정 보행을 controller가 완전히 생성하는 것이: The core idea is that stable gait is not completely generated by a controller, but rather can be generated by machine morphology and gravity-driven dynamics.
검증은 passive walking prototype과 동역학 분석으로: Verification is performed using a passive walking prototype and dynamics analysis, focusing on real hardware but without a modern benchmark dataset.
결과는 knees를 포함한 passive walker가 안정적이고 에너지: The results showed that a passive walker, including knees, could produce a stable and energy-efficient gait pattern.
비교는 fully actuated trajectory tracking b: The comparison is with a fully actuated trajectory tracking biped, a passive approach that requires little control input but has limited terrain and speed range.
의의는 dynamic walking, underactuated locom: The significance is to provide the core philosophy of dynamic walking, underactuated locomotion, and energy-efficient legged robot design.
한계는 경사면, 제한된 속도, 외란 민감성에 묶이며 평지 보행과 방향 전: Limitations are tied to slopes, limited speed, and sensitivity to disturbances, while level walking and turning require additional actuation and control.
향후 과제는 powered ankle/knee, limit-cycle s: Future tasks include combination with powered ankle/knee, limit-cycle stabilization, variable terrain adaptation, and humanoid control.
Montana의 논문은 접촉점에서 물체와 손가락 표면의 상대 motion: Montana's paper provided the basic language for dexterous manipulation theory by describing differential geometry the relative motion of the finger surface and the object at the point of contact.
로봇 손이 물체를 굴리거나 미끄러뜨리며 조작하려면 접촉점의 위치, nor: For a robot hand to manipulate an object by rolling or sliding, the position of the contact point, normal, curvature, and rolling/sliding motion must be accurately modeled.
논문은 두 곡면이 접촉할 때 접촉점의 kinematic evolution: The paper deals with how to express the kinematic evolution of the contact point when two curved surfaces come into contact and apply it to grasp/manipulation.
기존 grasp analysis는 wrench closure에 집중하거나: Existing grasp analysis focused on wrench closure or assumed simple contact geometry and did not sufficiently address the differential kinematics of contact point movement.
목표는 contact kinematics의 일반 방정식을 유도해 roll: The goal is to provide a unified description of rolling contact and sliding contact by deriving general equations of contact kinematics.
방법은 differential geometry, surface param: The method develops contact point motion equations using differential geometry, surface parameterization, curvature tensor, and relative velocity.
핵심 아이디어는 손가락과 물체 표면의 국소 curvature가 접촉점의: The key idea is to mathematically express that the local curvature of the finger and object surface determines the movement and manipulability of the point of contact.
검증은 수학적 유도와 canonical contact examples 중: Verification focuses on mathematical derivation and canonical contact examples, and actual robot experiments or dataset evaluation are outside the scope of the paper.
결과는 contact motion을 정량적으로 기술하는 방정식이 제시되어: As a result, an equation was presented that quantitatively describes contact motion, which became the basis for dexterous manipulation and grasp planning theories.
비교는 point contact 또는 rigid closure 중심 모델: The comparison is with point contact or rigid closure-oriented models, which model the process itself of moving the contact point over the surface.
의의는 손 안 조작, rolling manipulation, tactil: Its significance is that it provided a basic kinematic framework that is still used in hand manipulation, rolling manipulation, and tactile contact modeling.
한계는 정확한 표면 geometry와 rigid contact를 가정하고: Limitations assume accurate surface geometry and rigid contact, and friction, compliance, and tactile uncertainties are limited.
향후 과제는 soft contact, tactile sensing, da: Future tasks include integration with soft contact, tactile sensing, data-driven local geometry estimation, and contact-rich manipulation planning.
Rutgers Master II 논문은 손가락 force feedback: The Rutgers Master II thesis is a hardware thesis that designs a glove-type haptic interface that provides finger force feedback and shows potential for rehabilitation and teleoperation applications.
가상현실, 원격조작, 재활 치료에서 손가락에 힘을 되돌려주는 haptic: In virtual reality, remote manipulation, and rehabilitation therapy, a haptic glove that returns strength to the fingers can greatly improve the user's sense of grasp and manipulation.
논문은 portable하고 비교적 가벼운 force-feedback gl: The paper addresses how a portable, relatively lightweight force-feedback glove can provide finger movements and force cues.
기존 haptic glove는 bulky하거나 force output이: Existing haptic gloves were bulky, had limited force output, and had difficulty satisfying both independent feedback for each finger and wearability.
목표는 Rutgers Master II라는 새로운 glove design: The goal is to propose a new glove design called Rutgers Master II and demonstrate performance suitable for hand rehabilitation and virtual interaction.
방법은 pneumatic 또는 actuator-driven finger: The method combines a pneumatic or actuator-driven finger force feedback mechanism, position sensing, glove ergonomics, and a control interface.
핵심 아이디어는 손가락별 force feedback을 착용형 device: The core idea is to integrate finger-specific force feedback into a wearable device to provide more natural hand interaction than desktop haptic devices.
검증은 glove prototype의 mechanical performa: Verification focuses on the mechanical performance and application demonstration of the glove prototype and does not involve evaluation of a large user dataset.
결과는 Rutgers Master II가 각 손가락에 feedback f: The results showed that Rutgers Master II provides feedback force to each finger and can be used in VR/rehabilitation tasks.
비교는 CyberGrasp류 상용 장치와 초기 glove systems가: The comparison is based on CyberGrasp-like commercial devices and early glove systems, and this paper focuses on improving the design and incorporating force feedback functionality.
의의는 hand haptics와 robotic rehabilitation: The significance is to expand the possibilities of wearable force-feedback interface in hand haptics and robotic rehabilitation.
한계는 착용감, calibration, actuator bandwidth: Limitations remain in terms of fit, calibration, actuator bandwidth, safety for long-term use, and adaptation to various hand sizes.
향후 과제는 lighter actuators, richer tactile: Future tasks include lighter actuators, richer tactile feedback, clinical validation, and telemanipulation coupling.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex 기록은 확인되나 paper-speci: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex records, but paper-specific CAD, controller code, and dataset disclosure links were not confirmed.
이 논문은 haptic interface의 discrete-time en: This paper proposed time-domain passivity control that observes the discrete-time energy behavior of the haptic interface and maintains stability with a passivity observer/controller.
Haptic interface와 teleoperation은 사람, dev: Haptic interfaces and teleoperations form a closed loop of people, devices, and virtual environments, so even small time delays and sampling effects can create unstable vibrations.
논문은 haptic system이 시간 영역에서 passive 상태를 벗: The paper deals with the problem of detecting when a haptic system leaves the passive state in the time domain and maintaining stability by adjusting energy.
기존 frequency-domain passivity analysis는: Existing frequency-domain passivity analysis was difficult or conservative to control actual nonlinear, time-varying, and discrete haptic interactions online.
목표는 passivity observer와 passivity contro: The goal is to ensure that the haptic interface maintains stability in real time through a passivity observer and passivity controller.
방법은 시스템의 energy flow를 sampling time마다 계산: The method calculates the energy flow of the system at each sampling time and designs a time-domain passivity control that injects damping when active energy occurs.
핵심 아이디어는 복잡한 environment model을 정확히 알기보다: The core idea is to use the measured energy balance itself as a stability signal rather than accurately knowing the complex environment model.
검증은 haptic interface 실험과 virtual wall 등: Verification is performed in interaction scenarios such as haptic interface experiments and virtual walls, and is control verification centered on actual devices.
결과는 passivity controller가 delay와 discret: The results showed that the passivity controller reduces instability caused by delay and discretization and enables stable force feedback.
비교는 고정 damping이나 frequency-domain passiv: The comparison is with fixed damping or frequency-domain passivity design, and the time-domain method has strong online adaptation and implementability.
의의는 haptics와 bilateral teleoperation에서 p: The significance is to create one of the practical standards for passivity-based safety controllers in haptics and bilateral teleoperation.
한계는 damping injection이 transparency와 fee: Limitations are that damping injection can reduce transparency and feel, and passivity is not a sufficient condition for task performance.
향후 과제는 adaptive transparency-passivity t: Future tasks include adaptive transparency-passivity trade-off, multi-DOF haptics, delayed network teleoperation, and human perception-aware control.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex 기록은 확인되나 paper-speci: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex records, but paper-specific code or hardware design files were not confirmed.
Deep Spatial Autoencoder는 image에서 task-r: Deep Spatial Autoencoder is a paper that makes visuomotor policy learning more sample-efficient by learning task-relevant keypoint-like representations from images unsupervised.
로봇 visuomotor learning은 raw image에서 acti: Robot visuomotor learning requires learning actions directly from raw images, but high-dimensional pixel input has large sample complexity when actual robot data is small.
논문은 manipulation policy가 사용할 수 있는 compac: The paper addresses the problem of automatically learning compact and spatially meaningful visual features that can be used by manipulation policies.
기존 hand-engineered feature나 supervised p: Existing hand-engineered features or supervised perception require annotation for each task, and end-to-end CNN policies require many robot trials.
목표는 unlabeled video/image에서 spatial auto: The goal is to learn a spatial autoencoder from unlabeled video/image to extract keypoint-like features and use them as controller input.
방법은 convolutional encoder의 feature map에: The method applies spatial softmax to the feature map of the convolutional encoder, turns the expected 2D coordinates of each channel into features, and performs reconstruction learning with an autoencoder.
핵심 아이디어는 reconstruction만으로도 manipulation: The key idea is to add an architecture bias so that the objects and gripper positions required for manipulation are revealed in the coordinate bottleneck just by reconstruction.
검증은 실제 로봇 manipulation tasks에서 learned v: Verification is performed using visual features learned from actual robot manipulation tasks for policy learning, and includes hardware experiments rather than simulation-only.
결과는 spatial feature가 raw pixel 또는 generi: The results show that spatial features stabilize visuomotor policy learning and enable task performance with fewer trials than raw pixel or generic features.
비교는 hand-crafted visual features, standa: The comparison focuses on hand-crafted visual features and standard autoencoder/CNN representation, and the baseline is an early visuomotor learning standard rather than a strong end-to-end deep RL.
의의는 later keypoint-based policy learning: The significance later created an important precedent for keypoint-based policy learning, visual servicing with learned features, and object-centric representation learning.
한계는 feature가 reconstruction objective와 s: Limitations include that features depend on the reconstruction objective and scene distribution, and there are limitations in occlusion, multi-object ambiguity, and long-horizon reasoning.
향후 과제는 self-supervised interaction signa: Future tasks include combining self-supervised interaction signals, temporal consistency, object-centric dynamics, and language-conditioned manipulation.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex와 arXiv가 확인되며 공식 pape: DOI/OpenAlex and arXiv are confirmed for resource disclosure, but official paper-specific code has not been confirmed, and the Papers with Code item is at the level of a reference link.
이 논문은 suction과 parallel-jaw grasp를 함께 선택: This paper improved warehouse bin picking performance by learning an ambidextrous policy that selects suction and parallel-jaw grasp together using Dex-Net-based synthetic training.
산업용 bin picking은 물체 형상과 pose가 다양해 suctio: In industrial bin picking, object shapes and poses vary, so which end-effector is more advantageous, a suction gripper or a parallel-jaw gripper, varies each time.
논문은 한 로봇이 suction과 grasping이라는 두 가지 gras: The paper addresses the problem of a robot performing robust picking by selecting two grasp modes, suction and grasping, according to the situation.
기존 grasping policy는 단일 gripper 유형에 최적화되어: The existing grasping policy was optimized for a single gripper type, so failure modes were distinct depending on the object surface, edge, and clutter conditions.
목표는 synthetic data와 analytic grasp metri: The goal is to allow the ambidextrous policy learned using synthetic data and analytic grasp metrics to determine gripper selection and grasp pose together in actual bin picking.
방법은 Dex-Net 스타일의 대규모 synthetic depth ima: The method learns a deep policy that evaluates suction and parallel-jaw candidates with Dex-Net-style large-scale synthetic depth images and grasp quality labels.
핵심 아이디어는 두 end-effector를 경쟁시키는 것이 아니라 같은: The key idea is not to make the two end-effectors compete, but to select the action family with the highest expected success from the same perception input.
검증은 physical robot bin-picking experimen: Verification is performed through physical robot bin-picking experiments and has a sim-to-real evaluation structure called a real robot test after simulation training.
결과는 ambidextrous policy가 단일 suction 또는 단: The results showed that the ambidextrous policy had higher pick success than the single suction or single gripper policy, and the paper reports reliability of about 95%.
비교는 suction-only, grasp-only, analytic 또: Comparisons can be made to suction-only, grasp-only, analytic or learned single-mode baselines, and baselines are strong standards that are meaningful in actual industry grasping.
의의는 end-effector diversity와 policy selec: The significance is that it shows that end-effector diversity and policy selection can greatly increase grasp robustness, which has direct implications for warehouse automation.
한계는 depth sensing과 known gripper familie: Limitations depend on depth sensing and known gripper families, and performance may be limited for deformable, transparent, and highly reflective objects.
향후 과제는 더 많은 tool/end-effector, online fa: Future challenges include integration with more tools/end-effectors, online failure recovery, tactile feedback, and clutter rearrangement.
자원 공개는 Science Robotics DOI와 project pag: The Science Robotics DOI and project page are confirmed for resource disclosure, and although there are Dex-Net series open resources, the exact dataset/code snapshot of the entire experiment in this paper requires separate confirmation.
OPV2V는 V2V communication 기반 collaborativ: OPV2V is a paper that discloses CARLA/OpenCDA simulation dataset and fusion benchmark pipeline for collaborative perception based on V2V communication.
자율주행 차량은 occlusion과 제한된 sensor range 때문에: Autonomous vehicles have difficulty fully understanding intersections and complex traffic scenes using single vehicle perception due to occlusion and limited sensor range.
논문은 vehicle-to-vehicle communication을 통해: The paper addresses the problem of a collaborative perception benchmark that fuses perception features or detection of multiple vehicles through vehicle-to-vehicle communication.
기존 autonomous driving dataset은 대부분 singl: Most of the existing autonomous driving datasets were single-ego vehicle-centered, so there was a lack of paired multi-vehicle data that could fairly compare cooperative perception algorithms.
목표는 OPV2V dataset과 baseline fusion pipel: The goal is to provide a standard evaluation basis for V2V perception research by releasing the OPV2V dataset and baseline fusion pipeline.
방법은 CARLA와 OpenCDA를 이용해 multi-vehicle Li: The method uses CARLA and OpenCDA to generate multi-vehicle LiDAR/camera/pose data and 3D labels and configure early/intermediate/late fusion baselines.
핵심 아이디어는 통신 가능한 차량들이 각자의 viewpoint를 공유하면: The core idea is to create a benchmark based on the assumption that occlusion can be reduced and 3D object detection can be improved if communication-capable vehicles share their respective viewpoints.
검증은 simulated cooperative driving scenes: Verification is performed using perception metrics such as 3D detection mAP in simulated cooperative driving scenes and is not a real road driving dataset.
결과는 cooperative fusion이 single-vehicle p: The results show that cooperative fusion can improve detection performance over single-vehicle perception, and OPV2V provides 73 scenes and large-scale annotated frames.
비교는 single-ego detection과 fusion level별: The comparison is single-ego detection and baselines for each fusion level, and since it is a simulation dataset, additional verification is required in real-life sensor noise and communication delay.
의의는 V2V collaborative perception을 개별 논문: The significance is to elevate V2V collaborative perception from an individual paper demonstration to a public benchmark and reproducible pipeline problem.
한계는 CARLA simulation bias, perfect pose/: Limitations remain due to CARLA simulation bias, the influence of perfect pose/communication assumptions, and the real-world domain gap.
향후 과제는 real cooperative driving dataset,: Future tasks include real cooperative driving dataset, bandwidth-aware feature selection, latency-robust fusion, and privacy/security-aware collaboration.
자원 공개는 OPV2V dataset site와 OpenCOOD GitH: The OPV2V dataset site and OpenCOOD GitHub are identified as open resources, and public benchmark resources are the core contributions of the paper.
ViSP 논문은 visual servoing 알고리즘과 robot con: The ViSP paper provided an experimental basis for vision-based control research by combining visual servoing algorithms and robot control skills into a reusable C++ platform.
Visual servoing은 카메라 영상 feature를 feedbac: Visual servicing is a core technology that controls robot motion using camera image features as feedback and must support a variety of robot and camera geometries.
논문은 visual servoing algorithm, tracking,: The paper addresses the issue of providing a generic software platform that integrates visual servicing algorithm, tracking, control law, and robot interface.
기존 visual servoing 연구 코드는 실험실별로 분산되어 있어: Existing visual servoing research code was distributed across laboratories, making algorithm comparison, robot porting, and reproducible demonstration difficult.
목표는 ViSP를 통해 image-based/position-based: The goal is to provide a common framework that can implement image-based/position-based visual servicing and various control skills through ViSP.
방법은 visual feature tracking, interaction: The method consists of visual feature tracking, interaction matrix, control law, camera model, and robot interface with a C++ library and examples.
핵심 아이디어는 visual servoing의 이론 구성요소를 모듈화해: The core idea is to modularize the theoretical components of visual servicing so that researchers can test them on the same platform while replacing features and control laws.
검증은 여러 robot control skill과 visual track: Verification is performed using several robot control skills and visual tracking examples and focuses on software platform demonstration.
결과는 ViSP가 다양한 visual servoing task를 한 pl: The results showed that ViSP can implement various visual servoing tasks on one platform, and it was later maintained as an open source visual servoing library.
비교는 개별 연구 코드와 대비되며, ViSP의 강점은 algorithm: The comparison is against individual research codes, and ViSP's strengths are genericity, portability, and reusable implementation rather than algorithm novelty.
의의는 visual servoing 연구를 실제 robot에서 반복 시험: The significance is that visual servicing research is made into a software infrastructure that can be repeatedly tested on actual robots.
한계는 library paper라 특정 task에서 state-of-th: The limitation is that it is a library paper, so rather than claiming state-of-the-art performance in a specific task, the scope of support and quality of implementation are key, and modern deep perception is outside the initial scope.
향후 과제는 ROS integration, deep feature tra: Future tasks include combining ROS integration, deep feature tracking, RGB-D/visual-inertial sensing, and learning-based visual servicing.
자원 공개는 ViSP 공식 사이트와 GitHub가 확인되며 공개 코드가: Resource disclosure is confirmed on the ViSP official site and GitHub, and public code is the core resource.
Lin-Canny 알고리즘은 convex polyhedra 사이의 최소거: The Lin-Canny algorithm is a paper that created the classic basis for collision checking by quickly updating the minimum distance between convex polyhedra with temporal coherence.
로봇 motion planning과 simulation은 움직이는 물체: Robot motion planning and simulation must repeatedly calculate the minimum distance and collision between moving objects, and this cost determines the overall speed.
논문은 연속적인 time step에서 물체 configuration이 조: The paper addresses the problem of quickly updating the distance between convex objects when the object configuration changes slightly in successive time steps.
기존 distance computation은 매번 처음부터 계산해 반복: Existing distance computation was inefficient in planning and animation with many repetitive queries as it was calculated from scratch every time.
목표는 이전 closest features 정보를 활용해 incremen: The goal is to propose a fast algorithm that incrementally calculates the minimum distance using previous closest features information.
방법은 convex polyhedra의 vertex-edge-face f: The method tracks the closest pair using the vertex-edge-face feature pair of the convex polyhedra and the Voronoi region relationship.
핵심 아이디어는 motion이 연속적이면 가장 가까운 feature pa: The key idea is to use temporal coherence in distance calculation, which means that if motion is continuous, the nearest feature pair does not change significantly.
검증은 geometric examples와 computational pe: Verification is centered on geometric examples and computational performance evaluation and is not an evaluation of the actual robot hardware dataset.
결과는 반복 distance query를 크게 가속할 수 있음을 보였고: The results showed that iterative distance queries could be greatly accelerated and later became the basis for collision detection and proximity query libraries.
비교는 brute-force pair checking 및 non-incr: The comparison is with brute-force pair checking and non-incremental distance methods, and its strength is its efficiency in a continuous motion environment.
의의는 robot planning, CAD, computer graphi: Significance: It is a classic algorithm that made proximity query an independent research topic in robot planning, CAD, and computer graphics.
한계는 convex geometry와 local feature track: Since the limitations are based on convex geometry and local feature tracking, non-convex meshes require additional structures such as decomposition or BVH.
향후 과제는 non-convex collision, dynamic sce: Future tasks include non-convex collision, dynamic scenes, robust numerical handling, and modern collision library integration.
Utah/MIT Dextrous Hand 논문은 다지·다관절 tendon: The Utah/MIT Dextrous Hand paper designed a multi-limb, multi-joint tendon-driven robotic hand and set the hardware standard for anthropomorphic dexterous manipulation research.
인간 손처럼 복잡한 manipulation을 수행하려면 다수의 자유도,: To perform complex manipulations like the human hand, a dexterous robotic hand with multiple degrees of freedom, fast actuators, compact transmission, and sensing is required.
논문은 Utah/MIT Dextrous Hand의 mechanical d: The paper addresses the mechanical design, actuator/transmission architecture, and sensor integration issues of the Utah/MIT Dextrous Hand.
기존 robot gripper는 병렬 jaw나 단순 finger 구조가: Existing robot grippers have many parallel jaw or simple finger structures, which lack the degree of freedom needed for humanoid in-hand manipulation and force control research.
목표는 연구자들이 dexterous manipulation control: The goal is to implement an anthropomorphic multi-finger robotic hand platform that allows researchers to experiment with dexterous manipulation control.
방법은 tendon-driven joints, pneumatic or h: The method designs hand hardware that combines tendon-driven joints, pneumatic or hydraulic actuation, joint sensing, and compact finger mechanisms.
핵심 아이디어는 인간 손의 기능적 자유도를 기계적으로 재현하면서 actu: The core idea is to keep the finger structure light by placing the actuator outside the hand while mechanically replicating the functional freedom of the human hand.
검증은 hand prototype의 설계 사양과 작동 demonstrat: Verification focuses on design specifications and operational demonstration of hand prototypes and does not involve evaluation of modern task benchmarks or datasets.
결과는 high-DOF dexterous hand가 실제로 제작 가능함을: The results showed that a high-DOF dexterous hand could actually be manufactured, and it was later cited as a representative platform for dexterous manipulation research.
비교는 단순 gripper 및 초기 multi-finger hands와: The comparison is with simple grippers and early multi-finger hands, and the difference is that manipulation dexterity is greatly expanded at the expense of complexity and cost.
의의는 robotic hand hardware가 grasp theory와: The significance is that robotic hand hardware is an important turning point that connects grasp theory and manipulation control research to actual experiments.
한계는 복잡한 transmission, 유지보수, calibration,: The limitation is that it requires complex transmission, maintenance, calibration, and actuator infrastructure, which places a heavy burden on practical deployment.
향후 과제는 compact actuation, tactile skin,: Future tasks include compact actuation, tactile skin, robust control, affordable dexterous hands, and learned manipulation.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex 기록은 확인되나 CAD, contro: Resource disclosure was confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex records, but CAD, controller code, and dataset disclosure links were not confirmed.
이 논문은 의료 로봇의 autonomy 수준이 높아질수록 필요한 regu: This paper is a Science Robotics perspective that summarizes the regulatory, ethical, and legal frameworks needed as the level of autonomy of medical robots increases.
Medical robotics는 수술, 진단, 치료 보조에서 autono: Medical robotics is increasingly using autonomy in surgical, diagnostic, and therapeutic assistance, but it is a high-risk area where patient safety and liability are directly at stake.
논문은 의료 로봇의 autonomy 증가가 규제 승인, 윤리, 법적 책임: The paper addresses how the increasing autonomy of medical robots creates issues for regulatory approval, ethics, liability, and verification procedures.
기존 의료기기 규제와 clinical validation 체계는 rule: Existing medical device regulations and clinical validation systems are suitable for rule-based or surgeon-controlled devices, but may be insufficient for learning-enabled autonomous robots.
목표는 autonomy level별 고려사항을 정리하고 안전한 의료 로봇: The goal is to organize considerations by autonomy level and present discussion points necessary for safe medical robot development and approval.
방법은 기술 review와 policy perspective 형식으로 a: The method analyzes autonomy taxonomy, risk, verification/validation, and liability issue in the form of technology review and policy perspective.
핵심 아이디어는 의료 로봇 autonomy를 단순 기능 발전이 아니라 e: The core idea is to view medical robot autonomy not as a simple functional development, but as a socio-technical system that must be designed together with evidence, governance, and accountability.

기존 joint-space dynamics 분석은 task-space에서: Existing joint-space dynamics analysis was difficult to intuitively show the apparent inertia and force capability actually experienced by an object in task-space.

향후 과제는 확률적 occupancy, motion cost, robot: Future tasks include NBV planning that combines stochastic occupancy, motion cost, robot kinematics, and learned view utility.
자원 공개는 DOI 기록만 확인했고, 논문 전용 PDF·코드·데이터셋·프: For resource disclosure, only DOI records were checked, and confirmation of public links for paper-only PDF, code, dataset, and project pages was limited.
MAV navigation을 위해 IMU 중심 상태추정기에 다양한 절대·: This is a multi-sensor fusion framework paper that modularly attaches various absolute and relative sensors to an IMU-centered state estimator for MAV navigation.
소형 비행 로봇은 GPS가 약하거나 없는 환경에서 IMU, vision,: Small flying robots must make stable state estimation by combining IMU, vision, range, and pose sensors in environments where GPS is weak or absent.
논문은 센서 구성이 바뀌어도 MAV pose, velocity, bias: The paper addresses the modular state-estimation problem that robustly estimates MAV pose, velocity, and bias even when the sensor configuration changes.
기존 estimator는 특정 센서 조합에 맞춘 단일 구현이 많아, de: Existing estimators often have a single implementation tailored to a specific sensor combination, making it difficult to reuse delayed measurements and various sensor types.
목표는 센서별 measurement model만 추가하면 같은 core: The goal is to create a scalable fusion architecture that operates on the same core filter by simply adding measurement models for each sensor.
방법은 IMU propagation을 중심으로 EKF 기반 상태를 유지하: The method maintains the EKF-based state centered on IMU propagation and modularizes absolute, relative, and delayed measurement updates.
핵심 아이디어는 estimator의 공통 상태와 센서 adapter를 분: The key idea is to separate the common state of the estimator and the sensor adapter, so that adding a new sensor does not require redesigning the entire filter.
검증은 MAV navigation 실험과 여러 센서 입력 조합에서 이루어: Verification is a real robot-based evaluation made from MAV navigation experiments and multiple sensor input combinations, and public PDF and MSF code families are verified.
결과는 다양한 센서를 통합해 안정적인 MAV navigation을 수행할: The results showed that stable MAV navigation can be performed by integrating various sensors, and were widely reused as ETH ASL's multi-sensor fusion implementation.
비교 관점에서 특정 VIO나 GPS-INS estimator보다 일반성과: From a comparative perspective, it has stronger generality and modularity than specific VIO or GPS-INS estimators, but is sensitive to EKF linearization and sensor calibration quality.
의의는 이후 aerial robotics에서 실험 플랫폼마다 다른 sen: The significance is that it provides a practical state estimation basis that can quickly integrate different sensor stacks for each experimental platform in aerial robotics.
한계는 factor-graph smoothing류보다 과거 상태 재최적화: The limitation is that past state re-optimization is limited compared to factor-graph smoothing, and strong nonlinearity, outliers, and time sync errors require separate processing.
향후 과제는 factor graph, online calibration,: Future tasks include integration of factor graph, online calibration, robust outlier rejection, event camera, and learned perception measurement.
자원 공개는 OpenAlex/DOI, Edinburgh 공개 PDF, e: Open resources include OpenAlex/DOI, Edinburgh public PDF, and ethz-asl/ethzasl_msf GitHub.
VLMaps는 pretrained visual-language featu: VLMaps is a paper that combines pretrained visual-language features with a 3D map to search for landmarks and spatial goals in natural language and connect them to navigation.
VLM과 LLM이 시각-언어 연결을 강하게 만들었지만, 로봇 naviga: Although VLM and LLM strengthened the visual-language connection, robot navigation required a step to anchor language meaning to a metric/spatial map.
논문은 자연어 명령을 열린 어휘 landmark와 공간 관계로 해석해 실: The paper deals with the problem of interpreting natural language commands as open vocabulary landmarks and spatial relationships and converting them from actual map coordinates to navigation goals.
기존 CLIP-on-wheels류 방법은 이미지-텍스트 매칭은 가능해도: Existing CLIP-on-wheels methods are capable of image-text matching, but 3D geometry and spatial relations are weak, making it difficult to accurately ground complex instructions.
목표는 추가 label이나 fine-tuning 없이 RGB-D 관측과: The goal is to create a language-indexable spatial map using only RGB-D observations and a pretrained visual-language model, without additional labels or fine-tuning.
방법은 RGB-D와 pose로 dense pixel-level VLM e: The method back-projects dense pixel-level VLM embedding with RGB-D and pose onto a 3D/2D grid map, and finds the goal with CLIP text embedding and an LLM-generated program.
핵심 아이디어는 semantic feature를 이미지마다 버리지 않고: The core idea is to accumulate semantic features in map cells rather than discarding them in each image, so that linguistic queries can be converted into spatial search operations.
검증은 Habitat/Matterport3D 기반 simulation,: Verification is a mixed offline/real-robot evaluation including Habitat/Matterport3D-based simulation, manually collected RGB-D sequences, and real-world navigation examples.
결과는 Google Research 설명 기준으로 Habitat/Matt: The results were **17%** better than the existing zero-shot method in Habitat/Matterport3D's challenging object-goal and spatial-goal navigation based on Google Research explanations.
비교 대상은 CLIP on Wheels와 LM-Nav류 zero-shot: The objects of comparison are CLIP on Wheels and LM-Nav type zero-shot navigation, and the difference in VLMaps increases not only in landmarks but also in spatial goals such as between and left/right.
의의는 VLM/VLA 시대의 robot navigation에서 map r: The significance is that the map representation itself has been expanded into an open-vocabulary language interface in robot navigation in the VLM/VLA era.
한계는 pretrained segmentation/embedding 오류: Limitations tie performance to pretrained segmentation/embedding errors, depth-pose quality, collision handling of the navigation stack, and LLM command parsing.
향후 과제는 dynamic scene, lifelong map updat: Future tasks include dynamic scene, lifelong map update, real robot large-scale deployment, and uncertainty-aware language grounding.
자원 공개는 공식 project page, arXiv, Google Re: Resource disclosure can be found on the official project page, arXiv, Google Research blog, and vlmaps/vlmaps GitHub.
딥러닝이 로보틱스에서 강한 perception 도구가 될 수 있지만 데이: This is a survey/position paper that summarizes that deep learning can be a strong perception tool in robotics, but is not an all-purpose solution due to data, embodiment, safety, and generalization issues.
딥러닝이 컴퓨터비전에서 급격히 성공한 뒤, 로봇도 perception부터: After the rapid success of deep learning in computer vision, expectations have grown as to whether robots can also be transformed into end-to-end learning from perception to control.
논문은 robotics에서 deep learning이 실제로 어떤 문제를: The paper systematically asks which problems deep learning actually solves well in robotics and under what conditions it reveals its limitations.
기존 논의는 성공 사례 중심이거나 특정 task에 갇혀 있어, 데이터 수: Existing discussions focused on success stories or were confined to specific tasks, failing to comprehensively look at data collection costs, physical interaction, safety, and transfer issues.
목표는 deep learning의 potentials와 limits를 로: The goal is to organize the potentials and limits of deep learning in a balanced manner from a robotics perspective, allowing researchers to avoid both excessive expectations and underestimation.
방법은 perception, representation learning,: The method critically reviews literature and cases related to perception, representation learning, manipulation, navigation, reinforcement learning, and sim-to-real.
핵심 아이디어는 로봇 학습을 이미지 분류와 다르게 embodiment,: The core idea is that, unlike image classification, robot learning should be viewed as a problem that combines embodiment, action, causality, and data scarcity.
검증은 새로운 실험 benchmark가 아니라 문헌 분석과 사례 기반 s: Verification is not a new experimental benchmark, but a literature analysis and case-based survey, and studies of actual robots, simulations, and offline datasets are discussed separately.
결과는 딥러닝이 perception과 representation에서는 강: The results show that deep learning is powerful in perception and representation, but there are still large gaps in long-tail safety and sample-efficient physical learning.
비교 관점에서 model-free end-to-end 학습만이 아니라 m: From a comparative perspective, we emphasize the need for not only model-free end-to-end learning, but also model-based control, classical robotics, and hybrid architectures.
의의는 로보틱스 커뮤니티가 deep learning을 도입할 때 어디를: The significance is that it provides a standard for the robotics community to judge where to learn and where to structure when introducing deep learning.
한계는 2018년 시점의 survey라 foundation model,: The limitation is that the survey was conducted in 2018, so it cannot directly reflect rapid changes after the foundation model, VLM/VLA, and diffusion policy.
향후 과제는 self-supervised robot data, simul: Future tasks include the combination of self-supervised robot data, simulation-to-real transfer, uncertainty and safety, and causal/world-model learning.
자원 공개는 DOI와 arXiv 공개본을 확인했지만, survey 논문: DOI and arXiv public versions were confirmed for resource disclosure, but due to the nature of the survey paper, code, dataset, and project pages were not confirmed as paper-only resources.
초음파 range sensor로 환경 모델과 로봇 위치를 함께 갱신해 모: This paper created the initial probabilistic mapping/localization flow of a mobile robot by updating the environment model and robot position together with an ultrasonic range sensor.
초기 모바일 로봇은 저가 초음파 센서로 장애물과 벽을 보아야 했지만, 센: Early mobile robots had to use low-cost ultrasonic sensors to see obstacles and walls, but both maps and locations were uncertain due to sensor noise and wide beams.
논문은 ultrasonic ranging을 이용해 world model을: The paper addresses the problem of creating a world model using ultrasonic ranging and simultaneously updating the robot position estimate.
기존 방법은 단일 range reading을 기하적으로 해석하거나 위치가: Existing methods either geometrically interpret a single range reading or assume that the location is already accurate, making it difficult to handle cumulative map error and pose uncertainty together.
목표는 불확실한 초음파 관측을 환경 표현과 위치추정에 동시에 반영하는 실: The goal is to present a practical mobile robot framework that simultaneously reflects uncertain ultrasound observations in environment representation and position estimation.
방법은 range measurement를 공간 모델에 누적하고, 로봇의: The method accumulates range measurements into a spatial model and updates the pose using consistency between the robot's estimated position and environmental features.
핵심 아이디어는 noisy sonar를 버리지 않고 확률적·누적적 wor: The core idea is to reduce the ambiguity of individual observations over time by not discarding the noisy sonar but absorbing it into a stochastic and cumulative world model.
검증은 실제 모바일 로봇과 ultrasonic sensor 기반 실험으로: Validation is an initial hardware evaluation consisting of experiments based on actual mobile robots and ultrasonic sensors, and is not a modern public benchmark.
결과는 저해상도 sonar만으로도 위치 추정과 환경 모델링을 결합할 수: The results show that low-resolution sonar alone can combine location estimation and environmental modeling, which subsequently influenced the flow of occupancy grids and probabilistic robotics.
비교 관점에서 카메라나 LiDAR보다 정보량은 낮지만, 저가 센서의 un: From a comparative perspective, the amount of information is lower than that of cameras or LiDAR, but the uncertainty of low-cost sensors was modeled and a direction for using them for autonomous movement was suggested.
의의는 SLAM이라는 용어가 널리 정착되기 전부터 mapping과 loc: The significance is that it experimentally addressed the interdependence of mapping and localization even before the term SLAM was widely established.
한계는 초음파 beam ambiguity, specular reflect: Limitations include ultrasonic beam ambiguity, specular reflection, and simple environment assumptions, making it unsuitable for complex dynamic scenes and high-precision maps.
향후 과제는 laser/vision/IMU와의 sensor fusion,: Future tasks include sensor fusion with laser/vision/IMU, explicit uncertainty propagation, and scalable SLAM in large-scale environments.
자원 공개는 DOI와 CiNii/IEEE 기록은 확인했지만, 코드·데이터: For resource disclosure, DOI and CiNii/IEEE records were confirmed, but code, dataset, and project pages were not confirmed.
Control-limited DDP는 box control constra: Control-limited DDP is a paper that processes box control constraints directly in the backward pass and adapts fast trajectory optimization to actual robot limitations.
고자유도 로봇의 trajectory optimization은 빠른 동작: The trajectory optimization of a high-degree-of-freedom robot enables the creation of fast movements, but ignoring the actual actuator limit can damage the robot.
논문은 Differential Dynamic Programming이 co: The paper attempts to solve the problem that Differential Dynamic Programming does not handle control bounds efficiently.
기존 DDP는 제어 입력이 unconstrained라고 가정해 빠르지만,: Existing DDP is fast because it assumes that the control input is unconstrained, but simple clamping or penalties can harm convergence quality and stability.
목표는 DDP의 빠른 간접 최적화 장점을 유지하면서 box inequal: The goal is to accurately reflect box inequality control constraints while maintaining the advantages of DDP's fast indirect optimization.
방법은 backward pass에서 control-limited quad: The method calculates limited feedforward and feedback gains by solving a control-limited quadratic subproblem in the backward pass.
핵심 아이디어는 제어 한계를 사후 보정하지 않고 local Q-funct: The key idea is to put the control limits into the local Q-function minimization itself rather than post-compensating them, and let the optimization process decide whether to activate the limits.
검증은 simulated control tasks와 **36-DoF**: Validation consisted of simulated control tasks and simulation evaluation including the **36-DoF** HRP-2 humanoid example.
결과는 control limits를 직접 처리해 clamping/pena: The results show more stable and efficient convergence than clamping/penalty by directly processing control limits, enabling near-real-time optimization.
비교 관점에서 trajectory optimizer 중 빠른 DDP 계열: From a comparative perspective, it takes advantage of the fast DDP series among trajectory optimizers while lowering the computational burden compared to constrained nonlinear programming.
의의는 robot whole-body control과 model-base: The significance is that it provides an optimal control tool to safely handle actuator saturation in robot whole-body control and model-based RL.
한계는 local trajectory optimizer라 초기 궤적과 모: The limitations are that it is a local trajectory optimizer, so it is sensitive to the initial trajectory and model accuracy, and state constraints and contact switching require separate processing.
향후 과제는 contact-rich motion, robust model: Future tasks include contact-rich motion, robust model uncertainty, MPC-style online replanning, and integration with differentiable physics.
자원 공개는 DOI와 공개 PDF 사본을 확인했지만, 논문 전용 공식 코: Resource disclosure confirmed the DOI and a copy of the public PDF, but no official code or dataset dedicated to the paper was identified.
PARO 같은 seal robot과의 장기 생활이 요양시설 노인의 사회심: This is a robot therapy paper that observes on-site the effects of long-term living with a seal robot such as PARO on the psychosocial and physiological status of elderly people in nursing homes.
고령화와 돌봄 인력 부족 속에서 소셜 로봇이 치료·정서 지원 도구가 될: There was a need to verify in actual care houses whether social robots could be used as a treatment and emotional support tool amidst an aging population and shortage of care workers.
논문은 elderly residents가 seal robot과 함께 생활: The paper asks how social psychological and physiological indicators such as conversation, emotion, and stress change when elderly residents live with a seal robot.
기존 robot therapy 논의는 단기 데모나 실험실 반응에 머무르는: Existing discussions on robot therapy often focus on short-term demonstrations or laboratory responses, failing to sufficiently demonstrate long-term effects in actual living spaces.
목표는 seal robot이 노인 돌봄 환경에서 사회적 상호작용과 정서: The goal is to evaluate with field data whether the seal robot can have a positive impact on social interaction and emotional stability in an elderly care environment.
방법은 요양시설에 seal robot을 배치하고, 관찰·설문·대화량·생리: The method is to place a seal robot in a nursing facility and measure observations, questionnaires, conversation volume, and physiological stress indicators over time.
핵심 아이디어는 로봇을 기능 수행자가 아니라 정서적 매개체로 두어 사람-: The core idea is to evaluate whether human-human interaction can be facilitated by placing robots as emotional mediators rather than functional performers.
검증은 실제 care house의 노인 대상 장기 현장 연구이며, 제어된: Validation is a long-term field study with older adults in an actual care house, and is an HRI/gerontechnology evaluation rather than a controlled laboratory performance benchmark.
결과는 seal robot이 일부 참여자의 상호작용과 정서 상태에 긍정적: The results supported the possibility of robot therapy by reporting that the seal robot could have a positive effect on the interactions and emotional states of some participants.
비교 관점에서 의료기기나 보조기기보다 정량 기능은 약하지만, 정서·사회적: From a comparative perspective, its quantitative function is weaker than that of medical devices or assistive devices, but it presents a different value axis of emotional and social engagement.
의의는 소셜 로봇의 효과를 실제 돌봄 환경의 장기 생활 맥락에서 측정한: Its significance is that it is an early, highly cited example of measuring the effectiveness of social robots in the context of long-term living in an actual care environment.
한계는 표본 크기, 통제군, novelty effect, 시설·문화 특수: Limitations require caution in generalization due to sample size, control group, novelty effect, and facility/cultural specificity.
향후 과제는 무작위 대조 연구, 장기 habituation 분석, 윤리·: Future tasks include randomized controlled studies, long-term habituation analysis, and integrated evaluation of ethics, attachment, and care workflow.
자원 공개는 DOI와 관련 공개 PDF/요약 자료는 확인했지만, 코드·데: For resource disclosure, DOI and related public PDF/summary data were confirmed, but code, dataset, and project pages were not confirmed.
TacTip family는 3D-printed biomimetic pin: The TacTip family is a paper that presents a smooth and reproducible tactile sensor platform with a 3D-printed biomimetic pin structure and optical tracking.
안전한 manipulation과 HRI에는 접촉을 정밀하게 읽는 tact: Safe manipulation and HRI require tactile sensing, which reads contact precisely, but many sensors are rigid or have poor manufacturing reproducibility.
논문은 부드러운 피부 구조 안의 변형을 카메라로 읽어 다양한 형태의 ta: The paper addresses the problem of creating various types of tactile sensors and evaluating their performance by reading the deformation in the soft skin structure with a camera.
기존 촉각 센서는 복잡한 배선, 높은 제작 난도, 낮은 내구성, 제한된: Existing tactile sensors have been difficult to widely use in robotic hands and grippers due to complex wiring, high manufacturing difficulty, low durability, and limited form diversity.
목표는 biomimetic intermediate ridge 원리를 반영: The goal is to show that a 3D-printed TacTip series sensor that reflects the biomimetic intermediate ridge principle can be a practical tactile platform.
방법은 부드러운 표면의 내부 pin marker 움직임을 optical: The method tracks the movement of an internal pin marker on a smooth surface with an optical camera and produces shapes such as TacTip, TacTip-GR2, TacTip-M2, and TacCylinder.
핵심 아이디어는 인간 손가락 피부의 기계적 증폭 구조를 3D 프린팅 가능: The core idea is to implement the mechanical amplification structure of human finger skin into a 3D printable pin morphology to visually read contact deformation.
검증은 rolling cylinder task 등 실제 센서 실험으로 이: Verification was conducted through actual sensor experiments such as a rolling cylinder task, and the paper reported submillimeter accuracy and super-resolved acuity of more than **10-fold**.
결과는 TacTip family가 다양한 morphology에서 안정적인: The results showed that the TacTip family can perform stable tactile localization and manipulation-relevant sensing in various morphologies.
비교 관점에서 전기식 taxel array보다 배선이 단순하고 형태 제작: From a comparative perspective, wiring is simpler and form production is more flexible than an electric taxel array, but there are requirements for camera space, lighting, and image processing.
의의는 soft tactile sensor를 공개 가능한 하드웨어 플랫폼: The significance is that it lowers the barrier to entry for tactile-based manipulation research by organizing soft tactile sensors into a publicly available hardware platform.
한계는 센서 크기, 카메라 frame rate, 내부 marker 추적,: Limitations remain in sensor size, camera frame rate, internal marker tracking, and response limitations in dynamic high-speed contact.
향후 과제는 고속·소형화, learned tactile represent: Future tasks include expansion into high speed and miniaturization, learned tactile representation, robot hand integration, and slip/texture/force estimation.
자원 공개는 PMC 공개 논문과 TacTip open-source 언급을: Resource disclosure confirmed the PMC open paper and TacTip open-source mention, but the single official GitHub status at the time of card creation requires separate confirmation.
Aerial swarm robotics의 통신, task allocati: This is a representative survey paper that systematizes communication, task allocation, trajectory planning, coordination, and hardware limitations of aerial swarm robotics.
저가 비행 플랫폼과 소형 센서가 보급되면서 단일 UAV보다 여러 대의 협: As low-cost flying platforms and small sensors become widespread, missions in which multiple cooperative UAVs cover large spaces become more important than single UAVs.
논문은 aerial swarm이 실제 임무를 수행하려면 어떤 알고리즘·하: The paper addresses the issue of organizing what algorithms, hardware, and communication elements are needed for an aerial swarm to perform its actual mission.
기존 연구는 formation, coverage, control, com: Existing research often deals with formation, coverage, control, and communication separately, making it difficult to see the system-level connection structure and bottlenecks at a glance.
목표는 aerial swarm robotics의 핵심 기술 영역과 ope: The goal is to provide a common map for follow-up research by summarizing the core technology areas and open challenges of aerial swarm robotics.
방법은 swarm size, communication topology,: The method surveys literature on swarm size, communication topology, task allocation, motion planning, collision avoidance, and experimental platforms.
핵심 아이디어는 aerial swarm을 단순 다중 UAV 제어가 아니라: The core idea is to view aerial swarm not as simple multi-UAV control but as a multi-agent system combining sensing, communication, computation, and autonomy.
검증은 새로운 실험이 아니라 문헌 기반 survey이며, 실제 비행 sw: Verification is not a new experiment, but a literature-based survey, and it categorizes actual flight swarm cases and theoretical and simulation studies together.
결과는 aerial swarm 연구의 알고리즘 계층과 실험적 제약을 체계: The results systematically demonstrate the algorithmic hierarchy and experimental constraints of aerial swarm research, and reveal bottlenecks in operation at scales 10s or larger.
비교 관점에서 ground swarm survey와 달리 항공 플랫폼의: From a comparative perspective, unlike the ground swarm survey, the energy, collision risk, 3D dynamics, and communication range of the airborne platform appear to be stronger constraints.
의의는 aerial swarm 분야에서 연구 주제를 나누고 통합 시스템: Its significance is that it is widely used as a reference point for dividing research topics and defining integrated system tasks in the field of aerial swarm.
한계는 survey라 정량 benchmark를 제공하지 않고, 2018년: The limitation is that it is a survey, so it does not provide a quantitative benchmark, and it cannot directly reflect changes in learning-based swarm, VIO, and decentralized VLM planning since 2018.
향후 과제는 scalable autonomy, safety guarant: Future challenges include scalable autonomy, safety guarantees, heterogeneous teams, field deployment, and limited communication under uncertainty.
자원 공개는 CaltechAUTHORS/GRASP 공개 PDF와 DOI를: Caltech AUTHORS/GRASP public PDF and DOI were confirmed for resource disclosure, but paper-specific codes and datasets were not confirmed due to the nature of the survey.
온라인 incremental bag-of-visual-words와 Bay: This paper quickly performed visual SLAM loop-closure detection using online incremental bag-of-visual-words and Bayesian filtering.
Visual SLAM에서 loop closure는 누적 drift를 줄이: In Visual SLAM, loop closure is a key step in reducing cumulative drift, but it must be quickly and robustly determined whether the current image is the same as any location in the past.
논문은 이미지 스트림이 들어오는 중에 이전 방문 장소를 실시간으로 찾아: The paper addresses the problem of creating loop closure and global localization candidates by finding previously visited locations in real time while an image stream is coming in.

목표는 visual words를 점진적으로 만들고 loop-closure: The goal is to present a real-time method to gradually create visual words and accumulate loop-closure probability temporally.
방법은 SIFT와 local color histogram을 visual: The method stores SIFT and local color histogram as visual words and updates the loop closure hypothesis with inverted index and Bayesian filtering.
핵심 아이디어는 과거 이미지의 단순 최단거리 검색이 아니라 시간적 pos: The core idea is not to simply search for the shortest distance of past images, but to maintain the temporal posterior to stabilize candidates even under strong perceptual aliasing.

AFM, micro/nano manufacturing, precision: In AFM, micro/nano manufacturing, and precision positioning, the fast response and fine resolution of piezo actuators are key driving technologies.

향후 과제는 self-supervised place descriptor,: Future tasks include combining self-supervised place descriptor, sequence-aware retrieval, uncertainty calibration, and lifelong map update.

Execution-extended RRT(ERRT)로 planning과: This paper enables real-time robot navigation in a dynamic environment by combining planning and execution with Execution-extended RRT (ERRT).
실제 모바일 로봇은 연속 공간에서 경로를 계획하는 동안에도 움직여야 하고: Real mobile robots must move while planning a path in continuous space and must quickly replan according to environmental changes.
논문은 RRT 기반 path planning을 real-time navi: The paper addresses the problem of replanning during execution by placing RRT-based path planning within a real-time navigation loop.
기존 RRT는 feasibility 탐색에는 강했지만, 매번 처음부터 계: Although the existing RRT was strong in feasibility search, it was not efficient enough in dynamic environments and fast robot execution if it was planned from scratch every time.
목표는 계획과 실행을 interleave하고 이전 경험을 재사용해 실시간: The goal is to create a randomized planner suitable for real-time robot navigation by interleaving planning and execution and reusing previous experiences.
방법은 waypoint cache와 adaptive cost penalt: The method proposes Execution-Extended RRT (ERRT) with waypoint cache and adaptive cost penalty search.
핵심 아이디어는 이전 성공 경로의 waypoint를 새 RRT 확장에 활: The core idea is to leverage waypoints from previous successful paths to expand new RRTs, reducing the cost of completely random re-searches.

결과는 ERRT가 basic RRT보다 replanning efficie: The results showed that ERRT improved replanning efficiency and path quality over basic RRT and showed competitive performance with heuristic/reactive methods.
비교 관점에서 potential-field류 reactive avoida: From a comparative perspective, it has better continuous spatial planning quality than potential-field type reactive avoidance, and has stronger reusability during execution than pure RRT.
의의는 sampling-based planning을 실험실 오프라인 알고: The significance is that sampling-based planning is brought from a laboratory offline algorithm to the online navigation loop of an actual robot.
한계는 동역학, uncertainty, multi-agent intera: Limitations include not deeply optimizing dynamics, uncertainty, and multi-agent interaction, and path quality depends on sampling and cost heuristic.
향후 과제는 kinodynamic constraints, dynamic: Future work is an online planner combining kinodynamic constraints, dynamic obstacle prediction, optimality, and multi-robot coordination.

RL로 학습한 neural policy가 quadrotor의 저수준 제어: This paper shows whether a neural policy learned with RL can directly perform low-level control of a quadrotor and withstand strong initial conditions in actual flight.
Quadrotor 제어는 전통적으로 모델 기반 cascade contro: Quadrotor control has traditionally relied on model-based cascade controllers, but there has been a growing trend to supplement nonlinear dynamics and disturbances with learning control.
논문은 state를 actuator command로 직접 매핑하는 neu: The paper addresses the problem of controlling a quadrotor by training a neural network policy that directly maps the state to actuator commands using reinforcement learning.
기존 RL 제어는 sample inefficiency와 불안정성 때문에: Existing RL control is difficult to apply directly to actual aircraft due to sample inefficiency and instability, and trajectory optimization can take a long calculation time.
목표는 conservative하지만 stable한 learning alg: The goal is to obtain a policy that works in both simulation and real quadrotor with a conservative but stable learning algorithm.
방법은 quadrotor dynamics를 대상으로 neural poli: The method trains a neural policy using reinforcement learning targeting quadrotor dynamics, and applies the learned policy to low-level control of the actual platform.

비교 관점에서 모델 기반 trajectory optimization보다: From a comparative perspective, the execution calculation is much faster than model-based trajectory optimization, but training stability and sim-to-real gap management are the key burdens.
의의는 deep RL이 실제 aerial robot low-level c: The significance is that early evidence shows that deep RL can be applied to actual aerial robot low-level control.

향후 과제는 robust sim-to-real, safety filter: Future tasks include robust sim-to-real, safety filter, residual/model-based RL, and disturbance-aware policy learning.

개인별 metabolic cost를 직접 피드백으로 삼아 soft exo: This paper optimizes the hip assistance profile of the soft exosuit as human-in-the-loop using individual metabolic cost as direct feedback.
보행 보조 wearable robot은 평균적인 제어 파라미터보다 개인별: A wearable walking assistance robot should reflect individual biomechanics and preferences rather than average control parameters to achieve greater actual energy savings.
논문은 사람이 treadmill walking 중일 때 hip assis: The paper addresses the problem of reducing metabolic cost by automatically adjusting hip assistance timing and magnitude when a person is treadmill walking.
기존 exosuit 제어는 수동 tuning이나 집단 평균 파라미터에 의: Existing exosuit control relies on manual tuning or group average parameters, making it difficult to quickly find the optimal assistance profile for each individual.
목표는 human-in-the-loop optimization으로 사용자: The goal is to find energetically optimal assistance for each user and verify actual metabolic cost reduction through human-in-the-loop optimization.
방법은 soft exosuit, force-controlled actua: The method repeatedly updates the assistance profile using soft exosuit, force-controlled actuation, metabolic estimation, and CMA-ES series black-box optimization.
핵심 아이디어는 로봇의 objective를 기계적 궤적 오차가 아니라 사: The core idea is to set the robot's objective not as a mechanical trajectory error, but as the user's actual physiological response.

결과는 최적화된 assistance가 unpowered 또는 no-exo: The results showed that optimized assistance showed a significant metabolic reduction compared to the unpowered or no-exo conditions, and in follow-up reports, a level reduction of approximately **14.8%** was mentioned.
비교 관점에서 고정 파라미터 controller보다 개인 적응성이 강하지: From a comparative perspective, it has stronger individual adaptability than a fixed parameter controller, but the real-time metabolic estimation and experiment time are major costs.
의의는 wearable robotics에서 preference learn: The significance is that it is a representative example of linking preference learning and physiological optimization in wearable robotics to actual walking assistance control.

향후 과제는 portable exosuit, faster physiolo: Future tasks include portable exosuit, faster physiological estimation, multi-objective comfort/safety optimization, and clinical population evaluation.

시각 feedback으로 quadrotor의 pose를 추정하고 안정화: This is an early vision-based aerial robot control paper that estimates the pose of a quadrotor and performs stabilization control using visual feedback.
소형 quadrotor가 연구 플랫폼으로 떠오르던 시기에, onboard: At a time when small quadrotors were emerging as a research platform, position and attitude feedback control using onboard or external vision was an important task.

의의는 vision-based MAV control과 visual ser: Its significance is that it provided an early experimental foundation for vision-based MAV control and visual servicing for aerial robots.

향후 과제는 onboard VIO, robust state estimat: Future tasks include integration of onboard VIO, robust state estimation, high-speed flight, and perception-planning-control.

논문은 da Vinci Surgical System을 연구용으로 재구성해: The paper addresses the issue of reconfiguring the da Vinci Surgical System for research purposes and making it an open-source kit that can be shared by multiple laboratories.
기존 수술 로봇 연구는 자체 하드웨어나 제한된 API에 묶여, force: Existing surgical robot research was tied to its own hardware or limited API, making it difficult to conduct comparative studies on force feedback, autonomy, and teleoperation.

결과는 dVRK가 다양한 연구 그룹의 공유 플랫폼이 되었고, 이후 sur: As a result, dVRK became a shared platform for various research groups, and later spread as a common hardware/software basis for surgical robotics papers.

의의는 고비용 medical robotics 분야에서 open-sourc: The significance is that it is a representative infrastructure paper that created an open-source platform culture in the field of high-cost medical robotics.

비홀로노믹 unicycle-like vehicle을 Lyapunov 기법: This is a classic RAM paper that presents a closed-loop control law for stably steering a non-holonomic unicycle-like vehicle using the Lyapunov technique.
차륜형 모바일 로봇은 nonholonomic constraint 때문에: Wheeled mobile robots are more difficult to stabilize in the desired posture than linear systems due to nonholonomic constraints.

기존 open-loop steering이나 단순 path tracking: Existing open-loop steering or simple path tracking are weak to initial condition changes and disturbances, and do not sufficiently reflect the theoretical constraints of non-holonomic stabilization.
목표는 Lyapunov function을 기반으로 수렴성을 설명할 수 있: The goal is to present a practical feedback steering law that can explain convergence based on the Lyapunov function.

결과는 unicycle-like vehicle의 안정적인 closed-l: The results showed that stable closed-loop steering of a unicycle-like vehicle was possible, and were widely cited in mobile robot control education and research.

의의는 차륜형 로봇 motion control의 기본 제어 법칙과 Lya: The significance is that it widely disseminates the basic control laws of wheeled robot motion control and the Lyapunov analysis framework.

Kirigami skin의 방향성 마찰과 기계적 불안정성을 이용해 단순: This is a soft robotics paper that uses the directional friction and mechanical instability of Kirigami skin to enable a simple soft actuator to perform crawling locomotion.
Soft robot locomotion은 보통 여러 actuator와 복: Soft robot locomotion usually requires multiple actuators and complex controls, but the system can be simplified if the skin structure itself creates friction direction.
논문은 단순 soft actuator에 kirigami-patterned: The paper addresses the problem of creating crawling motion without separate multiple actuation by applying kirigami-patterned skin to a simple soft actuator.
기존 soft crawler는 여러 챔버, 복잡한 sequencing,: Existing soft crawlers required multiple chambers, complex sequencing, and external structures, making them cumbersome to manufacture and control.
목표는 stretchable kirigami sheet의 buckle-i: The goal is to show that the buckle-induced scale-like structure of stretchable kirigami sheets can amplify locomotion by creating directional friction.
방법은 절개 패턴이 있는 얇은 kirigami skin을 soft act: The method attaches a thin kirigami skin with an incision pattern to a soft actuator, and when driven by pressure, the surface scales unfold and asymmetric the ground friction.
핵심 아이디어는 actuator 내부 제어를 복잡하게 만드는 대신, 외피: The key idea is to use the geometry and instability of the shell to rectify the push-pull cycle into a forward movement, rather than complicating the actuator's internal control.
검증은 제작한 soft actuator와 kirigami skin의 cr: Verification is an actual hardware experiment consisting of crawling experiments and friction/locomotion observations of the manufactured soft actuator and kirigami skin.
결과는 kirigami skin이 단순 actuator의 crawling: The results showed that kirigami skin can significantly improve the crawling ability of a simple actuator and suggested the possibility of mechanical programming of soft locomotion.
비교 관점에서 다중 actuator robot보다 제어는 단순하지만, 표: In comparative terms, control is simpler than that of a multi-actuator robot, but it is sensitive to surface conditions and skin wear and has limited freedom of direction change.
의의는 soft robotics에서 morphology와 material: The significance is that it intuitively shows that morphology and material instability can act as controllers in soft robotics.
한계는 특정 지면·패턴·구동 조건에 맞춘 proof-of-concept: The limitations are that it has a strong proof-of-concept nature tailored to specific ground, pattern, and driving conditions, and verification of complex terrain or long-term durability is limited.
향후 과제는 programmable friction skins, mult: Future challenges include programmable friction skins, multi-directional gait, durable materials, and terrain-adaptive soft locomotion.

자율주행차의 행동이 인간 운전자의 반응을 바꾼다는 점을 planning: This paper created more efficient and communicative driving by incorporating the fact that the behavior of an autonomous vehicle changes the response of a human driver into a planning model.
자율주행차는 다른 운전자를 피하기만 하는 것이 아니라, 자신의 행동이 인: Self-driving cars must not only avoid other drivers, but also take into account their interactive nature in that their actions guide future human actions.
논문은 robot car가 human driver의 반응을 예측하고 동시: The paper addresses the planning problem of a robot car predicting the response of a human driver and simultaneously leveraging that response.
기존 prediction-then-planning 방식은 인간을 수동 장: Existing prediction-then-planning methods treat humans like passive obstacles, resulting in defensive and opaque behavior, and fail to incorporate mutual influence into the model.
목표는 autonomous car와 human driver를 couple: The goal is to model autonomous cars and human drivers as a coupled dynamical system to plan actions that are efficient and communicative.
방법은 로봇 action이 차량 상태뿐 아니라 human action에도: The method creates a model in which robot actions affect not only the vehicle state but also human actions, and plans in merging and four-way stop scenarios.
핵심 아이디어는 인간 반응을 외생적 trajectory로만 예측하지 않고: The key idea is to treat human responses as endogenous variables that can be changed by robot policy, rather than predicting them solely as exogenous trajectories.
검증은 시뮬레이션 중심의 driving interaction scenar: Verification is performed through simulation-based driving interaction scenario evaluation and model comparison, and actual road driving verification is outside the scope of the paper.
결과는 influence-aware planner가 단순 defensiv: The results showed that an influence-aware planner can create more active and understandable merge/stop behavior than a simple defensive planner.
비교 관점에서 전통 예측 기반 planning보다 상호작용을 잘 반영하지: From a comparative perspective, it reflects interactions better than traditional prediction-based planning, but if the human model is wrong, both safety and reliability can be shaken.
의의는 autonomous driving planning을 multi-a: The significance is that it is a representative example of redefining autonomous driving planning as a multi-agent game and human-robot interaction problem.
한계는 단순화된 인간 모델과 제한된 교통 시나리오에 기반하며, real-: Limitations are based on simplified human models and limited traffic scenarios, and lack real-world heterogeneous driver behavior and safety guarantees.
향후 과제는 bounded rationality, risk-sensiti: Future tasks include bounded rationality, risk-sensitive planning, learned human models, and scalable game-theoretic planning.
