Fast-Planner 계열의 kinodynamic search와 B-s: This paper generates a fast quadrotor autonomous flight trajectory in a complex 3D environment using Fast-Planner series kinodynamic search and B-spline optimization.
Quadrotor가 복잡한 3D 환경을 빠르게 비행하려면 안전, 동역학: For a quadrotor to fly quickly in a complex 3D environment, local planning that simultaneously satisfies safety, dynamic potential, smoothness, and calculation time is required.
논문은 unknown/complex environment에서 빠른 aut: The paper addresses the problem of robust and efficient trajectory generation for fast autonomous flight in an unknown/complex environment.
기존 방법은 안전한 초기 경로와 동역학 가능 궤적 최적화를 따로 처리하거: Existing methods either handle safe initial path and dynamically possible trajectory optimization separately, or fast flight performance may be limited due to conservative timing.
목표는 kinodynamic feasible initial traject: The goal is to create a planning system that integrates kinodynamic feasible initial trajectory, B-spline smoothing, and dynamic feasibility time adjustment.
방법은 discretized control space의 kinodynam: The method creates an initial trajectory using a kinodynamic path search in a discretized control space, and optimizes clearance and smoothness using EDF gradient and B-spline convex hull properties.
핵심 아이디어는 빠른 search가 만든 feasible skeleton: The core idea is to change the feasible skeleton created by fast search into a non-uniform B-spline trajectory and ensure non-conservative dynamic feasibility through repeated time adjustment.
검증은 다양한 simulation environment와 challeng: Verification is a mixed simulation/real robot evaluation including various simulation environments and challenging real-world quadrotor tasks.
결과는 빠른 계획과 비행 가능성을 동시에 보여주었고, 논문은 open-s: The results showed both quick planning and flight feasibility, and the paper specified the release of an open-source package.
비교 관점에서 순수 geometric planner보다 dynamic f: From a comparative perspective, it has stronger dynamic feasibility than a pure geometric planner and is more advantageous for online replanning than heavy nonlinear optimization.
의의는 Fast-Planner가 이후 EGO-Planner, FUEL,: The significance is that Fast-Planner later became the base code for the open source UAV planning ecosystem such as EGO-Planner, FUEL, and RACER.
한계는 map quality, depth sensing range, dy: Performance is limited by map quality, depth sensing range, dynamic obstacle, and aggressive control tracking error.
향후 과제는 dynamic environment, perception u: Future tasks include dynamic environment, perception uncertainty, onboard compute limits, exploration and planning co-design.
자원 공개는 arXiv, HKUST 논문 페이지, HKUST-Aerial: Resource disclosures include arXiv, HKUST paper page, and HKUST-Aerial-Robotics/Fast-Planner GitHub.
P300 기반 비침습 BCI로 사용자가 목적지를 선택하고 automate: This paper combines P300-based non-invasive BCI to allow the user to select a destination and automated navigation to perform actual wheelchair movement.
중증 운동 장애 사용자를 위한 이동 보조에서는 직접 joystick 조작: In mobility assistance for users with severe motor disabilities, direct joystick operation may be difficult, so a combination of brain-computer interface and autonomy is necessary.
논문은 P300 neurophysiological protocol로 사용: The paper addresses the problem of reading user intent and automating wheelchair navigation using the P300 neurophysiological protocol.
기존 BCI wheelchair는 연속 저수준 제어를 사용자에게 요구하거: Existing BCI wheelchairs require continuous low-level control from users, or actual movement is slow and burdensome due to the low bandwidth of BCI signals.
목표는 사용자는 high-level destination selectio: The goal is to create a shared-control wheelchair where the user only makes high-level destination selection and the robot takes charge of obstacle avoidance and path execution.
방법은 visual stimulus 기반 P300 classifier로: The method selects the destination command using a visual stimulus-based P300 classifier, and the onboard navigation module plans and follows the route within the environment.
핵심 아이디어는 저대역폭 BCI를 low-level steering에 쓰: The core idea is not to use low-bandwidth BCI for low-level steering, but to combine it with automatic navigation to reduce the user's cognitive load.
검증은 비침습 EEG를 사용하는 human-subject 실험과 whee: Validation is a real-world system evaluation consisting of human-subject experiments using non-invasive EEG and a wheelchair navigation task.
결과는 P300 선택과 autonomous navigation의 결합이: The results showed that the combination of P300 selection and autonomous navigation can bring a brain-actuated wheelchair close to practical speed and burden levels.
비교 관점에서 continuous BCI control보다 명령 빈도 요: From a comparative perspective, command frequency requirements are lower than continuous BCI control, but performance is sensitive to P300 selection accuracy and menu design.
의의는 assistive robotics에서 BCI와 robot auto: The significance is that it is a representative example of combining BCI and robot autonomy in assistive robotics through role sharing.
한계는 사용자별 EEG calibration, fatigue, 환경 복잡: Limitations remain in user-specific EEG calibration, fatigue, environmental complexity, safety certification, and long-term use verification in actual patient groups.
향후 과제는 adaptive BCI, multimodal intent s: Future tasks include adaptive BCI, multimodal intent sensing, shared autonomy, and clinical long-term evaluation.
자원 공개는 DOI와 EPFL 공개 PDF가 확인되지만, 코드·데이터셋·: DOI and EPFL public PDF were confirmed for resource disclosure, but code, dataset, and project pages were not confirmed.
TrajOpt는 충돌 제약과 trajectory cost를 sequent: TrajOpt is a paper that quickly optimizes robot motion planning by solving collision constraints and trajectory costs through sequential convex optimization.
로봇 조작과 이동에는 collision-free path뿐 아니라 짧고: Robot manipulation and movement require short and smooth trajectories as well as collision-free paths, but obstacle avoidance constraints create a non-convex optimization problem.
논문은 로봇 trajectory를 locally optimal하고 col: The paper deals with an optimization-based motion planning problem that makes the robot trajectory locally optimal and collision-free.
기존 sampling planner는 feasible path는 잘 찾지: Existing sampling planners are good at finding feasible paths, but are limited in path quality and constraint expression, and nonlinear trajectory optimization is sensitive to collision constraint processing and initialization.
목표는 sequential convex optimization으로 비볼록: The goal is to provide a practical robot trajectory optimizer by iteratively linearizing non-convex collision constraints through sequential convex optimization.
방법은 signed distance 기반 collision cost/co: The method iteratively solves the convex subproblem using signed distance-based collision cost/constraint, hinge loss, trust region, and penalty update.
핵심 아이디어는 충돌 회피를 discrete collision check: The core idea is to make collision avoidance not a discrete collision check, but an optimizable continuous cost and constraint to simultaneously adjust the entire trajectory.
검증은 PR2 real robot tasks와 humanoid/box s: Verification includes both real robots and simulations, such as PR2 real robot tasks and humanoid/box simulation.
결과는 복잡한 manipulation과 navigation task에서: The result is a TrajOpt code and benchmark that quickly finds smooth collision-free trajectories in complex manipulation and navigation tasks.
비교 관점에서 sampling-based planner보다 traject: From a comparative perspective, the trajectory quality is higher than that of the sampling-based planner and it is easier to add constraints, but problems with local optimum and initialization remain.
의의는 최적화 기반 motion planning을 ROS/robotics: The significance is that it elevates optimization-based motion planning into a practical tool that can be widely used in the ROS/robotics community.
한계는 nonconvexity 때문에 전역 최적 보장은 없고, signe: The limitation is that there is no guarantee of global optimality due to nonconvexity, and the quality of the signed distance field and the initial trajectory determine whether it fails.
향후 과제는 global search와의 hybridization, co: Future tasks include hybridization with global search, contact-rich planning, uncertainty-aware constraints, and differentiable collision models.
자원 공개는 RSS supplementary page, TrajOpt G: Resource disclosures include the RSS supplementary page, TrajOpt GitHub, and planning benchmark GitHub.
Task planner와 motion planner를 특정 구현에 묶지: This is an extensible TAMP interface layer paper that connects the task planner and motion planner with a failure predicate rather than tying them to a specific implementation.
로봇이 물체를 옮기고 공간을 이동하려면 symbolic task plan: For a robot to move objects and move through space, both symbolic task planning and continuous motion planning are needed.
논문은 두 planner를 하나의 특수 시스템으로 합치지 않고도 task: The paper addresses the problem of combining task and motion planning without combining the two planners into one special system.
기존 TAMP는 특정 task planner와 motion planner: Many existing TAMPs strongly integrated specific task planners and motion planners, making it difficult to replace and reuse the latest planner.
목표는 off-the-shelf task planner와 motion p: The goal is to connect the off-the-shelf task planner and motion planner with a planner-independent interface layer.
방법은 motion planning 실패를 task-level logic: The method expresses motion planning failure as a task-level logical predicate, and if the high-level plan is physically impossible, the task planner replans by reflecting the constraints.
핵심 아이디어는 continuous failure를 symbolic ex: The core idea is to upload continuous failures as symbolic explanations so that the task planner can use the “why it doesn’t work” as a learned constraint.
검증은 state-of-the-art robotics simulator와: Verification was performed on tasks such as clutter picking, tray utilization, and table setting using a state-of-the-art robotics simulator and PR2 robot.
결과는 다양한 challenging task에서 planner-speci: The results showed that robust plan refinement is possible without planner-specific integration in a variety of challenging tasks.
비교 관점에서 monolithic TAMP보다 유연성과 확장성이 크지만,: From a comparative perspective, it has greater flexibility and scalability than a monolithic TAMP, but overall performance depends on the quality of the failure predicate design.
의의는 TAMP를 모듈식 소프트웨어 아키텍처 문제로 재정의해, symbo: The significance is that it redefines TAMP as a modular software architecture problem, creating a practical interface between symbolic AI and motion planning.
한계는 predicate abstraction이 모든 motion fai: Limitations include that predicate abstraction may not sufficiently explain all motion failures, and complex uncertainties or dynamics are limited.
향후 과제는 learned failure explanations, pro: Future tasks include learned failure explanations, probabilistic TAMP, manipulation under uncertainty, and scalable object rearrangement planning.
자원 공개는 Berkeley/Ptolemy 논문 페이지와 PDF가 확인되: Berkeley/Ptolemy paper pages and PDFs were confirmed to be open resources, but official code and datasets dedicated to the paper were not confirmed.
AB3DMOT는 3D Kalman filter와 Hungarian ass: AB3DMOT is a paper that created a strong 3D MOT baseline using only 3D Kalman filter and Hungarian association and presented new evaluation metrics and open code.
자율주행과 로봇 perception에서 3D multi-object tr: In autonomous driving and robot perception, 3D multi-object tracking is a key module that maintains the state of surrounding agents by temporally connecting detection results.
논문은 3D MOT의 단순하고 강한 baseline과 3D 공간에 맞는: The paper addresses the problem of creating a simple and strong baseline for 3D MOT and a fair evaluation metric suitable for 3D space.
기존 3D MOT 연구는 복잡한 모델에 비해 baseline과 metri: Existing 3D MOT studies had weak baseline and metric standardization compared to complex models, and benchmarks such as KITTI were also biased toward 2D evaluation.
목표는 단순한 실시간 tracker로도 강한 성능을 보이고, 3D MOT: The goal is to demonstrate strong performance as a simple real-time tracker and to release an evaluation tool that can better compare 3D MOTs.
방법은 LiDAR 3D detection을 입력으로 받아 3D Kalma: The method receives LiDAR 3D detection as input, predicts the state with a 3D Kalman filter, and performs data association with the Hungarian algorithm.
핵심 아이디어는 tracking 성능의 상당 부분이 복잡한 deep mo: The key idea is to show that much of the tracking performance comes from better 3D state representation and association baselines than complex deep models.
검증은 KITTI와 nuScenes 3D MOT benchmark에서 오: Validation was performed by offline dataset evaluation on KITTI and nuScenes 3D MOT benchmark.
결과는 KITTI에서 **<strong>207.4 FPS</strong>: As a result, KITTI reports a speed of **207.4 FPS**, showing performance that competes with or surpasses several modern MOT systems even though it is a simple baseline.
비교 관점에서 end-to-end learned tracker보다 단순하: From a comparative perspective, it is simpler, faster, and more reproducible than the end-to-end learned tracker, but is highly dependent on detection quality and Kalman/Hungarian assumptions.
의의는 3D MOT 연구에서 “강한 단순 baseline을 이겨야 한다”: The significance is that it provides criteria and an open evaluation code that “must beat a strong simple baseline” in the 3D MOT study.
한계는 occlusion, long-term re-identificati: Limitations include not deeply addressing occlusion, long-term re-identification, interaction-aware motion, and camera-LiDAR fusion.
향후 과제는 learned motion model, multi-senso: Future tasks include learned motion model, multi-sensor association, uncertainty-aware metrics, and long-tail urban scenario tracking.
자원 공개는 arXiv, CMU PDF/project, xinshuowe: Resource disclosures include arXiv, CMU PDF/project, and xinshuoweng/AB3DMOT official GitHub.
Pedestrian을 목적 지향적으로 행동하는 agent로 보고 max-: This is a navigation paper that views the pedestrian as a goal-oriented agent and predicts future walking using a max-entropy planning model.
사람이 있는 환경에서 로봇은 단순 obstacle avoidance를 넘: In an environment with people, robots must go beyond simple obstacle avoidance and predict where pedestrians will go and reduce obstacles.
논문은 pedestrian future motion을 목적지와 환경 비용: The paper addresses the problem of predicting pedestrian future motion with approximately optimal behavior depending on destination and environmental costs.
기존 예측은 짧은 속도 외삽이나 hand-tuned heuristic에: Existing predictions rely on short-rate extrapolation or hand-tuned heuristics, which do not sufficiently generalize to environmental changes and goal-directed behavior.
목표는 사람의 과거 보행에서 cost function을 학습해 새로운 환: The goal is to perform probabilistic pedestrian prediction in new environments by learning the cost function from a person's past walks.
방법은 Markov decision process와 maximum ent: The method uses the Markov decision process and maximum entropy principle to learn feature-based costs and infer the future trajectory distribution.
핵심 아이디어는 pedestrian을 물리 입자가 아니라 목표를 향해 효: The core idea is to model the pedestrian not as a physical particle but as a planner that moves efficiently toward a goal, but allows for stochastic suboptimality.
검증은 pedestrian trajectory data와 robot pl: Verification was performed through offline prediction and planning performance evaluation in pedestrian trajectory data and robot planning scenarios.
결과는 학습된 planning-based prediction이 로봇 경로: The results showed that the learned planning-based prediction helped the robot path better balance time-to-goal and pedestrian disruption.
비교 관점에서 단순 kinematic predictor보다 환경 feat: From a comparative perspective, it reflects environmental features and destination structure more than a simple kinematic predictor, but is sensitive to target candidate and feature design.
의의는 social navigation과 human-aware plann: The significance is that it is a representative example of connecting inverse optimal control/max-ent IRL to pedestrian prediction in social navigation and human-aware planning.
한계는 crowd interaction, group behavior, b: Limitations include limited coverage of crowd interaction, group behavior, bounded rationality, and real-time large-scale deployment.
향후 과제는 multi-agent intent inference, lea: Future tasks include the impact of multi-agent intent inference, learned scene semantics, online adaptation, and robot action on human behavior.
자원 공개는 CMU RI/저자 페이지와 PDF가 확인되지만, 논문 전용: The CMU RI/author page and PDF were confirmed for resource disclosure, but code and datasets dedicated to the paper were not confirmed.
Stable pushing 방향과 controllability를 분석해,: Stable pushing is a classic nonprehensile manipulation that analyzes the direction and controllability and deliberately moves an object by pushing it without holding it.
로봇이 큰 물체나 잡기 어려운 물체를 다룰 때 pushing은 grasp: When a robot handles large objects or objects that are difficult to grasp, pushing is an important nonprehensile manipulation method that can replace grasping.
논문은 미는 동안 물체가 manipulator에 대해 안정적으로 붙어 움: The paper deals with the problem of planning a pushing path that ensures that the object moves stably against the manipulator during pushing.
기존 pick-and-place 접근은 grasp가 가능하다고 가정하고,: The existing pick-and-place approach assumes that grasp is possible, and single-contact pushing makes it difficult to predict object movement due to support friction uncertainty.
목표는 stable push의 mechanics와 controllabil: The goal is to analyze the mechanics and controllability of a stable push and plan a pushing path between obstacles.
방법은 quasi-static pushing model, center o: The method combines a quasi-static pushing model, center of rotation mapping, point/line contact stability conditions, controllability analysis and planner.
핵심 아이디어는 여러 접촉 또는 안정 접촉 방향을 선택하면 물체가 pus: The key idea is that by choosing multiple contact or stable contact directions, the object will not slip relative to the pusher, resulting in a planable non-holonomic system.
검증은 여러 manipulation task에서 planner demon: Verification is performed through planner demonstration and theoretical analysis in several manipulation tasks, and includes some real/simulated pushing examples.
결과는 stable pushing이 장애물 회피와 물체 재배치를 위한 계: The results showed that stable pushing can be a planable manipulation primitive for obstacle avoidance and object relocation.
비교 관점에서 grasping보다 하드웨어 요구가 낮고 큰 물체에 유리하: From a comparative perspective, it has lower hardware requirements than grasping and is advantageous for large objects, but is more sensitive to the friction model and contact maintenance conditions.
의의는 nonprehensile manipulation을 기하학, 역학,: Its significance is that it is a core reference that connects nonprehensile manipulation to geometry, mechanics, and planning theory.
한계는 quasi-static, planar, known geometry: The limitation is that it has strong quasi-static, planar, and known geometry/friction assumptions, making it difficult to apply directly to complex 3D contact and dynamic pushing.
향후 과제는 tactile/vision feedback, uncertai: Future tasks include tactile/vision feedback, uncertainty-aware pushing, learning-based contact model, and 3D manipulation planning.
자원 공개는 DOI와 공개 PDF 사본은 확인했지만, 코드·데이터셋·프로: For resource disclosure, the DOI and a copy of the public PDF were confirmed, but the code, dataset, and project pages were not confirmed.
Residual RL은 기존 feedback controller가 잘하는: Residual RL is a robot control paper that maintains what existing feedback controllers do well and allows RL to correct only residual errors such as contact/friction.
산업 로봇 제어는 모델 기반 controller가 효율적이지만, 접촉·마: Model-based controllers are efficient in controlling industrial robots, but manual tuning and vulnerability increase in tasks involving contact, friction, and unstable objects.
논문은 기존 controller와 reinforcement learnin: The paper addresses the problem of solving a difficult contact-rich control task in an actual robot by adding an existing controller and reinforcement learning policy.
기존 model-free RL은 sample cost와 안전 문제가 크고: Existing model-free RL has large sample costs and safety issues, and existing feedback control has difficulty modeling contact nonlinearity sufficiently.
목표는 conventional controller가 제공하는 안정적 기본: The goal is to obtain both sample efficiency and performance by learning the RL residual on top of the stable basic behavior provided by the conventional controller.
방법은 최종 control input을 baseline controlle: The method creates the final control input as the sum of the baseline controller output and learned residual action, and learns it from a real-world block assembly task.
핵심 아이디어는 RL이 전체 제어를 처음부터 배우지 않고 모델 오차와 접: The key idea is to structure the action space so that RL learns only the model error and contact compensation without learning the entire control from scratch.
검증은 실제 로봇의 block assembly/contact manipu: Verification is a hardware RL evaluation conducted through block assembly/contact manipulation experiments on an actual robot.

Vote3Deep는 sparse 3D point cloud에서 효율적 c: Vote3Deep is a paper that quickly performs KITTI 3D object detection using efficient convolution and voting in a sparse 3D point cloud.
자율주행 LiDAR perception은 3D point cloud에서: Autonomous LiDAR perception requires rapid detection of vehicles and objects in a 3D point cloud, but dense 3D convolution has high computational costs.
논문은 sparse point cloud를 입력으로 받아 real-tim: The paper addresses the problem of performing close to real-time 3D object detection by receiving a sparse point cloud as input.

비교 관점에서 hand-crafted 3D feature보다 학습 표현이: From a comparative perspective, the learning representation is stronger than hand-crafted 3D features, and sparse computation is more efficient than dense CNN.

향후 과제는 multi-class scaling, camera-LiDAR: Future tasks include combining multi-class scaling, camera-LiDAR fusion, sparse convolution libraries, and temporal tracking.

Safe Flight Corridor를 convex polyhedra로: This paper plans dynamically possible 3D flight of a quadrotor by creating a Safe Flight Corridor as a convex polyhedra and solving the QP polynomial trajectory.
Quadrotor가 복잡한 3D 환경을 빠르게 통과하려면 collisio: For a quadrotor to quickly pass through a complex 3D environment, a trajectory that goes beyond a collision-free path and satisfies differential flatness and dynamic limits is required.

기존 path planner는 geometric safety만 보장하거나: Existing path planners only guarantee geometric safety, or the trajectory optimizer may have poor real-time performance due to non-convex collision constraints.

핵심 아이디어는 복잡한 장애물 회피를 SFC의 선형 부등식 제약으로 바꾸: The core idea is to transform complex obstacle avoidance into linear inequality constraints in SFC and efficiently optimize it together with dynamics constraints.

향후 과제는 receding horizon perception plann: Future tasks include receding horizon perception planning, dynamic obstacle avoidance, probabilistic safety, and integration with aggressive flight controllers.

HRP-2는 일본 HRP 프로젝트의 humanoid platform으로,: HRP-2 is a humanoid platform of the Japanese HRP project and is a representative hardware paper that demonstrates bipedal walking performance and open architecture for research.

목표는 METI HRP phase two에서 개발한 HRP-2가 huma: The goal is to show that HRP-2 developed in METI HRP phase two is a practical platform for humanoid application research.

검증은 HRP-2의 walking, uneven surface 대응, n: Verification was centered on actual hardware demonstrations such as HRP-2's walking, uneven surface response, and narrow path walking.

의의는 humanoid whole-body control, walking: Its significance is that it provides a hardware reference point that has been repeatedly used in humanoid whole-body control, walking, and manipulation studies.

Gifu Hand II는 손가락 내부 구동기와 분산 촉각 센서를 가진 인: Gifu Hand II is a mechatronics paper that presents the design and performance of a humanoid multi-limb robot hand with internal finger actuators and distributed tactile sensors.
Dexterous manipulation을 위해서는 인간 손처럼 여러 자: Dexterous manipulation required an anthropomorphic robot hand with multiple degrees of freedom and tactile information like a human hand.
논문은 Gifu Hand II의 기구 설계, fingertip force: This paper introduces and evaluates the mechanical design of Gifu Hand II, a robotic hand that integrates fingertip force sensing and distributed tactile sensing.
기존 로봇손은 자유도, tactile coverage, 구동기 배치, 인: It was difficult for existing robot hands to simultaneously satisfy the degree of freedom, tactile coverage, actuator placement, and humanoid joint arrangement.
목표는 물체 조작에 적합한 다지 인간형 손과 표면 촉각 센서의 기본 특성: The goal is to experimentally demonstrate the basic properties of a multi-limbed humanoid hand and surface tactile sensors suitable for object manipulation.
방법은 엄지 **4-DOF**, 다른 손가락 **3-DOF** 구조와 f: The method combines the thumb **4-DOF**, other finger **3-DOF** structures, fingertip 6-axis force sensor, and surface **624** detecting point tactile sensor.
핵심 아이디어는 손가락과 손바닥 안에 구동기와 센서를 배치해 인간 손과: The core idea is to provide joint geometry and tactile distribution similar to the human hand by placing actuators and sensors within the fingers and palm.
검증은 tactile sensor 특성 측정과 물체 grasping 중: Verification is an evaluation of the actual hardware, including measuring tactile sensor characteristics and observing pressure distribution during object grasping.
결과는 Gifu Hand II가 인간 손과 유사한 dexterous ma: The results showed that Gifu Hand II has the potential to be used as a dexterous manipulation platform similar to the human hand.
비교 관점에서 단순 그리퍼보다 훨씬 풍부한 조작과 촉각이 가능하지만, 제: From a comparative perspective, it allows for much richer manipulation and tactile sensations than a simple gripper, but also has greater control complexity and mechanical maintenance burden.

SDM Hand는 단일 actuator와 compliant underac: SDM Hand is a paper that proposes an adaptive gripper capable of robust grasp even in large position errors with a single actuator and a compliant underactuated structure.
비정형 환경의 grasping은 물체 위치와 형상이 불확실하므로, 정밀: When grasping in an unstructured environment, the position and shape of the object are uncertain, so mechanical compliance and adaptability may be more important than precise control.
논문은 단순한 구동 구조로 다양한 물체를 안정적으로 잡는 highly a: The paper addresses the problem of designing and evaluating a highly adaptive robotic hand that stably grasps various objects with a simple driving structure.
기존 dexterous hands는 복잡하고 fragile하며 센서와 제: Existing dexterous hands are complex and fragile and require many sensors and controls, making them difficult to operate in unstructured grasping.
목표는 Shape Deposition Manufacturing 기반 co: The goal is to show that a compliant grasper based on Shape Deposition Manufacturing can successfully grasp various objects with large position errors.
방법은 polymer-based SDM 구조, underactuated: The method creates a hand design that uses a polymer-based SDM structure, an underactuated tendon mechanism, and compliant fingers driven by a single actuator.
핵심 아이디어는 control complexity를 줄이고 손 자체의 m: The core idea is to reduce control complexity and allow the hand's own mechanical intelligence to absorb object shape and pose uncertainty.

결과는 SDM Hand가 큰 impact를 견디고 낮은 acquisiti: The results showed that the SDM Hand could withstand a large impact and grasp objects of a wide range of sizes, shapes, and positions with low acquisition contact force.

FastSLAM에 unknown data association을 통합해: This paper expands Rao-Blackwellized particle filtering in SLAM where landmark correspondence is uncertain by incorporating unknown data association into FastSLAM.
SLAM에서 data association은 관측이 어떤 landmark: In SLAM, data association is a key challenge in determining which landmark an observation corresponds to, and incorrect correspondence greatly ruins the map and pose.
논문은 landmark association이 알려져 있지 않은 상황에서: The paper addresses the problem of performing SLAM while maintaining FastSLAM posterior factorization in situations where landmark associations are unknown.
기존 EKF-SLAM은 landmark 수가 많을 때 계산이 커지고, 잘: The existing EKF-SLAM requires large calculations when the number of landmarks is large and is vulnerable to incorrect nearest-neighbor associations.
목표는 particle별 robot path와 조건부 landmark e: The goal is to efficiently handle association uncertainty while maintaining the robot path and conditional landmark estimate for each particle.
방법은 Rao-Blackwellized particle filter의 각: The method updates the association hypothesis and landmark EKF within each particle of the Rao-Blackwellized particle filter and speeds up map access with a tree structure.
핵심 아이디어는 data association의 여러 가능성을 parti: The core idea is to distribute multiple possibilities of data associations across the particle set, reducing the risk of a single hard decision ruining the entire SLAM.
검증은 synthetic 및 real indoor SLAM scenari: Verification is performed through synthetic and real indoor SLAM scenarios and large landmark map evaluation, and the paper reports the possibility of scaling up to **50,000** landmarks.
결과는 unknown association에서도 FastSLAM이 EKF: The results showed that FastSLAM can operate more scalably than EKF-SLAM even in unknown associations.
비교 관점에서 EKF-SLAM보다 landmark 수 scaling이 유: From a comparative perspective, landmark number scaling is more advantageous than EKF-SLAM, but particle depletion and proposal distribution quality problems remain.
의의는 particle-filter SLAM이 대규모 feature ma: Significance is that it is a key paper that shows that particle-filter SLAM can handle large-scale feature maps and data association uncertainty.
한계는 feature-based landmark assumption이 강: The limitation is that the feature-based landmark assumption is strong, and association ambiguity is still difficult in dense mapping or severe perceptual aliasing.
향후 과제는 improved proposals, loop closure: Future tasks include improved proposals, loop closure robustness, semantic association, and combination of graph-SLAM and particle methods.

BIT*는 batch sampling으로 만든 implicit rando: BIT* is a paper that combines graph search and sampling-based optimal planning by heuristically exploring an implicit random geometric graph created through batch sampling.
고차원 motion planning은 sampling 기반 접근이 실용적: Although a sampling-based approach is practical for high-dimensional motion planning, the ordered search advantages of graph search are also needed to quickly converge to a good solution.
논문은 asymptotically optimal sampling plan: The paper addresses the problem of allowing an asymptotically optimal sampling planner to find initial and improved solutions more efficiently.
기존 RRT*는 anytime optimality가 있지만 탐색이 충분히: Existing RRT* has anytime optimality, but the search is not sufficiently ordered, and graph search has a high cost of generating continuous state space approximations.
목표는 informed sampling, random geometric: The goal is to propose a planner BIT* that integrates informed sampling, random geometric graph, and A*-style heuristic search.
방법은 batch로 sample을 추가해 implicit RGG를 만들고: The method creates an implicit RGG by adding samples in batches, and expands the edge queue and vertex queue in heuristic lower bound order.
핵심 아이디어는 sample set을 그래프로 명시적으로 모두 만들지 않: The core idea is to explore increasingly dense graphs, checking only potentially good edges for collisions, without explicitly creating the entire sample set as a graph.
검증은 abstract planning problems와 HERB 같은: Verification is an offline benchmark evaluation that compares RRT*, RRT#, FMT*, etc. in abstract planning problems and robot planning examples such as HERB.
결과는 BIT*가 초기 해와 solution improvement에서 강: The results show that BIT* shows strong anytime performance in the initial solution and solution improvement, and has probabilistically complete and asymptotically optimal properties.
비교 관점에서 RRT*의 incremental sampling과 FMT*: From a comparative perspective, it connects the incremental sampling of RRT* and the ordered graph search of FMT*/A* to compromise the advantages of both.
의의는 optimal sampling-based planning의 이론: The significance is that it is a representative planner that integrates the theoretical genealogy of optimal sampling-based planning and has spread into practical use through OMPL implementation.
한계는 collision checking cost, heuristic 품: Performance is limited by collision checking cost, heuristic quality, narrow passage, and kinodynamic steering availability.
향후 과제는 kinodynamic BIT*, informed heuris: Future tasks include combining kinodynamic BIT*, informed heuristics, batch size adaptation, and learning-guided sampling.

상용 FDM 3D printer와 printable elastomer로: This paper produced a high-force soft pneumatic actuator with a complex internal shape using a commercial FDM 3D printer and printable elastomer.
Soft pneumatic actuator는 안전하고 유연하지만, 복잡한: Soft pneumatic actuators are safe and flexible, but the process of manufacturing them to have complex internal channels and high forces at the same time was time-consuming.
논문은 저가 open-source consumer 3D printer로: The paper addresses the problem of directly printing a soft pneumatic actuator with a low-cost open-source consumer 3D printer and using it for soft robotic applications.
기존 casting이나 molding 방식은 다단계 공정이 필요하고, 복: Existing casting or molding methods require a multi-step process, and it is difficult to quickly and repeatedly manufacture complex internal geometry and high-degree-of-freedom structures.
목표는 상용 재료와 FDM printer로 airtight하고 high-: The goal is to show that an airtight, high-force soft pneumatic actuator can be made using commercial materials and an FDM printer.
방법은 printable flexible material, interna: The method combines printable flexible material, internal pneumatic chamber geometry, and experimental blocked force and motion characterization.

검증은 출력한 actuator의 힘, 변형, pressure respon: Verification is an evaluation of actual hardware, including force, deformation, pressure response and gripper/soft robotic application demonstration of the printed actuator.

의의는 soft robotics 제작을 maker-friendly add: The significance is that it is an early high-impact case that expanded the production of soft robotics to maker-friendly additive manufacturing.

Human-aware planner는 로봇 경로가 사람의 안전, 시야,: Human-aware planner is a social navigation paper designed to ensure that robot paths take into account human safety, visibility, comfort, and interaction constraints.
서비스 로봇이 사람과 같은 공간을 이동하려면 최단 경로보다 안전하고 예의: For service robots to move through the same space as people, they must create safer and more polite movements than the shortest path.
논문은 사람 주변을 지나는 mobile robot motion plann: The paper addresses the problem of a mobile robot motion planner that passes around people taking into account human comfort and social constraints.
기존 motion planner는 장애물 충돌 회피와 기하학적 최적화에: Existing motion planners were focused on obstacle collision avoidance and geometric optimization, and did not sufficiently reflect a person's field of view, personal space, and interaction legibility.
목표는 사람을 단순 장애물이 아니라 visibility, safety,: The goal is to create a planner that models people not as simple obstacles but as social entities with visibility, safety, hidden zones, and comfort.
방법은 사람 위치와 자세를 기준으로 cost map과 constraint: The method constructs a cost map and constraints based on person location and posture, and reflects human-aware costs in global/local planning.
핵심 아이디어는 “충돌하지 않음”보다 더 강한 사회적 기준을 cost f: The core idea is to evaluate the quality of the robot path by incorporating a stronger social standard than “no collision” into the cost function.
검증은 human-aware navigation scenario에서 pl: Verification is an evaluation centered on simulation and robot experiments that show planner results in a human-aware navigation scenario.
결과는 로봇이 사람 앞을 갑자기 가로지르거나 너무 가까이 접근하는 경로를: The results showed that the robot was able to avoid paths that suddenly cross in front of people or approach too closely and create more natural motions.
비교 관점에서 전통 geometric planner보다 사회적으로 수용: From a comparative perspective, it creates a more socially acceptable path than traditional geometric planners, but requires human models and cost weight tuning.
의의는 social navigation에서 personal space와: The significance is that it is a representative early paper that included personal space and visibility as motion planning objectives in social navigation.
한계는 문화·상황별 social norm, 다중 보행자 동역학, 사람 의: Limitations include simplification of cultural/situational social norms, multi-pedestrian dynamics, and human intention estimation.

논문은 정확한 동역학 파라미터를 모르는 manipulator가 원하는 t: The paper deals with the adaptive control problem that allows a manipulator that does not know the exact dynamics parameters to stably follow the desired trajectory.
기존 computed-torque control은 모델 파라미터 정확성에: Existing computed-torque control relies on model parameter accuracy, so compensation performance is weakened if there are payload changes or identification errors.

결과는 모델 불확실성 아래에서도 trajectory tracking er: The results showed that trajectory tracking error could be stably reduced even under model uncertainty, creating a standard flow for adaptive robot control.
비교 관점에서 fixed model computed-torque보다 pa: From a comparative perspective, it is stronger in parameter variation than fixed model computed-torque, but has limitations in persistence of excitation and unmodeled dynamics.
의의는 로봇 동역학의 구조를 이용한 Lyapunov adaptive co: The significance is that it is a key reference that widely publicized Lyapunov adaptive control using the structure of robot dynamics.
한계는 friction, actuator saturation, flexi: The limitation is that if non-model elements such as friction, actuator saturation, flexible joint, and contact dynamics are large, the theoretical guarantee becomes weak.

Vector Field Histogram(VFH)은 sonar 기반 hi: Vector Field Histogram (VFH) is a paper that implements real-time obstacle avoidance of a fast mobile robot using a sonar-based histogram grid and polar histogram.
초기 모바일 로봇은 불확실한 초음파 센서로도 좁고 복잡한 환경에서 멈추지: Early mobile robots had to move quickly without stopping in narrow and complex environments, even with uncertain ultrasonic sensors.
논문은 cluttered environment에서 목표 방향으로 진행하면: The paper deals with the problem of avoiding unknown obstacles in real time while moving toward a goal in a cluttered environment.
기존 potential field와 virtual force field는: Existing potential fields and virtual force fields were often unstable in narrow passage, oscillation, and noisy sonar reading processing.
목표는 range sensor 정보를 누적해 local obstacle: The goal is to propose a VFH method that accumulates range sensor information to calculate local obstacle density and generates fast steering commands.
방법은 2D Cartesian Histogram Grid를 계속 갱신하고: The method continuously updates the 2D Cartesian Histogram Grid, abbreviates it to a robot-centered 1D Polar Histogram, and selects low obstacle density sectors.
핵심 아이디어는 noisy range data를 순간 반발력으로 쓰지 않: The core idea is to select a stable avoidance direction by accumulating and compressing the noisy range data into local histogram density rather than using it as an instantaneous repulsion force.
검증은 초음파 센서가 달린 실제 모바일 로봇이 densely clutte: Verification was conducted through a hardware experiment in which an actual mobile robot equipped with an ultrasonic sensor drove a densely cluttered obstacle course.
결과는 평균 속도 약 **<strong>0.7 m/s</strong>**: The results showed that VFH enables real-time obstacle avoidance without stopping when driving at an average speed of about **0.7 m/s**.
비교 관점에서 potential-field류보다 narrow corrid: From a comparative perspective, it is stronger against narrow corridor and sensor noise than potential-field types, but does not provide global optimality or dynamic obstacle prediction.
의의는 occupancy/histogram 기반 local obstacl: Its significance is that it is a classic example of occupancy/histogram-based local obstacle avoidance, and later influenced real-time navigation research of VFH+ and DWA types.
한계는 local reactive planner라 trap 상황과 glo: The limitation is that it is a local reactive planner, so it is limited in trap situations, global path feasibility, high-speed dynamics limitations, and complex moving obstacles.
향후 과제는 global planner와의 결합, dynamic obst: Future tasks include integration with global planner, dynamic obstacle prediction, velocity constraints, and learned local costmap integration.

고정익 UAV의 저가 IMU attitude estimation에서 가속: This is a nonlinear complementary filter paper that corrects the gas acceleration component of the accelerometer in low-cost IMU attitude estimation of fixed-wing UAV.
고정익 UAV는 저가 IMU만으로 attitude를 추정해야 할 때가 많: Fixed-wing UAVs often need to estimate attitude using only low-cost IMUs, but during turns, accelerometers measure not only gravity but also aircraft acceleration.
논문은 accelerometer와 gyroscope를 결합해 fixed-: The paper addresses the problem of robust estimation of fixed-wing UAV attitude by combining an accelerometer and gyroscope.
기존 complementary filter는 accelerometer가: The existing complementary filter assumes that the accelerometer provides the direction of gravity, so errors may increase in fixed-wing flights with fast turns and large angle-of-attack changes.
목표는 airframe acceleration을 보정해 maneuver: The goal is to obtain a more stable gravitational direction estimate during maneuver by correcting the airframe acceleration.
방법은 nonlinear complementary filter에 airs: The method adds an airspeed-based centripetal acceleration model and angle-of-attack first-order dynamics to a nonlinear complementary filter.
핵심 아이디어는 가속도계 측정에서 비중력 가속도를 모델로 빼고, gyro: The key idea is to model the non-gravitational acceleration from the accelerometer measurements and combine the high-frequency information from the gyro with the low-frequency reference from the accelerometer.
검증은 Australian Centre for Field Robotics: Validation is an offline evaluation comparing full GPS/INS output from real-world fixed-wing UAV flight data from the Australian Center for Field Robotics.
결과는 기본 complementary filter보다 maneuverin: The results showed that it provided a more accurate attitude estimate under maneuvering fixed-wing conditions than the basic complementary filter.
비교 관점에서 full GPS/INS보다 저가·경량이지만, airspee: In comparative terms, it is cheaper and lighter than full GPS/INS, but relies on airspeed measurement and the effectiveness of a simple flight dynamics model.
의의는 소형 UAV의 practical state estimation에서: The significance is that it is a representative example of combining complementary filters with vehicle dynamics in practical state estimation of small UAVs.
한계는 극단적 maneuver, sensor bias drift, air: Limitations include that the calibration model may break down in extreme maneuvers, sensor bias drift, airspeed errors, and complex aerodynamics.
향후 과제는 online bias estimation, adaptive: Future tasks include online bias estimation, adaptive aerodynamic model, visual-inertial/GNSS fusion, and aggressive flight validation.

SuMa++는 surfel-based LiDAR SLAM에 semanti: SuMa++ is a paper that combines surfel-based LiDAR SLAM with semantic segmentation to reduce dynamic object influence and create meaningful maps.
자율주행 LiDAR SLAM은 큰 outdoor scene에서 빠르고 정: Autonomous LiDAR SLAM must be fast and accurate in large outdoor scenes, but dynamic objects such as moving cars and people contaminate odometry and maps.
논문은 LiDAR scan의 semantic label을 이용해 odom: The paper addresses the semantic SLAM problem of improving odometry and mapping using semantic labels of LiDAR scans.
기존 surfel-based LiDAR SLAM은 geometry만 사용: Existing surfel-based LiDAR SLAM used only geometry, so there was a risk of putting dynamic objects into the map as static structures or mixing them into pose estimation.
목표는 semantic segmentation 결과를 LiDAR SLAM: The goal is to simultaneously obtain dynamic object filtering and semantically enriched maps by inserting the semantic segmentation results into the LiDAR SLAM pipeline.
방법은 range image 기반 LiDAR semantic segmen: The method uses range image-based LiDAR semantic segmentation and performs label-aware surfel map update and pose estimation.
핵심 아이디어는 “무엇이 움직일 수 있는가”라는 semantic prio: The core idea is to reduce incorrect static assumptions by injecting a semantic prior of “what can move” into geometry-based SLAM.
검증은 KITTI/SemanticKITTI 계열 outdoor LiDAR: Verification was performed with offline SLAM evaluation on the KITTI/SemanticKITTI series outdoor LiDAR sequence.
결과는 semantic filtering이 동적 물체가 많은 장면에서 m: The results showed that semantic filtering can improve mapping quality and localization robustness in scenes with many dynamic objects.
비교 관점에서 순수 SuMa/LOAM류 geometric SLAM보다 d: From a comparative perspective, it has stronger dynamic scene response than pure SuMa/LOAM type geometric SLAM, but depends on segmentation model performance.
의의는 semantic perception과 classical LiDAR: Its significance is that it is a practical pipeline that combines semantic perception and classical LiDAR SLAM, and has become a representative public implementation of semantic SLAM.
한계는 label error가 SLAM에 전파되고, rare class나: The limitation is that label errors are propagated to SLAM, and semantic priors may be weakened in rare classes, unseen objects, and weather/domain shifts.
향후 과제는 uncertainty-aware semantic fusion: Future tasks include uncertainty-aware semantic fusion, panoptic/dynamic object tracking, online learning, and lifelong semantic map maintenance.

PL-SLAM은 point feature와 line segment를 함께: PL-SLAM is a paper that robustly performs stereo visual SLAM even in scenes with little texture by using point features and line segments together.
Visual SLAM은 점 특징이 풍부한 장면에서 강하지만, 복도나 인공: Visual SLAM is strong in scenes with abundant point features, but in low-texture environments with a lot of line geometry, such as corridors or artificial structures, point alone may be insufficient.
논문은 stereo camera에서 points와 line segment: The paper addresses the problem of performing more robust SLAM by tracking and optimizing points and line segments together in a stereo camera.
기존 point-based SLAM은 low-texture나 반복 패턴: Existing point-based SLAM lacks the number and distribution of features in low-texture or repetitive pattern scenes, which can make tracking and mapping unstable.
목표는 점과 선의 complementary geometry를 하나의 st: The goal is to increase stability in various environments by incorporating complementary geometry of points and lines into a single stereo SLAM backend.
방법은 point feature와 line segment를 추출·매칭하고: The method extracts and matches point features and line segments, and uses the reprojection error of both feature types together in stereo depth and graph optimization.
핵심 아이디어는 인공 환경에 흔한 직선 구조를 landmark로 활용해: The core idea is to use straight structures common in artificial environments as landmarks to reinforce geometric constraints in areas with weak point features.

비교 관점에서 ORB-SLAM2 같은 point-based system보: From a comparative perspective, it uses more structural line information than a point-based system such as ORB-SLAM2, but line extraction and matching costs are added.
의의는 point-line SLAM 계열에서 stereo backend와: The significance is that it demonstrated the practicality of line landmarks through a stereo backend and public implementation in the point-line SLAM series.
한계는 line feature가 적거나 동적 구조가 많은 장면, ligh: Limitations may be beneficial in scenes with few line features or a lot of dynamic structure, lighting changes, and line association ambiguity.
향후 과제는 semantic/structural regularity, M: Future tasks include semantic/structural regularity, Manhattan/world constraints, point-line-inertial fusion, and dynamic line rejection.

동적 batting task에서 local controller들을 순차적: This is a behavior-based control paper that attempts to ensure stability and goal reachability by sequentially composing local controllers in a dynamic batting task.
동적으로 빠른 로봇 행동은 하나의 전역 controller로 설계하기 어: Dynamically fast robot behavior is difficult to design with a single global controller, and local behavior must be switched stably for each situation.
논문은 공을 paddle로 반복적으로 쳐서 장애물을 지나 목표 위치에 안: The paper deals with a dynamically dexterous task in which a ball is repeatedly struck with a paddle to pass an obstacle and stabilize at a target location.
기존 behavior-based robotics는 여러 controlle: Existing behavior-based robotics connected multiple controllers, but it was difficult to formally guarantee transition stability and goal attainment.
목표는 local feedback controller들의 domain과: The goal is to compose the entire action in sequential composition using the domain and goal relations of local feedback controllers.

핵심 아이디어는 전역 복잡 동역학을 한 번에 풀지 않고, 안정적인 loc: The key idea is to connect stable local policy pieces so that they contain each other's target sets, rather than solving global complex dynamics at once.

결과는 공이 safe workspace에 들어오면 controller s: The results experimentally showed that when the ball enters the safe workspace, the controller sequence can operate to take the ball to the goal.
비교 관점에서 단순 reactive behavior보다 안정성 구조가 명: From a comparative perspective, the stability structure is clearer than that of simple reactive behavior, but the manual burden of designing the controller library and domain is high.
의의는 behavior composition을 직관적 subsumptio: The significance is that it is a classic example of elevating behavior composition to a formal control composition problem rather than an intuitive substitution.

UAV의 넓은 시야와 UGV의 정밀 지상 확인 능력을 결합해 cooper: This is a multi-robot systems paper that performs cooperative surveillance and target localization by combining the wide field of view of UAV and the precise ground identification ability of UGV.
넓은 영역 감시는 빠르게 훑는 aerial robot과 정밀하게 지상 목: Wide-area surveillance complements the advantages of an aerial robot that quickly scans and a ground robot that precisely checks ground targets.
논문은 UAV와 UGV가 함께 목표를 찾고 위치를 정밀화하는 cooper: The paper addresses the cooperative air-ground surveillance problem in which UAVs and UGVs work together to find targets and refine their locations.
기존 단일 플랫폼 감시는 UAV의 localization accuracy: Existing single-platform surveillance is difficult to satisfy both wide space and accuracy due to the lack of localization accuracy of UAVs or limitations in movement and visibility of UGVs.
목표는 여러 UAV/UGV를 하나의 sensor network처럼 사용해: The goal is to present a framework that scalably performs search and localization using multiple UAVs/UGVs as a sensor network.

검증은 GRASP 계열 cooperative air-ground test: Verification was conducted through actual robot/sensor network experiments conducted at a GRASP-affiliated cooperative air-ground testbed and reporting of the results.

비교 관점에서 pure UAV surveillance보다 localiza: From a comparative perspective, localization is more accurate than pure UAV surveillance and coverage is wider than pure UGV search, but communication and coordination complexity increases.
의의는 heterogeneous multi-robot surveillan: The significance is that it is a representative example that clearly shows the mission structure and experimental platform of air-ground teaming in heterogeneous multi-robot surveillance.

동적 사족보행 연구는 알고리즘뿐 아니라 충격을 견디는 경량 고성능 하드웨: Dynamic quadrupedal walking research starts from the context that not only algorithms but also lightweight, high-performance hardware that can withstand impacts are needed.

기존 대형 사족 로봇은 비싸고 무거우며 유지보수가 어려워 많은 제어 실험: Existing large four-legged robots are expensive, heavy, and difficult to maintain, making it difficult to quickly repeat many control experiments.
목표는 고성능 동작을 견디면서도 조립과 수리가 쉬운 소형 사족 로봇을 만: The goal is to lower the experimental barrier for dynamic control research by creating a small quadruped robot that can withstand high-performance motion while being easy to assemble and repair.
방법은 모듈형 다리, 고토크 밀도 구동기, 낮은 다리 관성, 충격 친화적: The method is the implementation of a four-legged platform combining modular legs, high-torque density actuators, low leg inertia, and impact-friendly mechanism design.
핵심 아이디어는 제어 성능을 소프트웨어만의 문제가 아니라 모터, 감속기,: The key idea is to view control performance not only as a software issue, but as a platform design issue that includes motors, reducers, leg mass, and structural rigidity.

결과는 소형 플랫폼에서도 높은 기동성과 반복 실험 가능성을 보였지만 논문: The results showed high mobility and repeatability even on a small platform, but detailed quantitative comparison of all conditions at the paper abstract level is limited.
비교는 BigDog류 대형 플랫폼이나 이전 MIT Cheetah 계열보다: The comparison focuses on the fact that it is a smaller and more experiment-friendly design than the large BigDog-type platform or the previous MIT Cheetah series.
의의는 사족보행 알고리즘을 고가 대형 장비가 아니라 널리 재현 가능한 연: The significance is that it allows the quadrupedal walking algorithm to be verified on a widely reproducible research platform rather than large, expensive equipment.
한계는 하드웨어 중심 논문이라 보행 지능 자체의 일반화나 험지 장기 자율: The limitation is that since it is a hardware-focused paper, it does not directly address the generalization of walking intelligence itself or long-term autonomy in rough terrain.
향후 과제는 공개 하드웨어 생태계, 더 강건한 전신 제어, 야외 장기 주: Future challenges include combining open hardware ecosystems, more robust whole-body control, outdoor long-term driving, and learning-based gait.
자원 공개는 DOI와 MIT Biomimetic Robotics 자료,: Resource disclosure includes DOI, MIT Biomimetic Robotics data, and related Cheetah-Software repositories, but it is not confirmed whether the entire CAD version of the paper is disclosed.
CALVIN은 언어 지시를 긴 조작 시퀀스로 접지하는 능력을 평가하기 위: CALVIN is a benchmark that provides a simulation environment, data, and baseline to evaluate the ability to ground verbal instructions into long manipulation sequences.
언어 기반 로봇 조작은 단일 명령 수행을 넘어 여러 기술을 순서대로 조합: Language-based robot manipulation must expand beyond the execution of single commands to the long-term task of combining multiple skills in sequence.
논문은 자연어 지시, 시각 관측, 연속 제어를 결합해 긴 수평선의 테이블: The paper addresses the problem of evaluating tabletop manipulation of long horizontal lines by combining natural language instructions, visual observation, and continuous control.
기존 비전-언어 조작 벤치마크는 작업 길이와 언어 다양성, 환경 일반화가: Existing vision-language manipulation benchmarks do not sufficiently reveal long-term combination abilities due to limitations in task length, language diversity, and environmental generalization.
목표는 다양한 센서 설정과 미지 언어·환경 조건에서 정책의 조합적 일반화: The goal is to create a public benchmark that can measure the combinatorial generalization of policies across a variety of sensor settings and unknown language and environmental conditions.
방법은 PyBullet 기반 CALVIN 환경, 언어 주석이 붙은 데모: The method provides a PyBullet-based CALVIN environment, language annotated demo data, multi-context imitation learning baseline, and evaluation protocol.
핵심 아이디어는 조작 스킬을 단일 성공률이 아니라 언어로 지정된 여러 하: The key idea is to evaluate manipulative skill not as a single success rate, but as a series of successes across multiple verbally specified subgoals.
검증은 시뮬레이션 조작 환경에서 기존 imitation baseline을: Verification learns the existing imitation baseline in a simulation operation environment and compares the success rate in a known environment and a new environment and instructions.
결과는 baseline이 긴 체인 과제에서 낮은 성능을 보여 CALVIN: The results show that the baseline shows low performance in long-chain tasks, revealing that CALVIN is not already a saturated benchmark.
비교는 단일 작업 imitation이나 짧은 horizon VLM ben: The comparison is different in that it requires longer instruction combinations and environment transitions than single task imitation or the short horizon VLM benchmark.
의의는 이후 VLA와 language-conditioned policy: The significance is that it provides a basis for future VLA and language-conditioned policy studies to use as a common test bed to compare long-term manipulation performance.
한계는 시뮬레이션 중심이라 실제 로봇 접촉, 센서 노이즈, 장기 하드웨어: The limitation is that since it is simulation-oriented, it does not directly verify actual robot contact, sensor noise, and long-term hardware failure.
향후 과제는 실제 로봇 전이, 더 긴 작업 그래프, 대규모 foundat: Future work includes evaluation of real robot transitions, longer task graphs, large-scale foundation model policies, failure recovery, and user re-questioning.
자원 공개는 arXiv, GitHub, 데이터 다운로드 스크립트가 확인되: As for resource disclosure, arXiv, GitHub, and data download scripts have been confirmed, and it is believed that code and data have been made public.
EV-FlowNet은 이벤트 카메라의 비동기 이벤트를 영상형 표현으로 바: EV-FlowNet is an early deep learning method that converts asynchronous events of an event camera into video representation and self-supervised learning of optical flow using photometric signals of grayscale images.
이벤트 카메라는 고속 운동과 HDR 장면에 강하지만 기존 프레임 기반 o: Event cameras are strong in high-speed motion and HDR scenes, but it is difficult to apply existing frame-based optical flow algorithms as is.
논문은 ground-truth flow 없이 이벤트 스트림만으로 dens: The paper addresses the problem of finding a learning-based method to predict dense optical flow with only event streams without ground-truth flow.
기존 이벤트 비전 방법은 수작업 모델 의존도가 높고 지도학습에 필요한 라: Existing event vision methods were highly dependent on manual models and lacked the label data needed for supervised learning.
목표는 이벤트 입력을 사용하면서도 동시 취득되는 grayscale ima: The goal is to train a self-supervised flow network using event input and simultaneously acquired grayscale images as learning signals.
방법은 event tensor를 U-Net류 encoder-decoder: The method uses photometric loss and smoothness loss that insert the event tensor into a U-Net type encoder-decoder and warp adjacent images with a prediction flow.
핵심 아이디어는 이벤트 카메라가 주는 sparse asynchronous: The key idea is to transform the sparse asynchronous measurement provided by the event camera into an optical flow magnetic map problem rather than an image reconstruction problem.
검증은 MVSEC의 indoor_flying과 outdoor_day 계열: Verification is an offline dataset experiment that evaluates optical flow prediction from MVSEC's indoor_flying and outdoor_day series data.
결과는 이벤트만 입력해도 프레임 기반 방법과 경쟁 가능한 flow를 만들: The results showed that it was possible to create a flow that could compete with frame-based methods by only inputting events, but this is not a claim that it overpowers supervised learning SOTA in all scenes.
비교는 이미지 기반 flow network와 이벤트 전용 hand-cra: The comparison is based on both an image-based flow network and an event-only hand-crafted approach, and its strength is that it learns without labels.
의의는 이후 이벤트 optical flow, event represent: Significance has since become one of the standard starting points for research on event optical flow, event representation, and self-supervised event perception.
한계는 grayscale image가 학습 supervision에 필요하: The limitation is that grayscale images are required for learning supervision, and since it is an open code based on TensorFlow 1.x and Python 2, reproducibility may be burdensome in the current environment.
향후 과제는 순수 이벤트 supervision, recurrent tem: Future tasks include pure event supervision, recurrent temporal modeling, generalization of the latest event dataset, and real-time low-power distribution.
자원 공개는 RSS PDF, arXiv, 공식 GitHub, MVSEC: Resource disclosures include RSS PDF, arXiv, official GitHub, and MVSEC data links, and code availability takes into account older dependencies.
Ultimate SLAM은 이벤트, 프레임 이미지, IMU를 결합해 고속: Ultimate SLAM is a multimodal SLAM system that reduces the vulnerability of visual SLAM under high-speed and high-dynamic range conditions by combining events, frame images, and IMU.
Visual SLAM은 빠른 움직임과 HDR 조명에서 motion blu: Visual SLAM easily breaks down pose tracking due to motion blur and exposure failure under fast movement and HDR lighting.
논문은 표준 카메라, event camera, IMU를 함께 사용해 까다: The paper addresses the problem of maintaining state estimation even under challenging visual conditions using a combination of standard cameras, event cameras, and IMUs.
기존 프레임 기반 SLAM은 고속 장면에 약하고 이벤트 기반 방법은 독립: Existing frame-based SLAM is weak in high-speed scenes, and event-based methods lack map and reinitialization information to be used independently.
목표는 이벤트의 시간 해상도, 이미지의 풍부한 texture, IMU의: The goal is to present a robust visual-inertial SLAM that combines the temporal resolution of events, rich texture of images, and inertial prediction of IMU.
방법은 event feature tracking, image featur: The method integrates event feature tracking, image feature tracking, IMU preintegration, sliding-window optimization, and relocalization configuration.
핵심 아이디어는 이벤트를 보조 센서가 아니라 프레임이 실패하는 순간 po: The key idea is to use the event not as a secondary sensor, but as the primary visual signal that bridges the pose constraint when a frame fails.
검증은 HDR 및 고속 회전·이동 조건을 포함한 event-camera: Verification evaluates estimation performance on the event-camera dataset and actual sensor sequences, including HDR and high-speed rotation/movement conditions.
결과는 프레임-only 또는 이벤트 없는 구성보다 challenging: The results show a stronger trend in terms of tracking maintenance and accuracy in challenging sequences than in frame-only or event-free configurations.
비교는 standard visual-inertial pipeline과 e: The comparison shows the complementarity of sensor combinations compared to the standard visual-inertial pipeline and the event-only·image-only variant.
의의는 이벤트 카메라가 visual SLAM의 극한 조건을 보완할 수 있: The significance is that it convincingly demonstrated at the system level that event cameras can compensate for the extreme conditions of visual SLAM.
한계는 특수 event camera와 정확한 multi-sensor ca: The limitation is that it requires a special event camera and accurate multi-sensor calibration, and is difficult to apply directly with general consumer sensors.
향후 과제는 더 간단한 calibration, dense event ma: Future challenges include simpler calibration, dense event mapping, learning-based event front-end, and low-power embedded implementation.
자원 공개는 arXiv, RPG 프로젝트 페이지, uzh-rpg 공개 G: Resource disclosure is confirmed on arXiv, RPG project page, and uzh-rpg public GitHub.
MVX-Net은 이미지 feature를 LiDAR voxel repres: MVX-Net combines image features with LiDAR voxel representation to handle camera-LiDAR fusion in autonomous driving 3D object detection as a single stage network.
자율주행 perception은 LiDAR의 3D geometry와 카메라: Autonomous driving perception can expect stronger 3D detection when utilizing LiDAR's 3D geometry and camera's dense semantic cue together.
논문은 point cloud 기반 VoxelNet에 이미지 정보를 어떻게: The paper addresses the multimodal 3D object detection problem of how to effectively inject image information into point cloud-based VoxelNet.
기존 early fusion은 센서 정합과 표현 차이 때문에 정보 손실이: Existing early fusion had the limitation of information loss due to differences in sensor matching and expression, and late fusion had the limitation of weak modality interaction.
목표는 VoxelNet 구조 안에서 image feature와 LiDAR: The goal is to improve KITTI 3D detection performance by combining image features and LiDAR voxel features within the VoxelNet structure.
방법은 2D CNN image feature를 3D point 또는 vo: The method matches 2D CNN image features with 3D point or voxel positions and integrates them into VoxelNet through point-fusion and voxel-fusion transformations.
핵심 아이디어는 raw sensor를 무작정 합치기보다 calibrati: The key idea is to use calibration to bring image features into the LiDAR voxel learning space rather than blindly merging raw sensors.
검증은 KITTI 3D object detection benchmark에: Verification is an offline dataset evaluation performed with BEV and 3D detection metrics on the KITTI 3D object detection benchmark.
결과는 KITTI에서 당시 multimodal 방법과 경쟁적이며 arXi: The results were competitive with the multimodal method at the time in KITTI and reported top-2 level performance in multiple categories based on arXiv abstracts.
비교는 LiDAR-only VoxelNet과 기존 multimodal d: The comparison targets LiDAR-only VoxelNet and existing multimodal detectors, and a strong LiDAR backbone is used as a fusion baseline.
의의는 이후 camera-LiDAR fusion 연구가 feature-l: Significance: It provided one of the initial structures that later camera-LiDAR fusion research often referred to when designing feature-level alignment.
한계는 KITTI 중심 평가라 복잡한 날씨·야간·센서 failure 조건: The limitation is that because it is a KITTI-centered evaluation, generalization has not been sufficiently verified under complex weather, night, and sensor failure conditions.
향후 과제는 transformer fusion, uncertainty-a: Future tasks include transformer fusion, uncertainty-aware calibration, and robust fusion in long-range objects and adverse weather.
자원 공개는 DOI와 arXiv는 확인되지만 논문 공식 GitHub는 확: Resource disclosure is confirmed through DOI and arXiv, but not through the paper's official GitHub.
Nearness Diagram navigation은 복잡한 근접 장애물: Nearness diagram navigation is a classic local navigation method that performs mobile robot collision avoidance by structuring the sensor space in complex nearby obstacle situations.
실내 mobile robot navigation은 global path가: Indoor mobile robot navigation requires quick local avoidance around narrow passages and complex obstacles even if there is a global path.
논문은 로봇 주변의 거리 정보를 이용해 충돌 없이 목표 쪽으로 진행하는: The paper addresses the problem of local reactive navigation, which uses distance information around a robot to proceed toward a goal without collision.
기존 potential field류 방법은 local minima와 좁은: Existing potential field methods are vulnerable to local minima and narrow space vibrations, and action selection can be unstable in complex obstacle arrangements.
목표는 troublesome scenario에서도 안전성과 진행성을 유지: The goal is to create a rule-based local navigation system that maintains safety and progress even in troublesome scenarios.
방법은 주변 거리 정보를 nearness diagram으로 나누고 상황: The method divides the surrounding distance information into a nearness diagram and determines gap selection and motion command according to the situation class.
핵심 아이디어는 모든 장애물을 하나의 potential로 합치지 않고 가: The core idea is to select a situation-specific avoidance strategy by explicitly classifying nearby structures rather than combining all obstacles into one potential.
검증은 시뮬레이션과 mobile robot 실험에서 좁은 통로, U형 장: Verification is done in simulations and mobile robot experiments using avoidance scenarios such as narrow passages, U-shaped obstacles, and crowded spaces.
결과는 전통적 reactive method가 실패하기 쉬운 장면에서 안정: Results show stable passage and collision avoidance in scenes where traditional reactive methods are prone to failure, but large-scale quantitative comparisons with modern benchmarks are limited.
비교는 potential field와 기존 local obstacle a: The comparison is based on the potential field and existing local obstacle avoidance series, and comparison with learning-based methods is not included due to time.
의의는 navigation front-end에서 local geometr: The significance is that it is a classic study that demonstrates the advantages of an approach that explicitly designs local geometry analysis in the navigation front-end.
한계는 수동 규칙과 센서 품질에 의존하고 동적 사람 군중이나 semant: Its limitations are that it relies on manual rules and sensor quality, and does not directly address dynamic human crowds or semantic preferences.
향후 과제는 동적 장애물 예측, social navigation cons: Future tasks include hybridization with dynamic obstacle prediction, social navigation constraints, and learning-based policy.
자원 공개는 DOI와 OpenAlex는 확인되지만 공개 코드나 datas: For resource disclosure, DOI and OpenAlex are confirmed, but public code or dataset page are not confirmed.
Mei-Rives calibration은 planar grid만으로 ce: Mei-Rives calibration is a unified projection model-based method that practically calibrates a central omnidirectional camera using only a planar grid.
광시야 omnidirectional camera는 로봇 localizat: Wide-field omnidirectional cameras are useful for robot localization and perception, but metric inference is difficult without accurate geometric correction.
논문은 parabolic, hyperbolic, fisheye, sphe: The paper addresses the problem of calibrating parabolic, hyperbolic, fisheye, and spherical single-viewpoint cameras with a planar grid.
기존 방법은 mirror parameter를 알아야 하거나 polynom: Existing methods were less practical because they required knowledge of mirror parameters or the polynomial model was unstable during initialization and optimization.
목표는 일반 카메라 보정처럼 쉽게 사용할 수 있으면서 central om: The goal is to create a calibration procedure that is as easy to use as a regular camera calibration, yet reflects the actual errors of a central omnidirectional sensor.
방법은 unified projection model에 radial·tan: The method adds radial·tangential distortion and intrinsic parameters to the unified projection model and performs grid corner-based initialization and nonlinear refinement.
핵심 아이디어는 이론적 central projection을 유지하되 실제: The core idea is to maintain the theoretical central projection but compensate for actual assembly errors with a small number of interpretable parameters.
검증은 parabolic, hyperbolic, folded mirror: Verification is done through calibration experiments with various actual sensors, including parabolic, hyperbolic, folded mirror, wide-angle, and spherical sensors.
결과는 다양한 omnidirectional sensor에서 낮은 repr: Results showed low reprojection error and robust point extraction from a variety of omnidirectional sensors, and the paper mentions the possibility of open source implementation.
비교는 polynomial approximation과 과매개변수 모델보다: The difference in comparison is that it is easier to initialize and has fewer interpretable parameters than the polynomial approximation and overparameterized models.
의의는 OpenCV omnidirectional calibration 계: The significance is that it has become a representative study of a practical central camera model that also influenced the OpenCV omnidirectional calibration series.
한계는 single viewpoint 가정이 깨지는 렌즈·거울 조합이나: Limitations do not directly address lens/mirror combinations that break the single viewpoint assumption or time-varying calibration.
향후 과제는 online calibration, multi-camera: Future tasks include online calibration, multi-camera omnistereo, non-central camera model, and uncertainty propagation.
자원 공개는 DOI와 HAL 공개본은 확인되지만 저자 페이지의 원 코드: For resource disclosure, DOI and HAL disclosures are confirmed, but the original code link on the author page is not confirmed.
이 논문은 AR 인터페이스로 사람이 로봇의 symbolic knowled: This paper presents an interactive knowledge patching method in which a person corrects manipulation failure by modifying the robot's symbolic knowledge on site using an AR interface.
서비스 로봇은 실제 환경에서 물체 위치와 affordance, 작업 규칙: It is difficult for service robots to operate stably based on prior knowledge when object locations, affordances, and work rules change in the real environment.
논문은 로봇이 가진 지식베이스의 오류나 누락을 사용자가 AR로 직접 보고: The paper addresses the problem of users directly viewing and correcting errors or omissions in the robot's knowledge base using AR.
기존 지식 기반 로봇은 내부 symbolic representation이: Existing knowledge-based robots had internal symbolic representations that were not visible to users, making it difficult to explain and correct the cause of failure.
목표는 AR을 통해 로봇 지식을 시각화하고 사람이 현장에서 patch를: The goal is to visualize the robot's knowledge through AR and have humans patch it in the field to restore planning and execution.
방법은 AR 장치로 객체와 relation을 표시하고 사용자의 수정 입력: The method displays objects and relations with an AR device and reflects the user's correction input into the robot knowledge base and task planner.
핵심 아이디어는 human-in-the-loop를 단순 teleopera: The key idea is to view human-in-the-loop not as a simple teleoperation but as a knowledge debugging procedure that directly modifies the robot's world model.
검증은 조작 과제에서 잘못된 지식 또는 누락된 관계를 AR patch로: Verification is performed through an experiment to see whether the task is successful by correcting incorrect knowledge or missing relationships in the manipulation task with an AR patch.
결과는 사용자가 로봇 지식을 더 직관적으로 수정해 실패 과제를 회복할 수: Results show that users can more intuitively modify robot knowledge to recover from failed tasks, but large-scale user studies are limited.
비교는 전통적 재프로그래밍이나 수동 지식베이스 편집보다 현장 맥락과 sp: The comparison highlights the strength of field context and spatial visualization over traditional reprogramming or manual knowledge base compilation.
의의는 explainable robot planning과 AR-assis: The significance is that it presents a practical interaction direction between explainable robot planning and AR-assisted robot programming.
한계는 AR 장비와 지식 표현 설계에 의존하며 continuous per: The limitation is that it depends on the AR equipment and knowledge representation design and does not automatically resolve continuous perception errors or low-level control failures.
향후 과제는 VLM 기반 자동 지식 제안, multi-user patch: Future tasks include VLM-based automatic knowledge proposal, multi-user patch provenance, and long-term knowledge consistency verification.
자원 공개는 DOI와 공개 poster는 확인되지만 공식 코드·데이터셋: For resource disclosure, DOI and public poster are confirmed, but official code/dataset links are not confirmed.
이 논문은 생물학적 CPG와 반사 개념을 사족 로봇에 적용해 자연 지면에: This paper is a classic study that implemented adaptive dynamic walking on natural surfaces by applying biological CPG and reflex concepts to a quadruped robot.
거친 자연 지형에서 사족 로봇이 넘어지지 않고 걷기 위해서는 사전 경로: In order for a quadruped robot to walk without falling over rough natural terrain, rapid sensory-motor adaptation is more important than prior path planning.
논문은 생물학적 보행 제어 개념을 이용해 불규칙한 지면에서 사족 로봇의: The paper addresses the problem of stabilizing the dynamic walking of a quadruped robot on irregular ground using the concept of biological gait control.
기존 scripted gait는 평탄한 지면에는 맞지만 지면 높이와 접촉: The existing scripted gait was suitable for flat ground, but its robustness was reduced when ground height and contact conditions changed.
목표는 central pattern generator와 reflex-li: The goal is to implement an adaptive gait controller on natural surfaces by combining a central pattern generator and reflex-like feedback.
방법은 신경 oscillator 기반 gait generation, ve: The method applies neural oscillator-based gait generation, vestibular·touch feedback, and body posture control to an actual quadruped platform.
핵심 아이디어는 보행을 정확한 궤적 추종이 아니라 생물학적 rhythm과: The core idea is to view walking as a closed-loop process in which biological rhythm and reflex feedback mutually compensate, rather than following an exact trajectory.
검증은 실제 사족 로봇이 자연 지면과 불규칙 지형을 걷는 하드웨어 실험: Verification is centered on hardware experiments in which an actual four-legged robot walks on natural ground and irregular terrain.
결과는 평탄하지 않은 지형에서 보행 적응과 자세 안정성을 보였으나 현대: The results showed gait adaptation and postural stability on uneven terrain, but comparative figures compiled with modern benchmark metrics are limited.
비교는 trajectory replay 방식보다 생체모사 feedback: The key to the comparison is a qualitative comparison in that the biomimetic feedback structure adapts better to disturbances than the trajectory replay method.
의의는 이후 legged locomotion에서 CPG, reflex,: The significance provided an important experimental basis for the subsequent research stream combining CPG, reflex, and sensor feedback in legged locomotion.
한계는 수동 설계 parameter가 많고 고속 달리기나 복잡한 발 디딤: The limitation is that there are many manual design parameters and it does not generalize to high-speed running or complex foot stepping plans.
향후 과제는 learning-based parameter adaptati: Future challenges include learning-based parameter adaptation, terrain perception, and the combination of whole-body MPC and biomimetic control.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 공식 코드·데이터셋은 확: Resource disclosure is confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but official code/dataset is not confirmed.

이 논문은 사람의 demonstration에서 cost function을: This paper is a study in which a mobile robot performs social navigation by learning the cost function from a human demonstration using inverse reinforcement learning.

논문은 사람이 선호하는 navigation behavior를 demons: The paper addresses the problem of creating a socially compliant path by learning people's preferred navigation behavior from demonstrations.

핵심 아이디어는 social rule을 직접 코딩하지 않고 사람이 실제로: The key idea is to back-estimate the reward/cost so that the path actually chosen by the person has a low cost, without directly coding the social rule.

이 논문은 3D LiDAR point cloud에서 ground, obj: This paper is an early autonomous driving perception study that deals with a geometry-based segmentation method for segmenting ground, object, and surface structures in a 3D LiDAR point cloud.
자율주행과 야외 로봇은 3D LiDAR 점군에서 주행 가능 지면과 장애물: Autonomous driving and outdoor robots must quickly separate drivable ground, obstacles, and object candidates from the 3D LiDAR point cloud.
논문은 sparse하고 noisy한 3D LiDAR point cloud: The paper addresses the problem of dividing a sparse and noisy 3D LiDAR point cloud into meaningful segments.
기존 image segmentation이나 2D range scan 기법: Existing image segmentation or 2D range scan techniques did not sufficiently reflect the non-uniform density and large outdoor scene structure of 3D LiDAR.
목표는 3D point cloud의 geometric cue를 이용해 이: The goal is to reliably generate segments that can be used for subsequent detection and tracking using the geometric cue of the 3D point cloud.
방법은 ground removal, local surface proper: The method uses point cloud segmentation procedures based on ground removal, local surface property, connected component, or clustering.
핵심 아이디어는 원시 점을 바로 객체로 분류하기보다 LiDAR scan: The core idea is to first create structurally consistent regions using LiDAR scan geometry rather than directly classifying raw points into objects.
검증은 야외 3D LiDAR 데이터에서 segmentation 품질과 d: Verification is a method of evaluating segmentation quality and downstream object perception possibility in outdoor 3D LiDAR data.
결과는 3D LiDAR 기반 scene understanding의 전처리: The results provided useful segmentation as preprocessing for 3D LiDAR-based scene understanding, but were not a deep learning semantic benchmark.
비교는 당시 geometric clustering과 ground segm: The comparison is based on geometric clustering and ground segmentation approaches at the time, and hand-crafted geometry is the key.
의의는 PointNet 이전 시대 LiDAR perception에서 ge: The significance is that the study showed how important geometry preprocessing was in LiDAR perception in the pre-PointNet era.
