향후 과제는 semantic segmentation, self-super: Future tasks include semantic segmentation, self-supervised LiDAR representation, temporal tracking, and multimodal fusion.
이 논문은 여러 시점의 기하 단서로 천의 코너 grasp point를 찾: This paper is a classic cloth manipulation study in which a PR2 type double-armed robot succeeded in autonomously folding a towel by finding the corner grasp point of the cloth using geometric clues from multiple viewpoints.
천 조작은 deformable object의 상태가 복잡하고 시각 app: Cloth manipulation is a representative difficult task in robot manipulation due to the complex state of deformable objects and their diverse visual appearances.
논문은 무작위로 놓인 수건에서 신뢰할 수 있는 grasp point를 찾: The paper addresses the problem of finding a reliable grasp point in a randomly placed towel and executing a folding sequence.
기존 cloth manipulation은 특수 도구나 강한 초기 상태 가: Existing cloth manipulation relies on special tools or strong initial state assumptions, making it difficult to repeat successfully with a typical robotic hand.
목표는 texture에 덜 의존하는 geometric cue로 수건 코너: The goal is to detect towel corners with geometric cues that are less dependent on texture and complete the folding task with a common two-arm mobile platform.
방법은 multiple-view depth/geometric observ: The method detects cloth extremity and corner candidates through multiple-view depth/geometric observation and performs regrasp and folding motion sequences.
핵심 아이디어는 천의 appearance가 아니라 보이는 형상 극값과 기: The key idea is to find the graspable corner using the visible shape extremes and geometry rather than the appearance of the fabric.
검증은 실제 로봇에서 단일 수건과 수건 더미 folding 실험을 수행하: Verification is a hardware verification that performs single towel and towel pile folding experiments on an actual robot.
결과는 project page 기준 단일 수건 <strong>50/50<: The results reported a successful single towel 50/50 trial based on the project page, showing strong experimental results in deformable manipulation at the time.
비교는 simulation-only cloth planning보다 실제: The comparison is different in that it shows end-to-end folding in an actual robot rather than simulation-only cloth planning.
의의는 deformable object manipulation에서 per: Significance: This is a representative study showing that perception, regrasp, and task sequence must be combined in deformable object manipulation.
한계는 수건 같은 비교적 정형 cloth와 조명·배경 조건에 맞춰져 있으: The limitations are limited to relatively standard cloth such as towels and lighting/background conditions, and generalization of complex clothing or pile manipulation is limited.
향후 과제는 learned cloth state representatio: Future tasks include learned cloth state representation, tactile feedback, category-level garment folding, and failure recovery.

KISS-ICP는 adaptive threshold, robust ker: KISS-ICP is a paper that shows that point-to-point ICP is also powerful in several LiDAR odometry benchmarks if adaptive threshold, robust kernel, deskewing, and subsampling are well designed.
LiDAR odometry는 자율주행, 매핑, 이동 로봇에서 3D sca: LiDAR odometry must reliably estimate ego-motion in autonomous driving, mapping, and mobile robots using only a 3D scan stream.
논문은 복잡한 feature engineering이나 IMU 없이 poi: The paper asks whether robust LiDAR odometry can be achieved with point-to-point ICP without complex feature engineering or IMU.
기존 최신 시스템은 많은 module과 sensor fusion을 추가해: The latest existing systems improved performance by adding many modules and sensor fusion, but it became unclear which elements were actually needed.
목표는 핵심 구성만 남긴 간단한 LiDAR odometry pipelin: The goal is to show that a simple LiDAR odometry pipeline, leaving only the core components, can achieve SOTA-level performance on a variety of platforms and datasets.
방법은 point-to-point ICP에 adaptive corresp: The method combines point-to-point ICP with adaptive correspondence threshold, robust kernel, simple motion compensation, and voxel subsampling.
핵심 아이디어는 ICP 자체가 낡은 것이 아니라 threshold와 mo: The core idea is that the ICP itself is not old, but that it is sufficiently strong if the basics such as threshold and motion distortion processing are designed properly.

비교는 LOAM 계열과 modern LiDAR odometry basel: The comparison targets the LOAM series and the modern LiDAR odometry baseline, and the key differentiator is simplicity versus performance.
의의는 복잡성 증가가 항상 답이 아니라는 점을 실험적으로 보여 LiDAR: The significance is that it re-established the ablation standard for LiDAR SLAM research by experimentally showing that increasing complexity is not always the answer.
한계는 순수 LiDAR 기반이라 feature-poor geometry나: The limitation is that it is purely LiDAR-based, so feature-poor geometry, dynamic-heavy scenes, and global loop closure depend on separate configurations.
향후 과제는 semantic filtering, loop closure,: Future tasks include semantic filtering, loop closure, multi-session mapping, uncertainty-aware odometry, and adverse weather evaluation.

Kintinuous 계열 연구는 RGB-D SLAM에 volumetric: Kintinuous series research proposed a method to create dense maps of large spaces in real time by combining RGB-D SLAM with volumetric fusion and deformation-based loop closure.
RGB-D SLAM은 camera pose뿐 아니라 로봇이 사용할 수 있: RGB-D SLAM is required to create not only camera pose but also a dense 3D surface map that can be used by robots in real time.
논문은 저가 RGB-D 센서 하나로 수백 미터 규모의 큰 환경을 dens: The paper addresses the problem of reconstructing a large environment measuring hundreds of meters into a dense volumetric map using a single low-cost RGB-D sensor.
기존 KinectFusion류 방법은 작은 작업공간에는 강하지만 fixe: Existing KinectFusion-type methods are strong in small workspaces, but are vulnerable to large-scale environments and loop closures due to the fixed volume.
목표는 large-scale scene에서도 volumetric fusi: The goal is to create a dense RGB-D SLAM system that restores global consistency while maintaining volumetric fusion quality even in large-scale scenes.
방법은 moving volume, pose tracking, volume: The method combines moving volume, pose tracking, volumetric fusion, deformation graph-based loop closure and map correction.
핵심 아이디어는 dense TSDF map을 streaming 방식으로: The core idea is to expand the dense TSDF map in a streaming manner and transform and match not only the trajectory but also the surface map itself during loop closure.
검증은 실제 RGB-D sequence에서 대규모 실내 reconstru: Verification evaluates large-scale indoor reconstruction quality, trajectory consistency, and runtime in actual RGB-D sequences.
결과는 commodity RGB-D sensor만으로 큰 공간의 glob: The results showed that globally consistent dense reconstruction of a large space can be generated in close to real time using only a commodity RGB-D sensor.
비교는 KinectFusion과 sparse SLAM 대비 large-s: The strengths of the comparison are large-scale dense mapping and loop correction compared to KinectFusion and sparse SLAM.
의의는 ElasticFusion 등 이후 dense visual SLAM: The significance is that it has strengthened the importance of surface fusion and deformation correction in dense visual SLAM research since ElasticFusion and others.
한계는 RGB-D 센서 범위와 조명, dynamic object, mem: Limitations remain sensitive to RGB-D sensor range and lighting, dynamic objects, memory management, and long sequence drift.
향후 과제는 learned geometry priors, semantic: Future tasks include learned geometry priors, semantic dynamic filtering, lifelong dense mapping, and GPU memory-efficient representation.

이 논문은 소형 quadrotor swarm이 야외 숲 같은 비정형 환경: This paper demonstrates a system in which a small quadrotor swarm flies cooperatively without collision through onboard perception and planning in an unstructured environment such as an outdoor forest.
소형 비행 로봇 swarm은 탐색과 감시, 구조 작업에 유용하지만 야외: Small flying robot swarms are useful for search, surveillance, and rescue operations, but it is difficult to fly cooperatively without collision in an outdoor unstructured environment.
논문은 외부 인프라 없이 여러 micro aerial robot이 unk: The paper addresses the problem of multiple micro aerial robots flying together in an unknown cluttered environment without external infrastructure.
기존 swarm flight는 실내 motion capture나 단순 환: Existing swarm flights often relied on indoor motion capture, simple environments, and offboard computation.
목표는 onboard sensing, localization, mappi: The goal is to demonstrate swarm autonomy in real outdoor environments by combining onboard sensing, localization, mapping, and trajectory planning.
방법은 lightweight perception, local mappin: The method integrates lightweight perception, local mapping, decentralized planning, trajectory optimization, and multi-robot coordination pipeline.
핵심 아이디어는 swarm 각 개체가 작은 계산 자원으로 주변을 실시간: The core idea is to lightweight the entire system so that each swarm entity understands its surroundings in real time with small computational resources and creates a collision avoidance trajectory.
검증은 실제 micro flying robots를 사용한 outdoor: Verification is performed through outdoor wild environment flight experiments and swarm scenarios using actual micro flying robots.
결과는 논문 제목처럼 실험실 밖 자연 환경에서 micro robot sw: As the title of the paper suggests, the result demonstrated micro robot swarm flight in a natural environment outside the laboratory, and the code is linked to the Science Robotics public video.
비교는 controlled indoor swarm보다 실제 환경 난이도가: The actual environment difficulty in comparison is higher than that of a controlled indoor swarm, and the requirement for multi-agent coordination is greater than that of a single-robot planner.
의의는 swarm robotics가 데모 중심 실내 환경을 넘어 야외 자: Significance is that the systems paper demonstrates that swarm robotics can be extended beyond demonstration-oriented indoor environments to outdoor autonomy problems.
한계는 특정 하드웨어와 환경 조건에 맞춘 통합 시스템이며 장기 임무, 악: Limitations are that integrated systems are tailored to specific hardware and environmental conditions, and long-duration missions, adverse weather, communication failures, and large-scale swarm expansion remain.
향후 과제는 semantic exploration, resilient c: Future tasks include semantic exploration, resilient communication, task allocation, safety guarantees, and larger swarm scaling.

이 논문은 quadrotor의 aggressive maneuver에서 a: This paper is an early aerial robotics study that enabled high-speed and wide-angle flight by modeling and controlling aerodynamic effects in the aggressive maneuver of a quadrotor.
Quadrotor가 빠른 임무를 수행하려면 hover 근방의 단순 모델을: For a quadrotor to perform a fast mission, it must handle large attitude changes and aerodynamic drag beyond a simple model near the hover.
논문은 autonomous quadrotor가 aggressive man: The paper addresses aerodynamic modeling and control issues required when an autonomous quadrotor performs an aggressive maneuver.
기존 quadrotor control은 small-angle hover: Existing quadrotor control is close to the small-angle hover assumption, so model errors increase during high-speed movement or sudden changes in attitude.
목표는 실험 기반 aerodynamic model과 controller를: The goal is to expand the quadrotor's aggressive flight envelope through experimentally based aerodynamic models and controllers.
방법은 quadrotor dynamics에 blade flapping 등: The method includes aerodynamic effects such as blade flapping in quadrotor dynamics and performs experimental flights with a trajectory tracking controller.
핵심 아이디어는 aggressive flight의 실패를 제어 gain: The core idea is that the failure of aggressive flight is viewed not as a lack of control gain but as an overlooked aerodynamic force modeling problem.
검증은 실제 quadrotor platform에서 빠른 비행과 급격한 m: Verification is done through fast flight and rapid maneuver tracking experiments on an actual quadrotor platform.
결과는 공력 보상이 포함된 모델이 aggressive maneuver t: The results showed that a model including aerodynamic compensation could improve aggressive maneuver tracking performance.
비교는 단순 rigid-body hover model 기반 제어보다 hi: The comparison shows that model accuracy is more important in high-speed flight than in simple rigid-body hover model-based control.
의의는 quadrotor가 정적 hover 장난감이 아니라 동적 비행 로: Significance was that it provided the model-based control axes necessary for the quadrotor to evolve into a dynamic flying robot rather than a static hover toy.
한계는 modern learning-based agile flight나: Limitations do not include modern learning-based agile flight or onboard perception, but include the experimental environment and platform specific tuning.
향후 과제는 vision-in-the-loop aggressive fli: Future tasks include vision-in-the-loop aggressive flight, aerodynamic learning, wind disturbance rejection, and agile planning-control co-design.
RRBT는 상태가 아니라 belief space에서 RRT식 탐색을 수행: RRBT is a representative study that deals with motion planning under uncertainty by performing RRT-style search in belief space rather than state.
로봇은 센서와 제어가 불확실한 상황에서 단순 state trajector: In situations where sensors and control are uncertain, robots must be planned considering belief evolution rather than a simple state trajectory.
논문은 motion planning under uncertainty를 b: The paper solves motion planning under uncertainty as a belief tree search problem and raises the problem of handling collision risk and information uncertainty together.
기존 RRT는 deterministic state space를 빠르게 탐: Existing RRT quickly explores the deterministic state space, but cannot directly express uncertainty propagation and chance constraints.
목표는 RRT의 탐색 장점을 belief space로 확장해 불확실한 시: The goal is to create a planner that can be applied to uncertain systems by extending the exploration advantages of RRT to belief space.
방법은 Gaussian belief, covariance propagat: The method constructs a Rapidly-exploring Random Belief Tree using Gaussian belief, covariance propagation, graph dominance relation, and sampling-based expansion.
핵심 아이디어는 동일한 state라도 uncertainty가 다르면 다른: The core idea is that even in the same state, if the uncertainty is different, it is viewed as a different planning node and the better belief dominates the bad belief.
검증은 불확실한 동역학과 관측 조건을 가진 planning benchma: Verification is a simulation-based experiment that evaluates path success probability and cost on a planning benchmark with uncertain dynamics and observation conditions.
결과는 deterministic RRT보다 uncertainty-awar: The results showed that it is possible to find an uncertainty-aware route rather than a deterministic RRT, but it is not a general-purpose solution for solving the entire high-dimensional POMDP.
비교는 RRT류 sampling planner와 belief-space: The comparison is based on an RRT-type sampling planner and belief-space planning approach, and the tractability of uncertainty representation is a strength.
의의는 belief-space motion planning과 chance: The significance is that it shows the possibility of sampling-based expansion in belief-space motion planning and chance-constrained robotics.
한계는 Gaussian approximation과 covariance u: Its limitations depend on Gaussian approximation and covariance update, and are burdensome for complex non-Gaussian uncertainty or high-dimensional perception states.
향후 과제는 POMDP solvers, active perception,: Future tasks include combining POMDP solvers, active perception, risk-sensitive planning, and learned belief dynamics.
자원 공개는 DOI와 MIT handle은 확인되지만 공식 코드 저장소는: For resource disclosure, the DOI and MIT handle are confirmed, but the official code repository is not confirmed.
이 논문은 maximum-entropy deep reinforcement: This paper is a study that used maximum-entropy deep reinforcement learning to learn a robot walking policy with relatively few real trials and showed the possibility of sim-to-real walking control.
로봇 보행은 모델 기반 제어로도 가능하지만 다양한 하드웨어와 지형에 적응: Robotic walking is possible with model-based control, but there is a growing need to automatically learn policies that adapt to various hardware and terrain.
논문은 deep reinforcement learning으로 legged: The paper addresses the problem of sample-efficiently learning a legged robot walking policy using deep reinforcement learning.
기존 RL 보행 연구는 많은 simulation tuning이나 막대한: Existing RL gait research requires a lot of simulation tuning or extensive real-world trials, so the cost of applying actual robots is high.
목표는 minimal per-task tuning으로 안정적인 보행 정책: The goal is to demonstrate a maximum-entropy RL-based approach that can learn a stable walking policy with minimal per-task tuning.
방법은 Soft Actor-Critic 계열의 entropy-regula: The method uses the Soft Actor-Critic series of entropy-regularized off-policy RL to learn a locomotion policy and apply it to an experimental walking task.
핵심 아이디어는 policy entropy를 유지해 탐색과 안정성을 높이: The core idea is to maintain policy entropy to improve search and stability, and to improve actual trial efficiency by reusing off-policy data.
검증은 시뮬레이션과 실제 legged robot walking 실험을 통: Verification evaluates learning success and robustness through simulation and actual legged robot walking experiments.
결과는 modest number of trials로 neural walk: The results showed that it was possible to learn a neural walking policy with a modest number of trials, but task-specific safeguards and reward design are still important.
비교는 on-policy RL이나 hand-tuned controller: The comparison emphasizes sample efficiency and reduced tuning burden compared to on-policy RL or hand-tuned controllers.
의의는 SAC류 modern deep RL이 실제 로봇 locomotio: The significance is that it is a baseline study that widely publicizes that SAC-type modern deep RL can be applied to actual robot locomotion.
한계는 reward shaping, safety during explor: Limitations include reward shaping, safety during exploration, hardware wear, and out-of-distribution terrain responses that have not been fully resolved.
향후 과제는 offline RL, safe exploration, sim: Future tasks include expansion to offline RL, safe exploration, sim-to-real adaptation, terrain-aware locomotion, and foundation policy.
자원 공개는 RSS DOI와 arXiv는 확인되지만 논문 공식 코드 링크: Resource disclosure is confirmed through RSS DOI and arXiv, but the link to the official code of the paper is not confirmed.
이 논문은 powered ankle-foot prosthesis가 pus: This paper is a rehabilitation robot study showing that a powered ankle-foot prosthesis can actively provide push-off power to reduce the metabolic cost of amputated walking.
하퇴 절단 보행에서는 발목 push-off 기능 상실 때문에 보행 에너지: In lower leg amputation gait, the energy cost of walking increases and gait symmetry may deteriorate due to loss of ankle push-off function.
논문은 능동 발목-발 보철이 사용자의 walking metabolic e: The paper addresses the issue of assessing whether active ankle-foot prosthetics actually improve the user's walking metabolic economy.
기존 passive prosthesis는 에너지를 저장·반환할 수는 있지: Existing passive prosthesis can store and return energy, but it is difficult to actively supply net positive work like a normal ankle.
목표는 powered ankle-foot prosthesis가 보행 중: The goal is to experimentally verify whether a powered ankle-foot prosthesis reduces physiological costs by assisting with ankle work required during walking.
방법은 모터 구동 ankle-foot prosthesis와 gait co: The method uses a motor-driven ankle-foot prosthesis and gait control and measures metabolic cost and biomechanics of the user's gait.
핵심 아이디어는 보철 발목을 수동 spring이 아니라 보행 phase에: The key idea is that the prosthetic ankle is designed not as a passive spring, but as an active actuator that applies mechanical work in accordance with the gait phase.
검증은 하퇴 절단 사용자 또는 실험 참가자의 treadmill walki: The verification is a human-subject experiment that measures metabolic energy and gait parameters in treadmill walking of lower leg amputees or experiment participants.
결과는 powered prosthesis가 보행 metabolic eco: The results showed that powered prosthesis can improve walking metabolic economy, but the number of users and long-term adaptation effect are limited.
비교는 passive-elastic prosthesis 대비 active: The comparison shows that active push-off is functionally different compared to passive-elastic prosthesis.
의의는 wearable robotics와 assistive prosthe: Significance: We have demonstrated that energy-injected assistance in wearable robotics and assistive prosthetics can provide real physiological benefits.
한계는 장치 무게, 배터리, 사용자별 tuning, 장기 임상 효과, 다: Limitations remain in device weight, battery, user-specific tuning, long-term clinical effectiveness, and walking on various terrains.
향후 과제는 adaptive prosthesis control, terr: Future tasks include adaptive prosthesis control, terrain-aware assistance, long-term clinical trials, and lightweight actuator design.
자원 공개는 DOI와 MIT DSpace record는 확인되지만 설계: DOI and MIT DSpace records are confirmed for resource disclosure, but disclosure of design files, control codes, and clinical data are not.
이 논문은 Faster R-CNN류 detector와 tiling str: This paper is an agricultural robotics study that detects large amounts of fruit in orchard images using a Faster R-CNN type detector and tiling strategy.
농업 로봇과 수확량 추정은 나무 환경에서 과실을 정확히 세고 위치를 찾는: Agricultural robots and yield estimation require perception skills to accurately count and locate fruit in a tree environment.
논문은 과수원 이미지에서 겹침과 작은 객체, 조명 변화가 있는 과실을 d: The paper addresses the problem of detecting fruits with overlap, small objects, and lighting changes in orchard images using a deep detector.
기존 handcrafted color/shape detector는 과실: Existing handcrafted color/shape detectors were vulnerable to changes in fruit type, lighting, and occlusion.
목표는 deep object detection을 orchard setti: The goal is to apply deep object detection to an orchard setting and analyze the required training data size and inference strategy.
방법은 Faster R-CNN 기반 detector를 과일 이미지에 학습: The method trains a Faster R-CNN-based detector on fruit images and applies tiling when there are 100-1000 fruits in one image.
핵심 아이디어는 자연 과수원 이미지의 작은 과실 밀집 문제를 detect: The core idea is to address the problem of small fruit density in natural orchard images not only through detector architecture, but also through image tiling and data diversity issues.
검증은 여러 농장과 과일 종류의 orchard dataset에서 dete: Validation is an offline experiment that evaluates detection performance and data ablation in the orchard dataset of various farms and fruit types.
결과는 deep detector가 전통 vision보다 강한 fruit: The results show that the deep detector has stronger fruit detection performance than traditional vision, and data requirements and deployment conditions were analyzed.
비교는 handcrafted orchard detection보다 repr: The comparison shows that representation learning is more robust to change than handcrafted orchard detection.
의의는 agricultural robotics에서 deep learnin: Significance is that deep learning perception in agricultural robotics can lead to practical yield estimation and automatic harvesting.
한계는 과일 종류와 지역·계절 변화, occlusion, annotati: Limitations include fruit type, regional and seasonal changes, occlusion, annotation costs, and real-time onboard deployment.
향후 과제는 domain adaptation, multi-season d: Future tasks include domain adaptation, multi-season dataset, 3D fruit localization, and robot harvesting closed-loop integration.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 ACFR Orchard Fruit Dataset: References to arXiv and ACFR Orchard Fruit Dataset are confirmed for resource disclosure, but the official data download status requires separate confirmation.
Frustum ConvNet은 2D proposal에서 생성한 slidi: Frustum ConvNet is a detection method that predicts amodal 3D object boxes by aggregating point-wise features in the sliding frustum generated from 2D proposals with FCN.
3D object detection은 카메라의 2D proposal과 p: The performance of 3D object detection depends on how to connect the camera's 2D proposal and the point cloud's 3D geometry.
논문은 2D detector가 제안한 frustum 내부 point를 사: The paper addresses the problem of predicting an amodal 3D bounding box using points inside the frustum proposed by a 2D detector.
기존 frustum 기반 방법은 point feature aggregat: Existing frustum-based methods were limited in point feature aggregation and maintenance of spatial resolution and did not fully utilize local geometry.
목표는 sliding frustum representation으로 loc: The goal is to achieve strong 3D detection both indoors and outdoors by well collecting local point-wise features with sliding frustum representation.
방법은 2D region proposal에서 여러 frustum을 만들고: The method creates several frustums from a 2D region proposal, arranges the point features of each frustum, and estimates the box using a fully convolutional network.
핵심 아이디어는 frustum을 하나의 큰 공간으로만 보지 않고 slid: The core idea is to continuously aggregate local 3D evidence by dividing the frustum into sliding slices rather than viewing it as one large space.
검증은 SUN-RGBD와 KITTI dataset에서 3D object: Verification is an offline benchmark evaluation performed with a 3D object detection metric on the SUN-RGBD and KITTI datasets.
결과는 arXiv 초록 기준 SUN-RGBD에서 기존 방법을 넘고 KIT: The results reported that SUN-RGBD exceeded existing methods based on arXiv abstracts and had stronger performance than published methods at the time of KITTI submission.
비교는 Frustum PointNet류와 KITTI/SUN-RGBD de: The comparison targets Frustum PointNet and KITTI/SUN-RGBD detectors, and 2D detector dependency is a common premise.
의의는 camera proposal 기반 3D detection에서 po: Significance showed the importance of point feature aggregation design in camera proposal-based 3D detection.
한계는 2D detector recall에 상한을 받으며 end-to-e: Limitations are limited by 2D detector recall and do not directly address end-to-end sensor fusion or temporal tracking.
향후 과제는 transformer-based fusion, tempora: Future tasks include transformer-based fusion, temporal detection, lidar-camera uncertainty, and fully end-to-end multimodal detector.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 zhixinwang/frustum-convnet: Resource disclosure is confirmed through arXiv and zhixinwang/frustum-convnet GitHub.
Neural RRT*는 learning module로 sampling 또: Neural RRT* is a learning-based planning study that aims to increase the optimal path planning efficiency of RRT* by guiding sampling or expansion with a learning module.
Sampling-based optimal planning은 이론적으로 강: Sampling-based optimal planning is theoretically strong, but requires many samples to converge to a good solution in a complex environment.
논문은 RRT*류 planner에 neural learning을 넣어 탐: The paper addresses the issue of improving search efficiency and path quality by applying neural learning to an RRT* type planner.
기존 RRT*는 무작위 sampling에 크게 의존해 구조가 있는 환경에: Existing RRT* relies heavily on random sampling, resulting in many unnecessary searches even in structured environments.
목표는 과거 계획 경험이나 환경 표현을 이용해 optimal path p: The goal is to propose a learning-guided RRT* that makes optimal path planning faster by using past planning experience or environmental representations.
방법은 neural network가 promising region 또는: The method uses a neural network to predict promising regions or planning decisions and combines them with the sampling/rewiring process of RRT*.
핵심 아이디어는 RRT*의 completeness·optimality 장: The core idea is to superimpose a data-driven prior on top of a classic planner that maintains the completeness and optimality advantages of RRT*.
검증은 2D 또는 robot path planning benchmark에: Verification is performed by comparing path cost, planning time, and success rate with existing RRT* in a 2D or robot path planning benchmark.
결과는 학습된 guidance가 탐색 시간을 줄이고 near-optima: The results showed that the learned guidance can reduce search time and find the near-optimal path more quickly.
비교는 vanilla RRT*, RRT*-variant와 수행되며 neu: Comparisons are made with vanilla RRT* and RRT*-variant, and although the neural prior is strong, generalization outside the training distribution is a separate issue.
의의는 classical motion planning과 neural pr: Its significance is a representative example of the hybrid planner flow that combines classical motion planning and neural prediction.
한계는 학습 데이터 생성 비용, unseen environment 일반화: Limitations include the cost of generating learning data, generalizing unseen environments, and maintaining theory guarantees, which determine actual performance.
향후 과제는 point-cloud scene input, uncertai: Future tasks include expansion to point-cloud scene input, uncertainty-aware guidance, safety guarantees, robot dynamics, and kinodynamic planning.
자원 공개는 DOI/OpenAlex는 확인되지만 이 논문 공식 GitHu: Resource disclosure is confirmed through DOI/OpenAlex, but not through this paper's official GitHub.
LIO-mapping은 LiDAR feature와 IMU measurem: LIO-mapping is a tightly-coupled LiDAR-inertial SLAM method that estimates pose even in fast motion and feature-poor situations by combining LiDAR features and IMU measurement through joint optimization.
LiDAR odometry는 빠른 움직임이나 feature 부족 상황에서: In LiDAR odometry, drift and distortion can increase with only scan matching in situations of fast movement or lack of features.
논문은 3D LiDAR와 IMU를 tight coupling으로 융합해: The paper addresses the problem of performing odometry and mapping by converging 3D LiDAR and IMU through tight coupling.
기존 loosely coupled LIO는 센서 간 제약을 충분히 활용하: Existing loosely coupled LIO could not fully utilize inter-sensor constraints and had lower stability due to LiDAR degradation.
목표는 LiDAR와 IMU residual을 함께 최소화해 빠른 moti: The goal is to minimize LiDAR and IMU residuals together to estimate high-precision pose at the IMU update rate even in fast motion.
방법은 LiDAR edge/plane feature residual과 I: The method puts LiDAR edge/plane feature residual and IMU preintegration constraints into joint optimization and matches them to the global map with LIO-mapping refinement.
핵심 아이디어는 LiDAR pose를 나중에 IMU로 보정하는 대신 두: The key idea is to simultaneously describe observations from both sensors in one cost function, rather than calibrating the LiDAR pose to the IMU later.
검증은 실내·실외 fast motion dataset과 challengi: Verification evaluates trajectory performance in indoor and outdoor fast motion datasets and challenging LiDAR feature conditions.
결과는 빠른 motion이나 feature가 부족한 상황에서도 accep: The results are reported to show acceptable drift and high precision even in situations where fast motion or features are lacking.
비교는 LOAM 계열과 VINS-Mono 구성요소를 배경으로 하며 tig: The comparison is based on the LOAM family and VINS-Mono components and highlights the benefits of tightly-coupled fusion.
의의는 FAST-LIO, LIO-SAM 등 이후 LiDAR-inertia: Its significance is one of the important turning points in the development of the LiDAR-inertial SLAM series after FAST-LIO and LIO-SAM.
한계는 feature extraction과 calibration, IMU: Its limitations depend on feature extraction and calibration, IMU quality, and do not completely resolve dynamic objects and loop closure.
향후 과제는 factor graph smoothing, direct Li: Future tasks include factor graph smoothing, direct LiDAR residual, online calibration, dynamic filtering, and large-scale loop closure.
자원 공개는 arXiv, project page, hyye/lio-map: Resource disclosures include arXiv, project page, and hyye/lio-mapping GitHub.
이 논문은 snap-through bistability를 이용한 soft: This paper implements autonomous on/off and oscillation of a pneumatic soft actuator without external electronic control using a soft valve using snap-through bistability.
Soft pneumatic robot은 부드러운 actuator를 쓰지만: Soft pneumatic robots use soft actuators, but often still require hard valves and electronic devices for control.
논문은 soft actuator 안에 control logic을 넣기 위: The paper addresses the problem of designing a soft bistable valve to incorporate control logic into a soft actuator.
기존 soft robot은 actuator는 soft라도 valve와 c: Existing soft robots have soft actuators, but their valves and controllers are rigid and tied to external devices, limiting their complete autonomous softness.
목표는 전원 없이 상태를 유지하고 압력 조건에 따라 전환되는 soft b: The goal is to create a soft pneumatic circuit by creating a soft bistable valve that maintains its state without power and switches depending on pressure conditions.
방법은 elastomeric membrane의 snap-through i: The method uses snap-through instability of the elastomeric membrane to create two stable states and adjusts the pressure threshold by geometry.
핵심 아이디어는 제어를 전자 신호가 아니라 재료와 구조의 불안정성에 내장: The key idea is to change the control from electronic signals to pneumatic logic built into the instability of materials and structures.
검증은 valve pressure response, pneumatic o: Validation consists of valve pressure response, pneumatic oscillator, autonomous gripper, and earthworm-like locomotion demonstration.
결과는 단일 constant pressure source로도 주기 운동과: The results showed that periodic motion and autonomous grasping could be created with a single constant pressure source.
비교는 hard solenoid valve 기반 제어보다 soft bod: The difference in comparison is that the control function can be integrated within a soft body rather than hard solenoid valve-based control.
의의는 soft robot에서 computation과 control이 재: The significance is that it is a representative material-logic study that showed that computation and control in soft robots can be placed in the material structure itself.
한계는 복잡한 다자유도 제어, 정밀 timing, 외란 적응, 대규모 회: There are still limitations in complex multi-degree-of-freedom control, precise timing, disturbance adaptation, and large-scale circuit design.
향후 과제는 soft pneumatic logic network, int: Future tasks include soft pneumatic logic network, integrated sensing, programmable materials, and untethered soft robot control.
자원 공개는 DOI, Whitesides group page, PDF와: Resource disclosures include DOI, Whitesides group page, PDF, and supplementary, but CAD/code datasets are not.
이 논문은 MIT Cheetah의 설계와 실험을 통해 고토크밀도 모터,: This paper summarizes the importance of high torque density motors, low loss transmission systems, low inertia legs, and energy regeneration for efficient legged locomotion through MIT Cheetah's design and experiments.
다리 로봇이 실제 이동 플랫폼이 되려면 속도뿐 아니라 에너지 효율과 충격: For a legged robot to become a real mobile platform, it must satisfy not only speed but also energy efficiency and impact durability.
논문은 효율적인 legged locomotion을 위해 어떤 구동기와 기: The paper addresses the problem of verifying with an MIT Cheetah implementation which actuator and mechanism design principles are needed for efficient legged locomotion.
기존 legged robot은 높은 에너지 소비, 큰 transmissi: Existing legged robots were far from animal-level efficiency due to high energy consumption, large transmission loss, and heavy leg inertia.
목표는 에너지 손실 메커니즘을 분석하고 이를 줄이는 설계 원리를 실제 M: The goal is to analyze energy loss mechanisms and apply design principles to reduce them to the actual MIT Cheetah robot.
방법은 actuator heat loss, transmission fri: The method analyzes actuator heat loss, transmission friction, and ground interaction loss and applies high torque density motor, low loss transmission, and low leg inertia design.
핵심 아이디어는 보행 효율을 controller tuning 이전에 ac: The core idea is to view walking efficiency as an actuator-transmission-leg mechanical co-design problem before controller tuning.
검증은 MIT Cheetah의 trotting experiment와 co: Verification is done through MIT Cheetah's trotting experiment and analysis of cost of transport, speed, and mechanical design.
결과는 MIT Cheetah가 기존 로봇 대비 낮은 transport c: The results showed that MIT Cheetah approached the low transport cost area compared to existing robots, and the paper presents a TCoT comparison plot.
비교는 ASIMO, BigDog, iSprawl 등 기존 로봇과 동물의: The comparison is based on efficiency indicators of existing robots and animals such as ASIMO, BigDog, and iSprawl.
의의는 이후 proprioceptive actuator와 dynamic: Its significance later became the standard for hardware design principles in proprioceptive actuator and dynamic quadruped research.
한계는 특정 로봇 구조에 맞춘 설계라 모든 지형과 보행 형태, auton: The limitation is that it is designed for a specific robot structure, so it cannot be generalized to all terrains, walking patterns, and autonomy stacks.
향후 과제는 더 가벼운 actuator, 내구성 높은 transmissi: Future challenges include lighter actuators, more durable transmission, learning/MPC-based locomotion, and hardware co-design.
자원 공개는 DOI, MIT Biomimetics publication,: For resource disclosure, DOI, MIT Biomimetics publication, and open PDF candidates are confirmed, but the entire design file/code is not confirmed.
이 논문은 IMU measurement를 manifold 위에서 prei: This paper presents a core technique for visual-inertial MAP estimation that preintegrates IMU measurements on a manifold and efficiently reuses IMU factors even when the keyframe pose changes.
Visual-inertial SLAM은 카메라 keyframe 사이의 고: Visual-inertial SLAM must efficiently incorporate high-frequency IMU measurements between camera keyframes into a factor graph.
논문은 bias와 pose linearization이 바뀌어도 IMU i: The paper addresses the preintegration problem of not having to redo IMU integration every time even if bias and pose linearization change.
기존 IMU factor는 optimization 중 상태 추정이 변할: The existing IMU factor had a large reintegration cost when the state estimate changed during optimization, and rotation manifold processing was difficult.
목표는 SO(3) manifold에서 IMU measurement를 pr: The goal is to enable efficient maximum-a-posterior visual-inertial estimation by preintegrating IMU measurement in the SO(3) manifold.
방법은 consecutive keyframes 사이 IMU를 local: The method preintegrates the IMU in local frames between consecutive keyframes and inserts bias correction and covariance propagation into the factor graph.
핵심 아이디어는 IMU 적분을 global pose 추정값과 분리해 lo: The key idea is to make graph optimization faster by separating the IMU integral from the global pose estimate and storing it as a local relative motion factor.
검증은 visual-inertial estimation benchmark: Verification is performed by evaluating accuracy and efficiency in visual-inertial estimation benchmark and simulation/real data.
결과는 preintegration이 정확도를 유지하면서 계산량을 크게 줄: The results show that preintegration significantly reduces the amount of computation while maintaining accuracy and makes smoothing-based VIO practical.
비교는 naive reintegration이나 filter-based V: The strength of the comparison is that it uses the IMU efficiently within graph optimization compared to naive reintegration or filter-based VIO.
의의는 GTSAM, VINS, ORB-SLAM3, Kimera 등 현대: The significance of this paper is that it directly influenced the design of key factors of modern VIO/SLAM backend such as GTSAM, VINS, ORB-SLAM3, and Kimera.
한계는 Gaussian noise, accurate calibration: Limits depend on Gaussian noise, accurate calibration, and bias model, and separate corrections are required for severe vibration or time offset.
향후 과제는 online temporal calibration, robu: Future tasks include online temporal calibration, robust IMU noise modeling, and expansion of preintegration with event/rolling-shutter cameras.
자원 공개는 RSS paper와 DOI는 확인되며 공개 구현은 GTSAM: Resource disclosure is confirmed in RSS paper and DOI, and public implementation is confirmed in subsequent libraries such as GTSAM, but paper-only repo is not confirmed.
Orbit은 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 위에서 로봇 학습 환경, 센서: Orbit is an interactive robot learning framework that modularly configures the robot learning environment, sensors, robot platform, and benchmark tasks on NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
로봇 학습 연구는 photorealistic rendering, rigi: Robotic learning research requires a simulation base that can handle photorealistic rendering, rigid/deformable physics, and various robots and sensors.
논문은 reinforcement learning, imitation le: The paper addresses the problem of creating an integrated robot learning simulation framework that can be shared by reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and task planning research.
기존 환경은 특정 task나 simulator에 묶여 sensor mod: The existing environment was tied to a specific task or simulator, making it difficult to handle sensor modality, deformable object, and mobile manipulation at the same time.
목표는 Isaac Sim의 물리·렌더링 기능을 활용해 다양한 로봇 플랫폼: The goal is to quickly configure and benchmark various robot platforms and tasks by utilizing Isaac Sim's physics and rendering functions.
방법은 World와 Agent abstraction, sensor/act: The method designs a modular framework that provides world and agent abstraction, sensor/action interface, task template, and learning library wrapper.
핵심 아이디어는 환경 정의와 agent computation graph를: The core idea is to separate the environment definition and agent computation graph, allowing RL, imitation, and planning tasks to be cut differently in the same world.
검증은 framework 기능과 benchmark task suite,: Verification is performed using framework functions, benchmark task suite, and parallel learning/demonstration collection examples.
결과는 arXiv 초록 기준 <strong>16</strong> robo: The results are reported to provide 16 robot platforms, 4 sensor modalities, 10 motion generators, and 20+ benchmark tasks based on arXiv abstracts.
비교는 MuJoCo·PyBullet·Gazebo류보다 photoreali: Compared to MuJoCo·PyBullet·Gazebo, its strengths are photorealistic scenes and Isaac Sim sensor/physics integration, but the hardware requirements are large.
의의는 Isaac Lab으로 이어지는 modern robot learni: Its significance was that it served as the predecessor to the modern robot learning simulation ecosystem leading to Isaac Lab.
한계는 고사양 GPU와 Isaac Sim 의존성이 있고, simulati: Limitations include dependency on high-end GPU and Isaac Sim, and simulation fidelity does not guarantee real-world transfer.
향후 과제는 real-to-sim asset pipeline, sim-t: Future tasks include real-to-sim asset pipeline, sim-to-real benchmark, multi-robot task, and LLM/VLA agent integration.
자원 공개는 arXiv와 isaac-orbit project가 확인되며: The arXiv and isaac-orbit projects are confirmed to be releasing resources, and the current ecosystem appears to be leading to the Isaac Lab series.
이 논문은 휴머노이드 전신 운동을 선형·각운동량 관점에서 계획하고 제어하: This paper is a study that presents the concept of resolved momentum control, which plans and controls humanoid whole body movements from a linear and angular momentum perspective.
휴머노이드 운동은 손발 위치뿐 아니라 전신의 선형·각운동량을 조절해야 균: Humanoid movement requires control of not only the position of the hands and feet, but also the linear and angular momentum of the whole body to satisfy both balance and movement.
논문은 humanoid motion planning을 linear and: The paper deals with how to formulate humanoid motion planning as a linear and angular momentum control problem.
기존 joint-space 또는 ZMP 중심 접근은 전신 운동량과 상체·: Existing joint-space or ZMP-centered approaches found it difficult to explicitly address the effects of whole body momentum and balance of upper body and arm movements.
목표는 원하는 momentum behavior를 생성하고 이를 human: The goal is to propose a resolved momentum control framework that generates desired momentum behavior and translates it into humanoid joint motion.
방법은 centroidal momentum 관계를 사용해 task-lev: The method connects the task-level momentum command and joint velocity or acceleration using the centroidal momentum relationship.
핵심 아이디어는 휴머노이드 균형을 발 위치만이 아니라 전신 질량 분포와: The core idea is to view humanoid balance as a matter of whole body mass distribution and angular momentum control, not just foot position.
검증은 humanoid motion generation 시뮬레이션 또는: Verification is a method of demonstrating the momentum-based planning effect through humanoid motion generation simulation or robot model examples.
결과는 복잡한 humanoid motion을 momentum variab: The results show that complex humanoid motions can be planned with momentum variables, but are not directly comparable to modern whole-body QP.
비교는 ZMP-only 또는 joint trajectory plannin: What differentiates the comparison is that it reflects whole body dynamics more directly than ZMP-only or joint trajectory planning.
의의는 centroidal momentum dynamics와 whole-: Significantly, centroidal momentum dynamics and whole-body control have contributed to the trend of becoming key tools in humanoid robotics.
한계는 접촉 전환, friction cone, torque limit를: The limits are simpler than modern optimization formulations that incorporate contact transition, friction cone, and torque limits.
향후 과제는 whole-body MPC, multi-contact pla: Future tasks include integration with whole-body MPC, multi-contact planning, angular momentum regulation, and humanoid manipulation.
CLOCs는 2D detector와 3D detector의 후보 box를: CLOCs is a late-fusion method that improves 3D detection with camera-LiDAR object candidate consistency by combining the candidate boxes of 2D detector and 3D detector before NMS.
자율주행 3D detection에서는 LiDAR와 camera가 상보적이: In autonomous driving 3D detection, LiDAR and camera are complementary, but simple feature fusion is not always better than a single modality.
논문은 어떤 2D detector와 3D detector의 후보 결과도: The paper addresses the decision-level fusion problem, which improves the final detection by combining candidate results from any 2D detector and 3D detector.
기존 early/deep fusion은 detector 구조에 강하게 묶: Existing early/deep fusion is strongly tied to the detector structure, and late fusion is a simple score average that does not fully utilize geometric consistency.
목표는 NMS 이전의 2D·3D candidate를 함께 보고 더 정확한: The goal is to present a low-complexity fusion network that sees 2D and 3D candidates before NMS together and creates a more accurate 3D/2D detection score.
방법은 3D box를 image plane에 투영하고 2D box와의 g: The method projects a 3D box onto the image plane and inputs the geometric relationship and confidence with the 2D box into the CLOCs network.
핵심 아이디어는 raw sensor feature가 아니라 detecto: The key idea is to learn the positional and semantic consistency between detector candidates rather than raw sensor features, so that they can be attached to an arbitrary detector.
검증은 KITTI 3D object detection benchmark에: Verification is performed using a combination of detectors such as SECOND and Cascade R-CNN in the KITTI 3D object detection benchmark.

논문은 simulation의 privileged full state를 학: The paper deals with a robot learning problem that uses the privileged full state of simulation during learning, but only image observation during deployment.
기존 image-based RL은 perception과 control을: Existing image-based RL requires learning perception and control simultaneously, resulting in low sample efficiency, and state-based policy cannot be directly used in real robots.
목표는 actor는 RGB-D image로 행동하고 critic은 sim: The goal is to propose an asymmetric actor-critic that provides a more accurate learning signal with the actor acting as an RGB-D image and the critic as a simulation full state.
방법은 actor-critic 구조에서 policy input과 valu: The method uses different policy inputs and value/critic inputs in an actor-critic structure and learns a simulated manipulation task with domain randomization.
핵심 아이디어는 학습 때만 접근 가능한 simulator state를 t: The core idea is to stabilize the learning of partial observation actors by inserting the simulator state, which is accessible only during learning, into the critic like a teacher signal.

결과는 asymmetric input이 image-only actor-c: The results report that asymmetric input improves performance over image-only actor-critic and shows sim-to-real transfer without real data.
비교는 symmetric image-based actor-critic과: The comparison targets symmetric image-based actor-critic and state-based training settings and shows the advantages of privileged critic.
의의는 이후 privileged learning, asymmetric c: The significance is that it is a representative study that summarizes training-only information patterns that are widely used in privileged learning, asymmetric critic, and sim-to-real RL.
한계는 simulator state와 domain randomizatio: Limitations depend on the simulator state and domain randomization quality, and complex real-world contact or long-horizon tasks require additional structures.
